paper.title: Science Edge Evaluation: SEE the Missing Step Toward Real Scientific Discovery
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in scientific discovery, yet it remains unclear whether they can support complex real laboratory science. Here we introduce Science Edge Evaluation (SEE), a multimodal benchmark of expert-curated questions grounded in peer-reviewed literature and experimental practice in chemistry, biology, and materials science. Evaluation of 19 multimodal large language models (MLLMs) shows that even the best-performing model reaches only 48.7% accuracy. M

summary.core_problem: 评估当前多模态大模型是否真的能支持接近真实实验室场景的科学发现，而不是只会回答教科书式科学问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是一个专家策划的科学多模态 benchmark，覆盖化学、生物、材料，并把文献证据、实验实践和 visual-agent tool use 放进同一评测框架。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它暴露了通用 MLLM 在高证据约束科学推理上的短板，以及工具使用并不自动带来可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Science Edge Evaluation (SEE)，题目来自同行评审文献与实验实践，强调模型必须在原始实验依据边界内推理；同时设计 visual-agent 评测，测试工具调用带来的信息扩展是否真正转化为更可靠的科学判断。
summary.experiments: 评测 19 个 MLLM，最佳模型准确率仅 48.7%；加入工具后 visual-agent 最好到 52.7%。一个值得注意的结果是，通用模型平均优于 science-specialized 模型，说明领域微调并未解决证据约束下的科学推理问题。作为 benchmark 论文，重点是误差画像而非训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether current multimodal LLMs can support realistic laboratory-style scientific discovery rather than only answer textbook-like science questions.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an expert-curated multimodal benchmark spanning chemistry, biology, and materials science, grounded in papers and experimental practice. For pretraining researchers, the value is diagnostic: it exposes weaknesses of general MLLMs under evidence-constrained scientific reasoning and shows that tool use does not automatically yield reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Science Edge Evaluation (SEE) builds questions from peer-reviewed literature and lab practice, emphasizing reasoning within the boundary of original experimental evidence. It also includes a visual-agent setting to test whether tool-augmented information actually improves scientific decision quality.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 19 MLLMs. The best model reaches only 48.7% accuracy, and tool use raises the best visual-agent score to 52.7%. A notable finding is that general-purpose models outperform science-specialized ones on average, suggesting domain specialization alone does not solve evidence-bounded scientific reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但结论有用：通用模型胜过 science-tuned 模型、工具增信息不增可靠性，这两点会直接影响你怎么看领域继续预训练与 agent 评测。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the signal matters: general models beat science-tuned ones, and tools add information without adding reliability—both should update how you think about domain continued pretraining and agent eval.

paper.title: LongChart VQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for MLLMs with Complex Multi-Chart Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving with expanded context windows and stronger reasoning capabilities, enabling multi-chart understanding and multi-step inference. These abilities are increasingly important as MLLMs are adopted in complex agentic tasks. However, existing benchmarks largely emphasize single-chart perception, while simple chart-to-chart connections are insufficient to evaluate these capabilities. To capture multi-chart complexity while ensuring consistenc

summary.core_problem: 现有MLLM benchmark多侧重单图表感知，无法有效评估复杂多图表推理能力
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，提出基于潜在图合成的多图表VQA评测集LongChart，覆盖多步复杂推理
summary.technical_approach: 设计基于潜在图的合成pipeline，生成包含平均6.5张图像、31.2个问题的VQA集，从推理模式、辅助工具、图像扰动鲁棒性三个维度评测
summary.experiments: 评测10个SOTA MLLM，发现模型准确率随计算复杂度提升显著下降且波动大，暴露现有MLLM的多图表推理短板

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM benchmarks mostly focus on single-chart perception and cannot effectively evaluate complex multi-chart reasoning capabilities
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, introducing LongChart, a multi-chart VQA evaluation dataset synthesized via latent graphs, covering multi-step complex reasoning
summary_en.technical_approach: A latent-graph-based synthesis pipeline generates VQA sets with an average of 6.5 images and 31.2 questions, evaluating three dimensions: reasoning patterns, auxiliary tools, and robustness to image perturbations
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 10 SOTA MLLMs and finds that model accuracy drops significantly and varies widely as computational complexity increases, exposing shortcomings in multi-chart reasoning of current MLLMs

recommendation.zh: 做多模态统一预训练的可参考其评测维度设计，普通LLM预训练研究员无需深读
recommendation.en: Useful for multimodal pretraining researchers to reference evaluation dimension design; not necessary for general LLM pretraining practitioners.

paper.title: Can LVLMs Uncover the Truth Behind Visual Illusions? An Analysis of Perceptual and Reasoning Capabilities
paper.abstract: Large Vision Language Models have integrated reasoning capabilities, elevating cognitive performance to new levels. However, existing evaluations either focus solely on perception or rely on specific domains such as maths or coding. Evaluation for reasoning capabilities that align with an open-world environment is still required, especially one that considers perception and reasoning jointly. To bridge this gap, we propose to evaluate LVLMs by exploiting visual illusions as a diagnostic tool. Vi

summary.core_problem: 用视觉错觉作为诊断工具，评估 LVLM 是否能同时处理视觉感知误导和后续推理，而不是只在常规感知、数学或代码任务上表现良好。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 评测资产与诊断分析。价值在于把感知失败和推理失败放到同一个开放式场景里拆开看，可帮助判断多模态预训练是否真的学到稳定的视觉表征和跨模态推理接口。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 IllusionReasoning benchmark，收集真实世界视觉错觉图像，并配套多样化的标注问答。评测设计利用错觉图像中“客观信号”和“人类直觉误读”的差异，观察 LVLM 是被视觉表象带偏，还是能通过语言推理恢复客观判断。
summary.experiments: 摘要称评测覆盖一系列 LVLM，并发现它们的推理能力弱于常见宣传口径。公开摘要未给出具体模型清单、样本规模、准确率或分项提升数字，因此需要读实验表确认失败类型、模型代际差异和 judge 设置是否干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Adelaide University、State Key Laboratory of AI Safety、Institute of Computing Technology、University of Chinese Academy of Sciences、Tsinghua University、Amap、Alibaba Group、Beihang University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper uses visual illusions to test whether LVLMs can jointly handle misleading perception and downstream reasoning, rather than only scoring well on standard perception, math, or coding evaluations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM evaluation asset and diagnostic study. Its value is in coupling perceptual failure with reasoning failure, which is useful for understanding whether multimodal pretraining learns robust visual representations and a reliable vision-language reasoning interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build IllusionReasoning, a benchmark of real-world illusion images with diverse annotated QA pairs. The evaluation exploits the gap between objective visual signals and illusion-induced interpretations to see whether LVLMs follow the misleading percept or recover the correct answer through reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluation across a broad set of LVLMs and finds that their reasoning ability is weaker than commonly claimed. The provided abstract does not include model lists, dataset size, exact accuracy, or ablation numbers, so the experimental tables are needed to assess failure taxonomy and judge reliability.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Adelaide University, State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, Amap, Alibaba Group, and Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造和失败分解即可；若错觉样本没有泄漏和标注偏差，它能暴露 VLM 预训练里视觉表征的脆点。
recommendation.en: Read the dataset construction and failure breakdown; if leakage and annotation bias are controlled, it is a useful probe of brittle visual representations in VLM pretraining.

institutions: State Key Laboratory of AI Safety
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology

paper.title: See2Think: Do Multimodal Models Really Use Intermediate Visual States?
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models increasingly use sketches, annotations, tools, and intermediate images during reasoning, but it remains unclear whether they truly rely on these visual states. Existing benchmarks are limited both by task collections with narrow coverage or partially text-solvable samples and by evaluations that emphasize final answers without diagnosing how intermediate visual states are generated, rendered, and used. We introduce See2Think, a unified evaluation framework compri

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态模型在推理时是否真的使用草图、标注、工具生成图像等中间视觉状态，而不是只在文本链路上得到最终答案。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个多模态推理评测框架。它把最终答案评估拆成视觉动作生成、渲染状态质量、后续推理使用情况等环节，能暴露常规 VLM benchmark 中被文本可解样本和只看 final answer 掩盖的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 See2ThinkBench 和 Visual Action-of-Thought。See2ThinkBench 含 1200 个开放式、视觉依赖问题，覆盖 12 类任务，包括 2D 结构、3D 场景和真实世界推理。VAoT 记录文本思考、视觉动作、渲染状态和后续推理，并在四种受控推理设置下比较模型行为。
summary.experiments: 评测了代表性的闭源和开源多模态模型。摘要强调主要发现是视觉推理效果强依赖模型和环境配置；现有模型并不稳定地利用中间视觉状态。具体模型名单、分项分数和提升幅度需看正文表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether multimodal models actually use intermediate visual states such as sketches, annotations, tool outputs, and rendered images during reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation framework for multimodal reasoning. Instead of scoring only final answers, it decomposes the process into visual action generation, rendered-state quality, and downstream use of those states.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce See2ThinkBench and Visual Action-of-Thought. See2ThinkBench contains 1,200 open-ended visually dependent problems across 12 categories, spanning 2D structured reasoning, 3D scenes, and real-world reasoning. VAoT logs textual thoughts, visual actions, rendered states, and subsequent reasoning under four controlled inference settings.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates representative proprietary and open-source multimodal models. The abstract reports that visual reasoning is highly model- and environment-dependent, and that current systems do not reliably exploit intermediate visual states. Detailed model lists and scores require the main tables.

recommendation.zh: 读评测设计和错误分解即可；它能校准“画图推理”是否真在用视觉状态这个 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the evaluation design and error decomposition; it is useful for calibrating claims about visual-state reasoning.

paper.title: SciFigQual-Bench: A Benchmark for Scientific Figure Quality Assessment with Full-Manuscript Context
paper.abstract: Scientific images are the core elements of presenting experimental conclusions, elaborating system architecture, and supporting comparative arguments in scientific papers. However, existing image quality assessment (IQA) methods are predominantly designed for natural photographs or AI-generated content, which cannot be directly applied to scientific papers. The few existing studies on scholarly charts remain confined to visual-surface comparisons, failing to verify caption alignment, citation re

summary.core_problem: 评估科学论文中的图像质量时，现有 IQA 方法只看视觉表面，难以判断图注是否匹配、正文引用是否相关、图像是否有误导风险。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测数据集贡献，价值在于把科学图像质量评估从单图视觉质量扩展到全文上下文一致性。对通用 LLM 预训练帮助有限，但对多模态长文档理解、论文审稿辅助和 VLM-as-judge 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建 SciFigQual-Bench，覆盖清晰度、布局、图注匹配、上下文相关性、误导风险五个维度。核心设计是把图像放回完整 manuscript context 中评估，而不是只做图像或图表的表面质量打分。
summary.experiments: 数据来自 2020 至 2025 年顶级计算机科学会议论文，包含 6,308 张科学图像，由多名领域专家独立按五个维度评分并聚合为 gold-standard annotations。摘要未给出具体模型基线和评测结果细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets scientific figure quality assessment, where visual-only IQA methods cannot judge caption alignment, contextual relevance, citation fit, or misleading visual presentation.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation dataset that moves scientific figure assessment from surface-level image quality to full-manuscript contextual consistency. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but useful for multimodal long-document evaluation and VLM-as-judge setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: SciFigQual-Bench evaluates scientific figures along five axes: clarity, layout, caption fit, context relevance, and misleading risk. The key design choice is to provide full manuscript context rather than treating each figure as an isolated image.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset covers top computer-science conference papers from 2020 to 2025 and contains 6,308 figures, each independently scored by multiple domain experts and aggregated into gold annotations. The abstract does not report detailed model baselines or performance numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 长文档评测资产备查即可；预训练侧没有新方法，重点看标注维度设计。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a VLM long-document evaluation reference; no pretraining method insight, just inspect the annotation dimensions.

paper.title: AVE-Compass: Towards Holistic Evaluation for Audio-Video Editing Abilities
paper.abstract: While instruction-based video editing has advanced rapidly, real-world videos contain tightly coupled audio and visual signals, and editing one modality often requires coordinated changes in the other. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate visual transformations on silent clips or isolated audio editing, leaving complex audio-visual editing and cross-modal consistency underexplored. We introduce AVE-Compass, a comprehensive benchmark with 145 curated source videos, 196 audio-visually coupled ed

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是音视频编辑能力缺少细粒度评测的问题。现有视频编辑评测多关注静音视频的视觉变化，音频评测又常是孤立的音频生成或同步检测，无法判断模型是否同时完成目标编辑、保留非目标内容，并维持音画一致。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在统一多模态建模和评测信号设计。音视频编辑不是单纯的下游任务，它暴露了统一生成模型的几个核心短板：跨模态因果约束、时间同步、局部编辑与全局保真之间的冲突。对于研究视频-音频统一 tokenizer、AR+diffusion 联合建模、native multimodal pretraining 的团队，这类 benchmark 能帮助定位模型到底是不理解指令、不保留上下文，还是缺少音画联合规划能力。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AVE-Compass，用于 free-form audio-video editing 评测。数据包含 145 个源视频、196 条音视频耦合编辑指令和 2,688 个细粒度 checklist item。任务体系覆盖 28 类编辑操作，分为 joint audio-visual、speech、video-only、audio-only 四个分支。构建流程包括从现有视频数据集、网络视频和 AIGC 视频中收集候选样本，过滤无效音轨、音画错位、主体或声源不清晰的样本，再进行视频内容、镜头结构、主体、风格和声源标注。指令生成采用 human-in-the-loop：LLM 先基于结构化视频描述生成候选指令，critic 模型过滤不自然、不可行或与源视频不匹配的指令，最后由人工复核。评测协议将表现拆成 Instruction Following、Fidelity Preserving、Realism 和 Editing Intent。执行和保真主要由 MLLM checklist 判断，真实感由单独的 MLLM rubric 评估，同时加入音画同步、视频质量和音频质量等自动指标。论文还提出 AVE-Agent，将自由形式编辑指令分解为 task topology graph，并用 self-reflection 检查中间编辑状态，以改善复杂联合编辑任务中的质量和同步。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了代表性的开源和闭源音视频编辑系统，结论是当前系统在跨模态编辑下仍不稳定。最明显的问题出现在音频侧：模型容易错误删除或破坏背景声，也容易生成与视觉事件时间不一致的音频。视频-only 和音频-only 分支也用于检查非目标模态是否被无意修改。AVE-Agent 在复杂 joint editing 场景中改善了编辑质量和音画对齐，但给出的主要价值更偏诊断基准和错误分析，而不是一个完整替代生成模型的新训练范式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 AVE-Compass: Benchmark and Evaluation，以及 Fig. 2 的任务 taxonomy 和数据分布；再看评测协议中四个维度如何拆分，尤其是 checklist 如何区分目标编辑和非目标保真。若关注多模态生成模型的训练信号，可以看错误分析部分，重点关注音频漂移、背景声破坏、音画不同步这些 failure mode。AVE-Agent 部分可快速浏览，主要了解 task topology decomposition 和 self-reflection 如何作为规划层补丁使用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of fine-grained evaluation for audio-video editing. Existing video-editing benchmarks mostly evaluate visual changes on silent clips, while audio benchmarks often focus on isolated audio generation, replacement, or simple synchronization. They do not tell whether a model completes the intended edit, preserves untouched content, and keeps audio and visual signals temporally and semantically consistent.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining research is in unified multimodal modeling and evaluation design. Audio-video editing stresses capabilities that native multimodal models should eventually learn during pretraining: cross-modal dependency tracking, temporal alignment, local controllability, and preservation of non-target content. For work on audio/video tokenization, unified generative pretraining, or AR-diffusion hybrid models, AVE-Compass provides a useful diagnostic surface rather than just an application benchmark.
summary_en.technical_approach: AVE-Compass contains 145 source videos, 196 audio-visually coupled editing instructions, and 2,688 atomic checklist items. Its taxonomy covers 28 operation types across four branches: joint audio-visual editing, speech editing, video-only editing, and audio-only editing. Source videos are collected from existing video datasets, web videos, and generated videos, then filtered for valid audio tracks, audio-video alignment, clear subjects, clear sound sources, and well-defined editable targets. Instructions are generated from structured source-video descriptions through a human-in-the-loop pipeline: modality-aware LLM generators propose candidate instructions, a critic model filters unnatural or infeasible cases, and humans perform final verification. Evaluation is decomposed into Instruction Following, Fidelity Preserving, Realism, and Editing Intent. MLLM-based checklists judge edit execution and preservation, a separate MLLM rubric evaluates perceptual realism, and automatic metrics track audio, video, and cross-modal quality. The paper also introduces AVE-Agent, which decomposes free-form instructions into task topology graphs and uses self-reflection to inspect intermediate editing states.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate representative open-source and closed-source editing systems and find that current systems remain unreliable under cross-modal editing instructions. The dominant failures are on the audio side: background sounds are often incorrectly removed or distorted, and generated audio is frequently misaligned with edited visual events. The benchmark also exposes unintended changes to non-target modalities in video-only and audio-only settings. AVE-Agent improves editing quality and audio-video alignment in complex joint editing cases, but the stronger contribution is the benchmark and its diagnostic breakdown rather than a new foundation-model training recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction and evaluation sections, especially Fig. 2 for the task taxonomy and data distribution. The most useful part for multimodal pretraining work is the decomposition into instruction following, preservation, realism, and intent, because it clarifies which failure modes a unified model fails on. The error analysis is worth reading for concrete cases of audio drift, background-sound corruption, and temporal mismatch. The AVE-Agent section can be read quickly as a planning-layer baseline rather than the central contribution.

recommendation.zh: 音视频统一生成缺少干净评测；先看checklist设计和失败案例，模型排名反而是次要信息。
recommendation.en: Unified audio-video generation lacks clean evaluation; read the checklist design and failure cases first, with rankings treated as secondary.

paper.title: Spatial-IQ: Deconstructing Spatial Intelligence via Hierarchical Capability Tests
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at visual interpretation but fail on spatial reasoning tasks that humans solve reliably. Existing benchmarks evaluate these models as black boxes, limiting their ability to identify the underlying causes of lower performance: when a model fails a spatial reasoning task, it remains difficult to ascertain whether the hurdle is perceptual, such as recognizing object boundaries, or cognitive, such as reasoning about occlusion to infer hidden geometry. W

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型的空间推理评测仅返回最终任务的二元正确率，无法定位失败根因——无法区分错误来自低层次感知环节（如物体边界识别）还是高层次认知环节（如遮挡推断、支撑关系推理），也无法验证模型是否习得了与人类一致的层级化空间推理结构，而非依赖统计相关性猜测答案。
summary.importance: 为视觉语言模型的空间/物理常识能力评测提供了可诊断的分层框架，能够精确定位模型在物理世界建模上的能力短板；提出的分层任务分解式训练思路，为多模态模型空间能力的对齐训练提供了可复用的范式参考。
summary.technical_approach: 参考皮亚杰人类发展心理学与儿童空间认知标准化测试（考夫曼儿童评估测验的积木计数子项），将3D堆叠物体计数这一核心空间任务拆解为9个具有依赖关系、从感知到认知递进的子任务，额外加入心理旋转作为能力探针；基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim生成带全层级标注的合成视觉数据集，覆盖每个子任务的中间真值；训练侧提出两阶段方案：首先依据子任务依赖关系设计显式链式思考格式做监督微调，随后采用可验证奖励的强化学习，同时为最终答案正确和每个子步骤正确发放奖励。
summary.experiments: 覆盖闭源MLLM、开源MLLM、图像生成编辑模型的评测，并设置人类受试者作为对照，结果显示现有性能靠前的MLLM常能猜对最终计数结果，但中间子任务的正确率远低于人类，不具备人类表现出的层级推理依赖结构；初步训练结果显示，分层SFT结合分步RL的方案相比直接端到端训练最终答案有显著性能提升，可让模型习得类似人类的层级分解推理策略。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言部分对现有空间推理评测缺陷的分析、层级化任务拆解的设计逻辑，以及两阶段训练范式的动机，数据集生成的具体实现细节可略过，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks for multimodal large language models only return binary correctness scores for end tasks, failing to localize root causes of failures: they cannot distinguish errors originating from low-level perception (e.g., object boundary detection) from those caused by high-level cognitive deficits (e.g., occlusion inference, support relation reasoning), nor can they verify whether models acquire hierarchical spatial reasoning structures consistent with humans, rather than guessing answers via statistical correlations.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a diagnostic hierarchical evaluation framework for spatial and physical commonsense capabilities of vision-language models, enabling precise localization of weaknesses in physical world modeling. The proposed hierarchical task decomposition training approach offers a reusable paradigm reference for aligning spatial capabilities in multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Piaget's developmental psychology and standardized children's spatial cognition tests (the Block Counting subtest of the Kaufman Assessment Battery for Children), the framework decomposes the core task of counting stacked 3D objects into 9 dependent subtasks progressing from perceptual to cognitive levels, with mental rotation added as an additional capability probe. Fully annotated synthetic visual stimuli are generated via NVIDIA Isaac Sim, with ground truth for all intermediate subtasks. For training, a two-stage pipeline is introduced: first supervised fine-tuning on an explicit chain-of-thought format derived from subtask dependencies, then reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, which grants rewards for both correct final answers and correct execution of each intermediate step.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover closed-source MLLMs, open-weight MLLMs, and image editing models, with human participants as a control group. Results show that top-performing MLLMs often guess the correct final count but perform far worse than humans on intermediate subtasks, lacking the hierarchical reasoning dependency structure observed in humans. Initial training results show that the combination of hierarchical SFT and stepwise RL delivers significant performance gains over end-to-end training on final answers alone, enabling models to learn human-like hierarchical decomposition strategies.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the introduction's analysis of limitations in existing spatial reasoning benchmarks, the design logic of hierarchical task decomposition, and the motivation for the two-stage training paradigm. Details of dataset generation can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做多模态预训练，读任务分解和误差归因设计就够了；它不改方法论，但能帮你把“空间推理差”拆成可训练的问题。
recommendation.en: If you work on multimodal pretraining, read the task decomposition and error attribution design; it won’t change your method, but it can turn “poor spatial reasoning” into trainable subproblems.

paper.title: Medical-Checklist: Assessing the Comprehension of Medical Images by Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: This paper introduces a new benchmark test, Medical-Checklist, for assessing medical multimodal models. The recent advancements in multimodal models have demonstrated significant potential in the field of medical vision-language tasks. However, it is becoming increasingly clear that evaluating these models' performance, whether they are applied to natural or medical images, is challenging. The critical question is whether the models can accurately understand an input image while associating it w

summary.core_problem: 解决医学多模态模型评测里，现有指标难以判断模型是否真的理解图像与文本对应关系的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark/evaluation protocol。虽然场景在医学影像，仍有一点方法学价值：用最小文本扰动构造二选一判别，测试模型是否抓住关键概念，而不是靠语言先验蒙对。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Medical-Checklist：给定一张图像和两条候选描述，其中错误描述只替换一个医学概念词或短语，模型需做二分类选择。这个设计试图统一评估不同架构和训练方式的多模态模型，并把评测聚焦到概念级图文对应。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和完整结果，但强调该任务足够简单，能在不同类型的多模态模型间统一比较。对预训练研究员的价值主要在评测构造思路，而不是医学结果本身。
summary.authors_note: 作者为 Bannapol Limanond、Masanori Suganuma、Takayuki Okatani。未从给定信息中确认更具体的团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of evaluating whether medical multimodal models truly understand image-text correspondence rather than exploiting superficial cues.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol. While the domain is medical imaging, the methodological idea is still somewhat useful: use minimal textual perturbations in a forced-choice setup to test concept-level grounding instead of language-prior guessing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Medical-Checklist presents an image with two captions, where the incorrect one differs by a single substituted medical concept. The model must choose the correct caption, aiming to isolate concept-level image-text understanding across diverse multimodal models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model scales or full quantitative results, but emphasizes that the task is simple enough to compare heterogeneous multimodal models under a unified protocol. The value for pretraining researchers lies more in the evaluation design than in the medical findings.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are Bannapol Limanond, Masanori Suganuma, and Takayuki Okatani. No stronger lab context can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 医学场景限制了外推性，但“单概念替换 + 二选一”这个评测模板很干净；做 VLM 对齐时可直接借去测语言先验泄漏。
recommendation.en: The domain is narrow, but the single-concept substitution plus forced-choice protocol is clean; borrow the template if you need to probe language-prior leakage in VLMs.

paper.title: Do VLMs Read or Rewrite? On Transcription Faithfulness in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used in place of traditional OCR pipelines for document understanding. In this paper, we show they do not always act as faithful transcribers: when text is imperfect, they often tend to rewrite it into a more plausible form - a behavior that clean-text OCR benchmarks cannot detect. We introduce FaithC4, a multilingual perturbation benchmark of 1,455 single-page documents (English, Chinese, Korean) with three perturbation families: scramble, random s

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是一个很实际但常被忽略的问题：VLM 在文档转写时，究竟是在“读”图像里的字，还是在用语言先验“改写”成更像正常文本的内容。标准 OCR benchmark 多是干净文本，测不出这种偏差；而一旦输入里有拼写错误、字符扰动或视觉歧义，通用 VLM 可能输出更合理但不忠实的文本。作者要解决的核心问题不是 OCR 准确率本身，而是 transcription faithfulness，也就是模型是否逐字忠实于视觉证据。
summary.importance: 对纯 LLM 预训练的直接相关性有限，但对多模态预训练和统一建模很有启发。它揭示了一个典型的 pretrain-posttrain 张力：强语言建模先验会提升语义恢复能力，却可能损害字面保真。对于把文档理解、图像文字读取、视觉 token 到文本解码统一进一个大模型的人，这个问题很关键，因为它不是下游 prompt 小问题，而是训练目标与模态融合方式带来的系统性偏置。更具体地说，这篇工作提醒两点。第一，VLM 里的 LM prior 不是免费午餐，尤其在需要 literal transcription 的场景。第二，评测如果只看 clean OCR，会高估通用 VLM 作为“读字器”的可靠性。贡献主要在 benchmark 与现象刻画，不是新训练方法。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分两部分：构造可控扰动 benchmark，以及用它分离“视觉读取”与“语言改写”两种行为。作者从 mC4 采样英文、中文、韩文单页文档文本，先在文本层做受控字符扰动，再渲染成 PDF 图像。这样 ground truth 就是扰动后的文本，而不是原始干净文本，因此可以明确判断模型是在忠实转写，还是偷偷纠正。这个设计比直接在现成扫描文档上评测更干净，因为扰动位置、比例、类型都可控。

扰动分三类。Scramble 保留首尾字符、打乱中间字符，用来测试模型是否依赖词形整体模式和语言先验；Random 用同脚本随机字符替换，测试强破坏下的鲁棒性；Visual 用视觉相似字符替换，测试视觉歧义与语言先验的竞争。英文和韩文按词处理，中文按 4 字窗口处理。作者在 8% 的 eligible words 或字符窗口上施加扰动，并保留原始版本作为对照。

评测对象分三类：通用 VLM、OCR-specialized VLM、传统 OCR。这个分组很重要，因为它对应不同强度的语言先验。通用 VLM 经过大规模多模态与文本预训练，最容易“脑补”；OCR 专项模型经过文档抽取微调，语言先验被任务约束部分压制；传统 OCR 基本是字符级识别，没有强生成式 prior。作者用统一 prompt 让通用 VLM 自然输出，不额外强调“不要纠错”，避免把现象用指令压掉。

除了整体误差统计，论文还对 Qwen3-VL-4B 做层间 probing，分析何时发生 rewriting。作者发现，当扰动词的内部表示仍靠近原始词编码时，模型更容易走向“改写”而非“照抄”。另一个细节是词长效应：短词更容易被语言模型先验覆盖，长词一旦偏离正常拼写，模型反而不容易自信地纠正。
summary.experiments:
实验规模是 1,455 份单页文档，覆盖 EN/ZH/KO 三种脚本，评测 15 个系统。主结果很清楚：通用 VLM 在扰动下的 WER 退化最大，英文上可到 4.5 个百分点；OCR-specialized VLM 的退化约 0.2–2 个百分点；传统 OCR 小于 0.6 个百分点。这个差异基本支持作者的核心论点：语言先验越强，越容易在 imperfect text 上牺牲忠实性。

另一个重要发现是非局部效应。即便只扰动约 5% 的词，通用 VLM 在未扰动部分上的错误也会比 clean baseline 高 5–10 倍。这说明 rewriting 不是局部字符识别失误，而是整页上下文建模被带偏，模型会在更大范围内重写文本。对统一文档模型来说，这个现象比单点 WER 更值得警惕。

跨语言结果也有信息量。结论在英中韩都成立，但最伤的扰动类型因脚本不同而异，说明 rewriting 既受语言模型先验影响，也受书写系统和字符空间结构影响。中文没有 scramble，更多体现 visual/random 替换的影响；韩文由于可施加扰动的长词比例较低，整体扰动率也更低。

机制分析部分，Qwen3-VL-4B 的 layerwise probing 显示：当 perturbed word 的表示与原词仍接近时，模型更可能输出原词或“合理词”，而不是视觉上真实出现的扰动词。词长实验显示 4–6 字符短词的 rewriting 率可达约 10%，超过 7 字符后降到 0%。这说明 LM prior 对短词的覆盖更强，而长词的组合空间更大，模型不容易做高置信纠错。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读到中等深度。先看 Introduction，抓住作者要测的是 faithfulness，不是一般 OCR accuracy。然后看数据构造部分，确认 ground truth 为什么定义成“扰动后文本”，以及三类 perturbation 分别在测什么。主表格里重点比较三类系统在不同语言、不同扰动下的 WER 退化，而不是只看 clean performance。接着看 non-local effect 的分析，这部分最能说明通用 VLM 的问题不是局部识别，而是整页生成偏置。最后看 Qwen3-VL-4B 的 probing 和词长分析，理解 rewriting 何时发生。

如果只花 25–35 分钟，建议看：任务定义、FaithC4 构造、主结果表、non-local effect 图、Qwen3-VL probing。若要进一步深挖，值得追问三点：这种 rewriting 能否通过训练目标修正；OCR-specialized VLM 的改进来自数据还是解码约束；以及在 native multimodal pretraining 里，如何平衡语义恢复与字面保真。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode that standard OCR-style evaluation largely misses: when asked to transcribe documents, do VLMs actually read the text, or do they rewrite it into something more plausible? On clean benchmarks, this distinction is mostly invisible. But once the input contains typos, character corruption, or visually ambiguous symbols, a model with a strong language prior may output a corrected or normalized string rather than the literal content in the image. The core problem is therefore transcription faithfulness, not generic OCR accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to text-only pretraining is limited, but it is quite relevant to multimodal pretraining and unified modeling. The paper exposes a clear trade-off: stronger language-model priors can improve semantic recovery while hurting literal fidelity. That matters for document VLMs, OCR-capable multimodal LMs, and any setup that decodes text from visual tokens using a powerful generative backbone. The main lesson is not about prompting; it is about objective mismatch and modality fusion. If evaluation only measures clean-text OCR, it can overestimate how reliable a general-purpose VLM is as a faithful reader. The contribution is primarily a benchmark plus a careful characterization of the phenomenon, not a new training method.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two technical components: a controlled perturbation benchmark and an evaluation protocol designed to separate visual reading from language-driven rewriting. The authors sample raw text from mC4 in English, Chinese, and Korean, apply character-level perturbations directly in text space, and then render the perturbed text into single-page document images. This is a strong design choice because the ground truth becomes the perturbed text itself, making it possible to tell whether a model transcribes what is present or silently corrects it.

They use three perturbation families. Scramble preserves the first and last character while shuffling the middle, probing reliance on lexical priors. Random substitution replaces characters with random same-script alternatives, creating severe corruption. Visual substitution replaces characters with visually similar ones, probing the competition between visual evidence and language prior. English and Korean are perturbed at the word level; Chinese uses non-overlapping 4-character windows. The perturbation rate is controlled, with clean documents retained as a baseline.

The evaluation spans three system classes: general-purpose VLMs, OCR-specialized VLMs, and traditional OCR pipelines. This taxonomy is central to the paper’s argument because it roughly orders systems by the strength of their language prior. General VLMs have broad multimodal and text pretraining and are most likely to hallucinate corrections. OCR-specialized VLMs are constrained by document extraction fine-tuning. Traditional OCR systems operate much closer to character recognition and have little generative prior. The authors also avoid adding anti-correction instructions to the prompt, so the model’s default behavior is exposed rather than suppressed.

Beyond aggregate error rates, the paper probes Qwen3-VL-4B layer by layer. The mechanistic claim is that rewriting tends to occur when the internal representation of a perturbed word remains close to the representation of the original clean word. They also report a word-length effect: short words are much more likely to be rewritten than longer ones.
summary_en.experiments:
The benchmark contains 1,455 single-page documents across English, Chinese, and Korean, and the evaluation covers 15 systems. The main result is clean and consistent: general-purpose VLMs degrade the most under perturbation, with up to 4.5 WER points on English; OCR-specialized VLMs degrade by about 0.2 to 2 points; traditional OCR pipelines degrade by less than 0.6 points. This strongly supports the paper’s central claim that stronger language priors increase the risk of sacrificing faithfulness on imperfect text.

A particularly important finding is the non-local effect. Corrupting only around 5% of words can increase errors on the untouched remainder by 5–10x relative to the clean baseline for general VLMs. That means the issue is not just local character confusion. The model’s page-level generation process is being pulled toward a different textual interpretation, which is much more concerning for unified document models.

The multilingual results are also informative. The same qualitative pattern holds across English, Chinese, and Korean, but the most damaging perturbation type differs by script. This suggests that rewriting is shaped both by language priors and by script-specific visual and tokenization structure. The probing analysis on Qwen3-VL-4B further shows that rewriting is more likely when the perturbed token remains representationally close to the original word. The word-length analysis reports rewriting rates of up to about 10% for short 4–6 character words, dropping to 0% beyond 7 characters.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a solid skim-to-medium-depth read. Start with the introduction to understand that the target property is faithfulness, not ordinary OCR score. Then read the benchmark construction carefully: why the perturbed text is treated as ground truth, and what each perturbation family is intended to isolate. In the main results, focus on degradation relative to the clean condition rather than absolute clean performance. The most important section after that is the non-local effect analysis, because it shows the problem is not merely local recognition noise but a broader generation bias. Finally, read the Qwen3-VL-4B probing and word-length analysis to see when rewriting is triggered.

If you only have 25–35 minutes, read the task definition, FaithC4 construction, main result tables, the non-local-effect figure, and the probing section. If you want to go deeper, the useful follow-up questions are: whether this behavior can be corrected by training objectives rather than prompts, whether OCR-specialized VLM gains come mainly from data or decoding constraints, and how native multimodal pretraining should balance semantic recovery against literal fidelity.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的价值不在 OCR，而在它把 VLM 的“看见”与“补全”混淆测得很干净；做原生多模态预训练的人应重点看 benchmark 设计和 Qwen3-VL 的层分析。
recommendation.en: The point is not OCR but a clean measurement of when VLMs confuse seeing with language completion; if you work on native multimodal pretraining, read the benchmark design and the Qwen3-VL layer analysis.

paper.title: ESCUCHA: A Spanish Speech Benchmark for Heterogeneous Acoustic Conditions
paper.abstract: As large audio language models (LALMs) advance, robust evaluation frameworks have become essential. In this context, Spanish speech understanding under realistic acoustic conditions has received particularly little attention. We introduce ESCUCHA, the first Spanish speech understanding benchmark designed to evaluate LALMs across heterogeneous acoustic conditions and reasoning abilities. ESCUCHA comprises 1,000 human-curated questions paired with audio, totaling 162.9 hours sourced directly ``fro

summary.core_problem: 构建用于评估 large audio language models 在真实西班牙语声学条件下语音理解能力的 benchmark。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态/音频 LM 评测资产。现有音频语言模型评测对西班牙语、口音差异、非规范语音、长音频和复杂声学环境覆盖不足；ESCUCHA 提供了更接近真实使用条件的测试集。
summary.technical_approach: ESCUCHA 包含 1,000 个真人整理的问题，配对 162.9 小时来自真实环境的音频，而不是从现有数据集中抽样。数据覆盖几秒到 80 分钟以上的音频，包含 9 类感知问题和 10 类推理问题，并加入多音频问题、口头问题、音频指令和开放式评估标记。
summary.experiments: 摘要称对若干当前多模态/音频模型进行了 benchmarking，但未给出具体模型列表、分数或失败模式。应重点查看不同声学条件、长音频、多音频和口音维度下的模型差异，而不是只看总分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating large audio language models on Spanish speech understanding under realistic and heterogeneous acoustic conditions.
summary_en.importance: This is an audio-LM and multimodal evaluation contribution. Existing benchmarks under-cover Spanish, accent variation, non-normative speech, long audio, and messy real-world acoustics; ESCUCHA provides a more realistic testbed for those conditions.
summary_en.technical_approach: ESCUCHA contains 1,000 human-curated questions paired with 162.9 hours of audio collected from the wild rather than sampled from existing datasets. Audio durations range from seconds to over 80 minutes. The benchmark spans 9 perceptual and 10 reasoning categories and includes multi-audio questions, spoken questions, audio instructions, and flags for open-ended evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that several multimodal/audio models are benchmarked but does not provide the model list, scores, or error breakdowns. The most useful results are likely the per-condition gaps across acoustics, long audio, multi-audio inputs, and accent variation rather than aggregate scores.

recommendation.zh: 做 audio LM eval 可以收进 benchmark 表；不做西语或长音频，读任务 taxonomy 就够。
recommendation.en: Add it to the audio-LM benchmark list; if Spanish or long audio is not your focus, the task taxonomy is enough.

paper.title: GDP.pdf: Benchmarking Grounded Multimodal Reasoning over Professional PDF Documents
paper.abstract: A large share of day-to-day work in professional domains happens inside PDF files: benefits packets, leases, datasheets, clinical guidelines, construction plans. Benchmarks for document AI have generally measured the required capabilities in isolation: OCR, layout analysis, chart reasoning, table QA, document VQA. A high score on any one of them does not necessarily reveal whether a model can answer a realistic question that someone in the field would actually ask about a specific PDF. GDP.pdf i

summary.core_problem: 现有文档 AI benchmark 把 OCR、版面分析、图表推理、表格 QA、文档 VQA 等能力拆开单独测，高分无法预测模型在真实专业 PDF 工作流中的表现；而且模型在真实 PDF 上的错误经常不是显性错误，而是引用了存在但不具决定性的条款或数字，看起来像对的，实际上没有 grounded 到正确证据。
summary.importance: 从评测角度补了一个重要缺口：面向真实职业场景的 grounded multimodal reasoning。核心贡献不是规模，而是构建原则——所有题目来自十个领域从业者的真实工作问题，且必须至少难住两个前沿多模态模型才被收录；评分用原子化 rubric，同时给严格通过率和部分得分，特别检查答案是否建立在正确证据上。对多模态长文档模型、文档智能以及“grounding 失败但表面答对”这类对齐/评测问题有参考价值，但属于评测工作，不直接贡献预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: GDP.pdf 构建了 100 道题，覆盖 Finance、Healthcare、Legal、STEM/Research、Engineering、Construction、Manufacturing/Supply Chain、Insurance、Real Estate、HR 十个领域。每题包含原始 PDF、自然语言问题、专家参考答案、领域标签、能力轴标签和原子化 rubric。筛选流程：1）领域专家提交自己工作中真实会问的问题及源 PDF；2）多个前沿多模态模型尝试作答，至少两个模型出现实质性错误（答案实质错误、漏掉决定性证据、编造内容）才保留；3）过滤掉仅凭通用先验知识就能回答、不需要读 PDF 的题；4）每题打上 11 个能力轴标签，分三层：基础抽取与 grounding、结构与多模态理解、高级推理。评分采用两级指标：rubric score 对每个原子判据给 0/1 部分分；strict pass rate 要求所有 rubric 条目都满足才算通过，排序以 strict pass 为主，rubric score 用于细粒度错误分析。
summary.experiments: 对 7 个前沿多模态模型做了 pilot 评测。论文强调严格通过率非常低，说明现有模型在真实专业 PDF 任务上离实用还有明显距离；rubric score 则揭示模型往往能完成部分子任务，但在决定性证据定位、脚注/附录/修订条款等“fine print”上频繁失败。错误分析围绕 11 个能力轴展开，重点关注三类问题：文档结构复杂性（跨页表格、边栏、图例、脚注、末尾修订）、背景知识与文档内容的交互、以及“错误不显眼”的 groundedness 失败——模型引用了真实存在但与问题无关的条款或数字。具体绝对分数在正文描述中强调 strict pass 很罕见，但该版本仅含 100 题，规模小，定位是诊断性 pilot 而非覆盖性 leaderboard。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 对“分数高但真实任务不会做”的批评、benchmark 设计里的 adversarial screening 和 atomic rubric 评分协议、以及错误分析部分关于 grounding 失败的观察。如果关心文档 VLM 或 agent 在真实文件上的评测，可细看 capability taxonomy 和 rubric 设计示例。做基础预训练的读者可快速浏览，主要启发点是评测应如何捕捉“看起来对但证据错了”的失败模式。
summary.authors_note: Surge AI 团队发布。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing document AI benchmarks measure OCR, layout analysis, chart reasoning, table QA, and document VQA in isolation, so high scores do not predict whether a model can answer realistic questions about professional PDFs encountered in actual work; furthermore, failures on real PDFs are often not overt—the model cites a clause or number that does exist in the document, but it is not the decisive evidence, producing a plausible answer that is not properly grounded.
summary_en.importance: Fills an evaluation gap for grounded multimodal reasoning over real professional documents. The contribution is not scale but construction principle: every question is authored by working professionals across ten domains, and an item is included only if it defeats at least two frontier multimodal models. Scoring uses an atomic rubric that reports both a strict pass rate and partial credit, explicitly checking whether the response is anchored to the correct evidence. Relevant to researchers working on multimodal long-document models, document intelligence, and the broader problem of detecting grounding failures masked by superficially correct answers, though this is an evaluation contribution rather than a pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: GDP.pdf contains 100 question–document pairs spanning Finance, Healthcare, Legal, STEM/Research, Engineering, Construction, Manufacturing/Supply Chain, Insurance, Real Estate, and Human Resources. Each item includes the original PDF, a natural-language question, an expert reference answer, a domain label, capability-axis tags, and an expert rubric with atomic criteria. The construction pipeline is: (1) domain experts contribute questions from their actual workflows together with source PDFs; (2) several frontier multimodal models attempt each candidate, and an item is retained only if at least two models make a substantive failure (materially wrong answer, missed decisive evidence, or fabricated claim); (3) tasks answerable from general prior knowledge without reading the PDF are rejected; (4) each item is tagged against an 11-axis capability taxonomy organized into three tiers: foundational extraction and grounding, structural and multimodal comprehension, and advanced reasoning. Evaluation reports two metrics: a rubric score that gives partial 0/1 credit per atomic criterion, and a strict pass rate that requires every rubric element to be satisfied. Ranking is by strict pass rate, while rubric scores enable finer-grained error analysis.
summary_en.experiments: A pilot evaluation is run across seven frontier multimodal models. The paper highlights that strict pass rates are very low, indicating a substantial gap between current models and practical professional PDF workflows. Rubric scores show that models often succeed on partial sub-tasks but frequently fail to locate decisive evidence, especially in fine print such as footnotes, appendices, legends, plan symbols, and appended amendments. Error analysis is organized around the 11 capability axes, with emphasis on three recurring issues: structural complexity of real documents (multi-page tables, sidebars, legends, footnotes, amendments), interaction between domain background knowledge and document content, and non-obvious grounding failures where the model cites real but irrelevant clauses or numbers. The benchmark contains 100 items and is positioned as a diagnostic pilot rather than a large coverage leaderboard.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, about 15–25 minutes. Focus on the Introduction's critique of isolated academic benchmarks versus real document workflows, the adversarial item screening and atomic rubric design, and the error analysis on grounding failures. Readers interested in document VLM or agent evaluation over real files can look more closely at the capability taxonomy and rubric examples. Those focused on foundation pretraining can read quickly; the main takeaway is how evaluation can be designed to catch failures that look correct but rely on the wrong evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by the Surge AI team.

recommendation.zh: 专业文档多模态推理的高质量评测集，多模态基座预训练时可直接引入作为验证集，重点看§3筛选流程和评分标准。
recommendation.en: High-quality benchmark for professional document multimodal reasoning; can be used directly as validation set for multimodal base pretraining, focus on §3 filtering pipeline and rubric design.

paper.title: VEGAS: Human-Aligned Video Caption Evaluation via Gaze
paper.abstract: Vision-language models excel at video captioning, yet typically generate descriptions that fail to capture individual viewers' attention. We propose VEGAS (Video caption Evaluation via GAze Score), a training-free metric that leverages test-time gaze to sample personalized, attention-aligned text. It is a cross-modal, information-theoretic metric that quantifies how well a candidate caption matches a viewer's focus. To evaluate VEGAS, we curate a dataset of egocentric activities and instructiona

summary.core_problem: 现有视频字幕生成模型生成的字幕无法捕捉观众个体注意力，缺乏与人类注意力对齐的个性化视频字幕评测方法的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新（提出训练无关的眼动驱动的视频字幕评测指标VEGAS）+ 数据贡献（构建带同步眼动与参考标注的自我中心活动与教学幻灯片数据集），为多模态人类对齐评测提供了新的评测维度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VEGAS跨模态信息论评测指标，基于测试时观众眼动数据量化候选字幕与观众注意力的匹配度；通过拒绝采样选择对齐字幕，无需对字幕模型重训练。
summary.experiments: 构建了包含自我中心活动与教学幻灯片的配对数据集（带同步眼动与参考标注；实验表明VEGAS选择的字幕与人类注意力对齐度显著更高，提升了下游字幕到视频的检索性能。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video captioning models generate captions that fail to capture individual viewer attention, lacking a personalized video caption evaluation method aligned with human attention.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation (training-free gaze-driven video caption evaluation metric VEGAS) plus data contribution (dataset of egocentric activities and instructional slides paired with synchronized gaze and reference annotations), providing a new evaluation dimension for multimodal human alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose VEGAS, a cross-modal information-theoretic metric that quantifies the match between candidate captions and viewer focus using test-time gaze data; select aligned captions via rejection sampling without retraining the captioning model.
summary_en.experiments: Curate a dataset of egocentric activities and instructional slides paired with synchronized gaze and reference annotations; experiments show VEGAS-selected captions have significantly better alignment with human focus and improve downstream caption-to-video retrieval performance.

recommendation.zh: 视频字幕的眼动对齐评测思路可作为多模态人类对齐评测的参考，仅看§2的VEGAS指标定义和数据集构造即可。
recommendation.en: The gaze-aligned video caption evaluation approach serves as a reference for multimodal human-aligned evaluation; only read §2 VEGAS metric definition and dataset construction.

paper.title: UI2App: Benchmarking Visual Interaction Inference in Executable Web Application Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated growing competence in web page generation. However, existing text-driven approaches rely on complex prompts that impose substantial demands on users and offer limited expressivity for page layout and cross-page visual coherence. Image-driven paradigms, which take UI screenshots as input, align more closely with real development workflows. However, current benchmarks focus primarily on visual fidelity and lack a systematic evaluation of the interacti

summary.core_problem: 评测从 UI 截图生成可执行 Web 应用时，模型能否仅凭视觉状态推断跨页面交互行为，而不只是复刻静态外观。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 和 evaluation protocol。它把 screenshot-to-code / app generation 的评测从视觉相似度推进到 executability、navigation reachability、visual correctness 和 interaction behavior，更接近真实前端生成任务。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UI2App benchmark，包含 327 张截图，组织为 45 组状态一致的 multi-route web application。评测 pipeline 端到端运行生成产物，并从可执行性、导航可达性、视觉表现和交互恢复等维度打分。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体评测模型、baseline 名单和分数。可确认的是数据集规模为 327 screenshots / 45 screenshot sets，任务设置要求没有文本或行为指导，仅从截图恢复 runnable multi-route app。
summary.authors_note: 题目附注显示机构包含 Cohere。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates whether models can infer interactive behavior for executable web applications from UI screenshots alone, rather than merely reproducing static visual appearance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a benchmark and evaluation protocol. It shifts screenshot-to-code and app-generation evaluation from visual fidelity toward executability, navigation reachability, visual correctness, and interaction recovery, which is closer to real frontend generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: UI2App contains 327 screenshots grouped into 45 state-coherent screenshot sets for runnable multi-route web applications. The evaluation pipeline runs the generated artifacts end to end and scores executability, navigation reachability, visual quality, and inferred interaction behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names, baselines, or quantitative scores. The confirmed benchmark scale is 327 screenshots across 45 screenshot sets, with no textual or behavioral guidance given to the model.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided note identifies Cohere as a strong participating institution.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM-to-code 评测资产可备查；预训练研究员只看任务定义和四维指标，别被前端 benchmark 细节带偏。
recommendation.en: Useful as a VLM-to-code evaluation asset; for pretraining, read the task definition and four metrics, not the frontend benchmark details.

paper.title: Does It Fail to See or Fail to Know? Attributing Errors in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) perform well on visual question answering with high-quality images but struggle when questions require knowledge beyond what is clearly and directly visible. In such settings, uncertainty quantification should not only indicate whether the model is likely to fail but also diagnose why it is uncertain, across dimensions such as perception, entity recognition, and knowledge retrieval. While prior work has focused on individual failure modes in isolation or treated inc

summary.core_problem: 区分 VLM 回答错误到底来自视觉感知失败、实体识别失败，还是识别后仍缺乏外部知识，并研究这些失败源能否在生成前预测。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 失效机制分析和不确定性诊断框架。它不直接给出预训练方法，但对多模态模型 eval 和训练数据归因有价值：同样的错答可能需要完全不同的改进动作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出统一错误归因框架，把 VQA 类错误拆成 perception、entity recognition、knowledge retrieval 等维度，并分析 pre-generation signals 是否能预测失败来源。相比把错答视为单一失败，该方法更关注模型在 decode 前已有的内部或输入侧信号是否足以做诊断。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个数据集和模型家族上观察到一致模式：一部分错误来自视觉或识别瓶颈，另一部分在相关实体已识别后仍存在。核心结果是 recognition-related 和 knowledge-related failures 可在解码前被预测，但摘要未给出模型列表、指标和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The University of Melbourne。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper disentangles whether VLM failures come from visual perception, entity recognition, or knowledge retrieval after the entity is already identified, and asks whether these sources can be predicted before decoding.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a failure-analysis and uncertainty-diagnosis framework for VLMs. It does not propose a pretraining method, but it is useful for multimodal evaluation and data attribution because the same wrong answer can imply different fixes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a unified attribution framework that separates VQA errors into perception, entity-recognition, and knowledge-retrieval dimensions. They then test whether pre-generation signals can predict these failure sources, instead of treating all incorrect answers as one monolithic category.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple datasets and model families, the abstract reports a consistent pattern: some errors come from visual or recognition bottlenecks, while others persist after the relevant entity is recognized. The main result is that recognition-related and knowledge-related failures can be predicted before decoding, though the abstract does not give model names, metrics, or effect sizes.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with The University of Melbourne.

recommendation.zh: 读错误分解框架即可；它提醒 VLM 数据补齐不能只看错答率，要先分清看不见、认不出、还是不知道。
recommendation.en: Read the failure decomposition only; it is a useful reminder that VLM data fixes require separating not-seeing, not-recognizing, and not-knowing.

paper.title: Seeing Is Not Sharing: Some Vision-Language Models Overestimate Common Ground in Asymmetric Dialogue
paper.abstract: In collaborative dialogue, shared perception does not guarantee shared interpretation. Mutual understanding must be established through interaction. We investigate whether vision-language models (VLMs) can distinguish what could be shared from what has been shared between dialogue participants through grounding. We formulate this as an interpretation-matching task on 13,077 annotated reference expressions from HCRC MapTask dialogues, and evaluate VLMs under systematically controlled manipulation

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM 在非对称协作对话中能否区分“双方可能共享的信息”和“已经通过对话建立共同理解的信息”。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态理解与互动 grounding 分析。它不直接推进统一多模态预训练，但指出视觉内容可能诱发过度对齐判断，对 VLM 数据与评测设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将问题形式化为 interpretation-matching 任务，使用 HCRC MapTask 对话中的 13,077 条带标注指代表达。实验系统控制对话上下文和地图信息可见性，并比较真实地图图像、同内容文本描述和无信息图像对模型判断的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要称提供真实地图图像能提升总体性能，但会让模型更倾向于预测双方已经对齐；同样地图内容的文本描述也复现该偏差，而无信息图像会抑制对齐预测，说明偏差来自任务相关地图内容而非视觉通道本身。提升以非对齐样本准确率下降为代价。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Utrecht University；Albert Gatt 和 Massimo Poesio 在自然语言生成、指代与对话 grounding 方向有长期工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether VLMs can distinguish information that could be shared from information that has actually been grounded between participants in asymmetric dialogue.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal understanding and interaction-grounding analysis. It does not directly advance native multimodal pretraining, but it gives a useful signal for VLM data and evaluation design: task-relevant visual content can induce over-alignment predictions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate the problem as an interpretation-matching task using 13,077 annotated referring expressions from HCRC MapTask dialogues. They systematically manipulate dialogue context and map-information access, comparing authentic map images, textual descriptions of the same map content, and non-informative images.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that authentic map images improve overall performance but push models toward over-predicting alignment. Text descriptions of the same map content reproduce the bias, while non-informative images suppress alignment predictions, suggesting the bias comes from task-relevant map content rather than the visual channel. The gain comes at the cost of worse accuracy on non-aligned cases.
summary_en.authors_note: The institution is Utrecht University. Albert Gatt and Massimo Poesio have long-running work on natural language generation, reference, and dialogue grounding.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM grounding 负例知道即可；看实验操控设计，别把它当成多模态预训练能力结论。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a VLM grounding failure case; read the manipulation design, not as a claim about multimodal pretraining capability.

paper.title: Can OCR-VLMs Read Devanagari? A Stress-Test Benchmark and Post-Correction Study
paper.abstract: OCR systems, ranging from classical engines to specialised OCR vision-language models (OCR-VLMs) and frontier multimodal LLMs, report strong results on English and Chinese document benchmarks, yet their behaviour on Indic scripts is largely uncharacterised. We benchmark ten systems on Devanagari (Hindi): classical EasyOCR; open VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen3-VL-8B, olmOCR-7B); specialised OCR-VLMs (DeepSeek-OCR, Unlimited-OCR); and frontier closed models (Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5,

summary.core_problem: 评估 OCR-VLM 和前沿多模态模型在 Devanagari/Hindi 文档 OCR 上的鲁棒性，尤其是在退化扫描条件下的表现。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/OCR 评测资产和失效分析。它提醒多模态预训练不能只看英文和中文文档 OCR，高分干净合成集可能掩盖脚本和退化条件下的失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者测试十个系统，包括 EasyOCR、Qwen2.5-VL-3B、Qwen3-VL-8B、olmOCR-7B、DeepSeek-OCR、Unlimited-OCR，以及 Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.5、Mistral OCR。评测覆盖四种合成退化条件和 300 张真实印刷扫描，并分析后处理纠错。
summary.experiments: 在干净渲染文本上，十个系统 chrF++ 都在 91 到 98 之间，区分度很低；退化条件下专用 OCR-VLM 更脆弱。DeepSeek-OCR 的 median 最好，但会出现少数灾难性重复，输出长度最高达到参考文本的 71 倍，导致 corpus mean 严重恶化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates OCR-VLMs and frontier multimodal models on Devanagari/Hindi OCR, with emphasis on robustness under degraded document conditions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM/OCR evaluation and failure analysis. It shows that document OCR capability cannot be inferred from English/Chinese or clean synthetic benchmarks alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study benchmarks ten systems: EasyOCR, Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen3-VL-8B, olmOCR-7B, DeepSeek-OCR, Unlimited-OCR, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, and Mistral OCR. It uses four synthetic degradation settings, 300 real printed scans, and a post-correction analysis.
summary_en.experiments: On clean rendered text, all ten systems cluster between chrF++ 91 and 98, so the setting barely separates models. Under degradation, specialized OCR-VLMs are fragile; DeepSeek-OCR has the best median but rare catastrophic repetition failures up to 71 times the reference length, damaging the corpus mean.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 abstract 里的失效案例；对 VLM 预训练的信号是脚本覆盖和退化鲁棒性，比干净 OCR 分数更该进 eval。
recommendation.en: Read the failure cases in the abstract; the useful VLM-pretraining signal is script coverage and degradation robustness, not clean OCR scores.

paper.title: Illuminating Unified Multimodal Model for Free-form Interleaved Text-Image Generation
paper.abstract: The advancement of generative AI models capable of producing text and image marks a critical step forward in the realm of multimodal intelligence, particularly for tasks involving the interleaving of both modalities. To advance this intelligence to the next stage, it is crucial for models to autonomously generate free-form interleaved text-image sequences. In this paper, we introduce ILLUME-X, an advanced unified multimodal paradigm that enables high-quality, free-form interleaved text-image gen

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单纯的图像生成或图像理解，而是统一多模态模型如何稳定地生成自由长度、自由顺序的 text-image interleaving 序列。难点有三层：训练数据稀缺且格式杂，统一模型在文本自回归与图像生成目标之间容易互相干扰，评测上也缺少能衡量“跨模态连续性”的专门指标。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在统一建模接口，而不是某个单点模块。它把 interleaved multimodal generation 明确当成预训练范式问题来处理：数据怎么构、目标怎么混、注意力怎么设、训练如何分阶段稳定下来。这和 Transfusion、Chameleon、Janus 一类工作的关切一致。论文的贡献更偏系统整合，但其中关于 attention mask、progressive training、以及数据构造的做法，对原生多模态基座训练有现实参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一是数据管线。作者构建了约 100K 高质量 interleaved 样本，来源包括从视频中提取的真实交错序列，以及由多模态 LLM 合成的复杂场景数据。这里的目标不是单纯扩充图文对，而是让模型见到“文本—图像—文本—图像”这种真实切换结构，并覆盖 N-to-M 输入输出形式。

第二是统一架构与 interleaved attention。模型主体是 decoder-only Transformer，但不是把所有模态完全同构处理。视觉理解和视觉生成仍用不同的连续视觉编码器：ViT 提供语义特征，VAE 编码器提供低层视觉细节。Transformer 主干采用共享 self-attention，同时配 modality-specific 的 QKV 投影和 FFN，接近 mixture-of-transformers 一类设计。序列中显式插入 BOI、EOI、EOS 等控制 token。注意力掩码是核心：跨 segment 采用广义因果结构，当前 segment 可以看之前所有 segment；segment 内部则按模态区分，文本和控制 token 用 causal attention，视觉 token 用 bidirectional attention，以保留图像内部的整体空间建模能力。这一点说明作者没有强行把图像生成完全改写成纯 AR token prediction，而是保留了视觉块内的并行建模。

第三是训练目标与渐进式训练。文本和控制 token 用 CE，视觉生成部分用 rectified flow 风格的 MSE 目标。也就是说，这不是纯 AR，也不是纯 diffusion，而是统一 Transformer 上混合离散语言建模与连续视觉流匹配。作者还设计了 progressive training 和 self-adaptive objectives，用来逐步提升自由长度交错生成能力，并缓解多目标训练不稳定。正文里还提到对 noisy latent token 的排列与 mask 处理，用来减少噪声对后续样本生成的干扰，这属于训练稳定性上的细节修补。
summary.experiments: 实验主要验证三件事：一是 ILLUME-X 在 free-form interleaved generation 上优于已有统一多模态基线；二是数据管线和渐进式训练是否真的带来收益；三是 ILScore 这套评测能否更好地区分模型在跨模态连续性上的差异。论文声称在 interleaved benchmark 上超过先前方法，并展示更自然的文本—图像切换与更好的单模态质量。消融里，去掉高质量 interleaved 数据、去掉 specialized attention mask、或去掉 progressive/self-adaptive training，性能都会下降。对预训练研究者来说，最值得看的不是最终案例图，而是不同训练阶段和不同目标配比下的稳定性变化，以及模型是否在保留理解能力的同时获得生成能力。摘要里给出的数据规模是 100K interleaved samples，这个量级不算大，因此更应关注数据质量和结构设计，而不是把结果简单归因于数据量。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“数据—mask—目标”三步走。先看数据构造部分，弄清真实视频抽取序列和 MLLM 合成样本分别承担什么角色。再看 Figure 2 一类的架构与 attention mask 图，理解 segment 级因果、segment 内模态特化这套规则。最后看训练目标，特别是文本 CE 与视觉 rectified flow MSE 如何在同一 backbone 上共存。

如果时间有限，优先读方法和消融，30 分钟左右可以判断这套方案是否只是工程拼装。若继续深读，建议重点追问三件事：为什么视觉 token 采用 bidirectional attention 而不是统一 causal；progressive training 的阶段切换依据是什么；ILScore 是否真的比常规图文指标更能反映 interleaved generation 质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a specific unified multimodal modeling problem: how to train a single model to generate free-form interleaved text-image sequences with arbitrary length and modality order. The difficulty is not only architectural. Interleaved data are scarce and structurally messy, text autoregression and image generation objectives can interfere with each other, and standard evaluation does not capture whether the model maintains coherent cross-modal transitions.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining lies in the interface design for native multimodal modeling. The work treats interleaved generation as a pretraining problem: how to build the data, how to mix objectives, how to define attention patterns, and how to stabilize training across modalities. That places it in the same family of questions as Chameleon, Transfusion, Janus, and related unified models. The contribution is more system-level than algorithmically sharp, but the choices around data construction, attention masking, and progressive training are useful for anyone thinking about multimodal foundation training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The approach has three parts. First, a data pipeline builds around 100K high-quality interleaved samples. These include authentic interleaved sequences extracted from video and synthetic sequences produced by multimodal LLMs. The point is not just to enlarge image-text pairs, but to expose the model to actual modality switching patterns such as text-image-text-image and more general N-to-M mappings.

Second, the model uses a unified decoder-only Transformer with modality-aware components. Visual understanding and visual generation are still handled by different continuous encoders: a ViT for semantic features and a VAE encoder for low-level visual details. The Transformer backbone uses shared self-attention, while QKV projections and FFNs are modality-specific, similar in spirit to mixture-of-transformers designs. Special tokens such as BOI, EOI, and EOS mark modality boundaries. The attention mask is the key design choice: across segments, the model follows a generalized causal structure where the current segment can attend to all previous segments; within a segment, attention depends on modality, with causal attention for text/control tokens and bidirectional attention for vision tokens. This preserves holistic spatial modeling inside image segments instead of forcing everything into a pure autoregressive token stream.

Third, the training objective mixes language modeling and flow-based image generation. Text and control tokens are trained with cross-entropy, while vision generation uses a rectified-flow-style MSE objective. So the model is neither purely AR nor purely diffusion-like; it is a hybrid unified backbone with discrete text prediction and continuous visual flow matching. The paper also uses progressive training and self-adaptive objectives to improve stability and gradually build free-form interleaved generation ability. Additional masking around noisy latent tokens is introduced to reduce interference during generation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments aim to show three things: better free-form interleaved generation than prior unified multimodal baselines, measurable gains from the curated interleaved data and progressive training strategy, and the usefulness of the proposed ILScore evaluation protocol. The paper reports stronger benchmark performance and more coherent text-image alternation than earlier methods. The ablations are the most informative part: removing the curated interleaved data, the specialized attention mask, or the progressive/self-adaptive training setup degrades performance. For pretraining-oriented readers, the important question is not the showcase examples but whether the model can add generation ability without collapsing understanding quality, and how stable the mixed-objective training is across stages. Since the curated dataset is only about 100K samples, the structural quality of the data matters more than raw scale.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim order is data, mask, then objective. Start with the data construction section to understand the distinct roles of video-derived interleaved sequences and MLLM-synthesized samples. Then read the architecture and attention-mask figure carefully; the segment-level causal rule plus modality-specific intra-segment attention is the central design choice. Finally, read the training objective section to see how text CE and visual rectified-flow MSE coexist in one backbone.

If time is limited, the method and ablation sections are enough to judge whether the paper offers more than a stitched system, and that should take about 30 minutes. If reading more deeply, focus on three questions: why bidirectional attention is used for visual tokens instead of a fully causal stream, how the progressive training stages are scheduled, and whether ILScore captures interleaved quality better than standard text and image metrics.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和 ablation；若目标函数细节扎实，可直接影响内部图文交错预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; if the objective details are clean, they can feed directly into interleaved text-image pretraining recipes.

paper.title: Video-MME-Logical: A Controlled Diagnostic Benchmark for Video Temporal-Logical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent interest in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) raises a central question: can they reason over dynamic visual evidence rather than merely recognize objects or events in individual frames? This ability, which we refer to as video temporal-logical reasoning, requires models to maintain, update, and compose evidence as visual states evolve across frames. Existing video benchmarks often conflate this capability with scene complexity, static recognition, or uncontrolled temporal variatio

summary.core_problem: 评测多模态大模型是否能基于视频中随时间变化的视觉证据进行状态维护、更新和组合推理，而不只是识别单帧对象或事件。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是受控诊断 benchmark。它试图把视频时间-逻辑推理从场景复杂度、静态识别和未受控时间变化中分离出来，对判断视频 MLLM 的真实推理能力有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Video-MME-Logical，围绕五类 temporal-logical operation 构造评测：state tracking、sequential counting、temporal ordering、dynamic spatiality 和 structural composition。数据包含 25 个细粒度任务类别，通过受控对象状态、状态转移、时间依赖和逻辑组合来生成问题，并可通过调节 temporal horizon 与 reasoning composition 控制难度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出样本量、参评模型列表、得分表或模型失效模式。核心实验预计是对现有 MLLM/视频模型做 final-answer evaluation，并分析不同时间长度和组合复杂度下的性能退化。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Colab 和 Beihang University；未能从给定信息确认知名作者或该团队在视频 MLLM benchmark 方面的代表性系列工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal large language models can reason over evolving visual evidence in videos, rather than merely recognizing objects or events in isolated frames.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a controlled diagnostic benchmark. It tries to isolate video temporal-logical reasoning from scene complexity, static recognition, and uncontrolled temporal variation, which makes it useful for assessing video MLLM reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Video-MME-Logical is organized around five temporal-logical operations: state tracking, sequential counting, temporal ordering, dynamic spatiality, and structural composition. It includes 25 fine-grained task categories built from controlled object states, transitions, temporal dependencies, and logical compositions. Difficulty is controlled by varying temporal horizon and reasoning composition.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report dataset size, evaluated models, score tables, or failure modes. The intended evaluation appears to be final-answer testing of current MLLMs/video models, with analysis over temporal horizon and compositional difficulty.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Colab and Beihang University; no well-known authors or established video-MLLM benchmark track record can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和难度控制设计；若结果显示模型随 horizon 系统退化，可作为视频预训练 eval 备选。
recommendation.en: Read the task taxonomy and difficulty-control design; if scores degrade cleanly with horizon, it is a useful candidate eval for video pretraining.

paper.title: PerceptionRubrics: Calibrating Multimodal Evaluation to Human Perception
paper.abstract: We introduce PerceptionRubrics, a rubric-based evaluation framework that addresses the gap between saturated benchmark scores and real-world brittleness. Shifting evaluation from holistic semantic matching to rigorous atomic auditing, PerceptionRubrics pairs 1,038 information-dense images with over 12,000 instance-specific rubrics. These criteria are derived from golden captions constructed via a novel Circular Peer-Review consensus pipeline and then distilled into a dual-stream system of Must-R

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态评测分数饱和、却无法反映真实视觉感知脆弱性的问题，尤其是模型在密集图像中对关键事实的漏判与细节误判。
summary.importance: 这是评测方法与评测资产贡献。它不是再做一个泛泛 benchmark，而是把多模态评测从整体语义匹配改成基于原子事实和强约束的 rubric 审计，对 VLM 训练目标和数据质量诊断都有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PerceptionRubrics：先用 Circular Peer-Review 共识流程构造高质量 golden captions，再蒸馏成两类 rubric——Must-Right（必须正确的关键事实）和 Easy-Wrong（容易出错的细粒度细节）。评分上采用 Gated Scoring，不再线性平均，而是对关键事实错误施加近似二值惩罚，从而更接近人类对“关键事实错了就整体不可信”的判断。
summary.experiments: 数据包含 1,038 张信息密集图像和 12,000+ instance-specific rubrics。实验结论包括：模型在碎片化元素识别上可能得分不错，但在严格合取约束下明显失效；开放式问答不一定比封闭式设置更能揭示感知能力；现有高分模型在 dense visual auditing 下仍有明显 reliability gap。摘要未给出具体模型名单和数值，但评测设计本身比常见 caption/VQA 指标更有诊断性。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mismatch between saturated multimodal benchmark scores and real perceptual brittleness, especially failures on mandatory visual facts and fine-grained details in dense images.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method and dataset contribution. Rather than adding another generic benchmark, it reframes multimodal evaluation as atomic, rubric-based auditing with hard constraints, which is directly useful for diagnosing VLM objectives and data quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: PerceptionRubrics first builds high-quality golden captions through a Circular Peer-Review consensus pipeline, then distills them into two rubric streams: Must-Right facts and Easy-Wrong details. Scoring uses a gated mechanism instead of linear averaging, so missing mandatory facts incurs sharp penalties, better matching how humans treat critical factual errors.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,038 information-dense images and over 12,000 instance-specific rubrics. Reported findings include a reliability gap where models can verify fragments yet fail strict conjunctive constraints, and an open-vs-closed stratification result suggesting open-ended formats do not necessarily expose perceptual competence better. The abstract does not provide exact model rosters or margins, but the evaluation design is clearly more diagnostic than standard caption/VQA metrics.

recommendation.zh: 这类评测对预训练最有用的地方不是榜单，而是把“关键事实错一条就该重罚”写进协议；先看 rubric 设计和 gated scoring，能直接反推数据与 loss 该怎么改。
recommendation.en: The value here is not the leaderboard but the protocol: it operationalizes the idea that missing one mandatory fact should dominate the score; read the rubric design and gated scoring to rethink data curation and training losses.

paper.title: What We are Missing in Multimodal LLM Evaluation?
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can process diverse inputs, e.g., text, images, audio, and video, and generate textual responses. While their capabilities have advanced rapidly, evaluation of such models has not kept pace. Most existing evaluation benchmarks are limited to isolated tasks and reveal little about whether a model integrates information across modalities. We examine current means for evaluating MLLMs and review the existing benchmark taxonomy to identify gaps, including tem

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型（MLLM）评测多集中于孤立任务，无法衡量跨模态信息整合等核心能力，缺乏对评测体系缺口的系统梳理
summary.importance: 首次系统归纳MLLM评测的四大核心缺口，属于评测体系的原理分析贡献，为后续构建贴合真实多模态智能的基准指明方向
summary.technical_approach: 梳理现有MLLM评测的任务分类体系，从能力覆盖维度拆解现有评测的不足，归纳未被覆盖的关键能力维度
summary.experiments: 无定量实验与模型训练配置，为综述式的gap分析工作

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM evaluations focus mostly on isolated tasks and fail to measure core capabilities like cross-modal information integration, with no systematic review of evaluation paradigm gaps
summary_en.importance: Systematically identifies 4 key gaps in MLLM evaluation, an analytical contribution to evaluation methodology that guides future benchmark design aligned with real multimodal intelligence
summary_en.technical_approach: Reviews the taxonomy of existing MLLM evaluation benchmarks, decomposes their capability coverage, and summarizes uncatered critical capability dimensions
summary_en.experiments: No quantitative experiments or model training configurations; a review-style gap analysis work

recommendation.zh: 梳理多模态评测的四个核心缺口，做多模态预训练的研究员可快速过一遍gap清单，无需深读正文
recommendation.en: Catalogs 4 key gaps in MLLM evaluation; multimodal pretraining researchers can skim the gap list, no deep reading required

paper.title: Same Evidence, Different Answer: Auditing Order Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Standard benchmarks for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) score each item on one canonical ordering and miss whether order-irrelevant shuffling changes the answer, a baseline reliability property called for by emerging AI evaluation guidelines. We introduce Facet-Probe, a five-facet audit (option, evidence-chunk, document-rank, image-set, and mixed-modality ordering) of 18 frontier and open-weight MLLMs. A Bayesian item-response model separates ordering noise from per-facet bias, and a sa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究多模态大模型对输入顺序的敏感性：在证据内容不变、仅做语义上应当等价的重排时，模型是否会给出不同答案。作者指出，现有 benchmark 通常只在一个 canonical ordering 上打分，因此默认了“顺序无关”这个假设，却很少真正检验。论文要解决的核心问题不是再做一个多模态能力榜单，而是审计一种更基础的可靠性属性：同样的证据，换个排列，答案是否稳定。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义主要在评测与训练信号两端。评测端，这篇文章提醒人们，单次 canonical benchmark accuracy 可能系统性高估模型在 multimodal RAG、检索增强、agent 调度、临床界面等场景中的可靠性。训练端，它暴露出模型并没有学到真正稳健的证据聚合规则，而是部分依赖位置偏置、排序启发式或后验合理化。对于做 native multimodal pretrain、长上下文融合、跨模态对齐的人，这类顺序敏感性不是小毛病，而是表示学习和解码策略共同留下的偏差。论文的贡献主要是构建了一个较完整的审计框架，而不是提出新的训练方法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两个核心部件：Facet-Probe 审计框架，以及 ODI（Ordering-Decomposed Item-Response Theory）分解模型。

Facet-Probe 把“顺序”拆成五个 facet 来测：选项顺序、证据块顺序、文档排名顺序、图像集合顺序、以及混合模态顺序。这个设计比只测 option-order 更完整，因为多模态系统里的顺序来源很多：检索器返回的文档顺序、图像拼接顺序、文本与图像交错顺序，都可能影响答案。作者在 12 个数据集、4 类任务上对 18 个 MLLM 做了大规模试验，试图覆盖从 MCQ reasoning 到多证据聚合的不同场景。

ODI 的作用是把 observed flip rate 拆开。作者认为，模型在不同顺序下答案变化，既可能来自真正的 ordering bias，也可能只是解码随机性或边界不稳定。为此他们引入一个 2PL Bayesian IRT 风格的分解，把每个 item 的 ordering noise 与每个 facet 的系统性偏置分开估计。这里一个关键设计是 same-ordering control：对完全相同输入重复解码，用它估计 decoder stochastic floor，再看真正换顺序后多出来多少 flip。这个控制很重要，否则“顺序敏感”里会混入大量普通采样噪声。

作者还做了机制分析和 mitigation 测试。机制上，文中提到一个常见失败模式是 content rationalization：模型先被顺序牵引到某个答案，再事后围绕当前顺序中的显著证据编造看似合理的解释。缓解上，他们测试了 training-free prompt 改写，但发现这些方法是 modality-conditional 的，在文本任务上有效的提示，不一定能迁移到视觉推理或混合模态场景，也很难叠加组合。
summary.experiments:
实验规模比较大：18 个模型，包含 6 个闭源前沿模型和 12 个开源模型；12 个数据集；总试验数超过 40 万。模型覆盖 Gemini、Claude、ChatGPT，以及 Qwen3.5-VL、InternVL3.5、Kimi-VL、MedGemma 等家族。闭源模型尽量用温度 0 或接近的确定性设置，开源模型用 greedy decoding，以减少把解码噪声误判为顺序效应。

核心结果有几条。第一，没有任何一个被测 MLLM 真正顺序不变。筛选后的各 facet 平均 flip rate 在 24% 到 50% 之间；即便是表现最好的模型，仍有 13.4% 的 trial 会因顺序变化而翻转答案。第二，能力强的模型通常更稳，文中给出 capability 与 flip rate 的 Spearman 相关约为 -0.95，但能力提升并不能消除这个问题，只能降低其频率。第三，模型自报置信度明显低估顺序风险，低估幅度达到 9 到 62 个百分点，说明 calibration 并不能替代顺序鲁棒性审计。第四，在 Gemini 的 same-ordering control 中，即使温度设为 0，真实换序带来的 flip 仍显著高于同输入重复解码的噪声底线，支持“顺序效应是真实存在的系统偏差”这一结论。第五，prompt-level mitigation 有一定效果，但高度依赖模态和任务，不具备统一迁移性。

如果从全文里抓重点，建议特别关注各 facet 的差异，而不是只看总体 flip rate。因为 option-order、document-rank、image-set ordering 背后的机制并不一样，对训练改进的指向也不同。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合当评测方法论文来读。先看 Introduction 和方法总览，明确作者不是在讨论一般 prompt sensitivity，而是在讨论语义等价重排下的 order invariance。然后直接看 Facet-Probe 的五个 facet 定义，理解每一种顺序扰动对应什么真实系统场景。

接着看 ODI 和 same-ordering control。这里是全文最值得细读的部分，因为它决定了结果是否可信。重点看作者如何区分 ordering noise、systematic bias 和 decoder stochastic floor；如果只看 flip rate 而不看这个分解，很容易高估或误解问题。

实验部分建议先看总表，再看 capability vs. flip 的相关图、same-ordering control 图，以及 mechanism analysis。若你关心训练改进，可以重点看 mitigation 小节，但不要期待现成 recipe；作者的结论更像是“简单 prompt 修补不够，问题更深”。

泛读大约 30–40 分钟可以抓住主线；如果你做多模态检索、长上下文融合或 benchmark 设计，建议把附录里的 prompt 适配、数据筛选和 exploratory claim 的限定条件也一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits order sensitivity in multimodal LLMs: when the evidence is unchanged but presented in semantically equivalent permutations, does the answer remain stable? The central problem is not to build another capability leaderboard, but to test a basic reliability property that current benchmarks usually assume rather than verify. Standard multimodal evaluations score one canonical ordering and implicitly treat all equivalent permutations as interchangeable. This work asks whether that assumption actually holds.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance is on the evaluation side, with implications for training. For evaluation, it shows that canonical benchmark accuracy can systematically overstate reliability in multimodal RAG, retrieval pipelines, agent tool scheduling, and high-stakes interfaces where users expect the same evidence to yield the same answer. For training and representation learning, the findings suggest that many MLLMs have not learned robust evidence aggregation rules; instead, they still rely partly on positional bias, ranking heuristics, or post-hoc rationalization. For researchers working on native multimodal pretraining, long-context fusion, or cross-modal alignment, this is not a cosmetic issue. It points to a mismatch between nominal task competence and invariance properties that a well-behaved model should satisfy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components: Facet-Probe and ODI.

Facet-Probe is a five-facet audit of ordering effects: option order, evidence-chunk order, document-rank order, image-set order, and mixed-modality order. This is a stronger design than prior work that only studies one ordering axis, because real multimodal systems inherit ordering from many sources: retrieval rank, chunk packing, image arrangement, and interleaving of text and visual evidence. The benchmark spans 12 datasets and four task families, aiming to cover both standard multiple-choice reasoning and multi-evidence aggregation settings.

ODI, or Ordering-Decomposed Item-Response Theory, is the statistical layer that separates different sources of answer flips. The authors argue that observed answer changes across permutations can come from true ordering bias, but also from decoder stochasticity or fragile decision boundaries. To disentangle these, they use a Bayesian 2PL IRT-style decomposition that estimates per-item ordering noise and per-facet systematic bias. A key design choice is the same-ordering control: the exact same input is decoded multiple times to estimate the stochastic floor, and only the excess flip rate under actual reordering is attributed to ordering effects. This control is essential; without it, raw flip rates are hard to interpret.

The paper also includes mechanism analysis and mitigation tests.
