One recurring mechanism is content rationalization: the model is nudged toward an answer by the ordering, then generates a plausible explanation around whichever evidence appears salient in that arrangement. For mitigation, the authors test training-free prompt modifications, but find that these are modality-conditional. A prompt trick that helps text-heavy settings does not necessarily transfer to visual reasoning or mixed-modality tasks, and different mitigations do not compose cleanly.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical study is large: 18 models, including 6 frontier closed-source systems and 12 open-weight models; 12 datasets; and more than 400,000 trials. The model set includes Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT variants, along with Qwen3.5-VL, InternVL3.5, Kimi-VL, and MedGemma families. Closed models are queried with temperature 0 where possible, and open models are greedily decoded, specifically to reduce the chance of mistaking ordinary decoding randomness for ordering effects.

Several findings stand out. First, none of the audited MLLMs is order-invariant. Screened panel-mean flip rates across facets range from 24% to 50%, and even the best model still flips on 13.4% of trials. Second, stronger models are generally more stable, with a reported Spearman correlation of about -0.95 between capability and flip rate, but capability does not eliminate the issue. Third, self-reported confidence substantially underestimates ordering risk, by 9 to 62 percentage points, so calibration alone is not a sufficient reliability signal. Fourth, the same-ordering control on Gemini shows that even at temperature 0, the excess flips under reordered inputs remain well above the same-input stochastic floor, supporting the claim that the effect is a real systematic bias rather than just decoder noise. Fifth, prompt-level mitigations can help, but only in a modality- and task-specific way.

When reading the results, it is more useful to compare the five facets than to focus only on the overall flip rate, because option-order, document-rank, and image-set sensitivity likely arise from different mechanisms and imply different remedies.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as an evaluation-method paper rather than a modeling paper. Start with the introduction and the high-level setup to understand that the target is order invariance under semantically equivalent permutations, not generic prompt sensitivity.

Then go straight to the definition of the five Facet-Probe axes. Each facet corresponds to a realistic source of ordering in deployed systems, and understanding those mappings helps interpret the results.

Next, read the ODI section carefully. This is the most important technical part because it determines whether the reported instability is actually attributable to ordering. Focus on how the paper separates ordering noise, systematic bias, and the decoder stochastic floor. Raw flip rates without this decomposition would be much less convincing.

In the experiments, first scan the main summary tables, then read the capability-versus-flip correlation plots, the same-ordering control results, and the mechanism analysis. If you care about practical fixes, read the mitigation section, but the main lesson is not a ready-made recipe; it is that shallow prompt repairs do not solve the deeper invariance problem.

A 30–40 minute pass should be enough for the main ideas. If you work on multimodal retrieval, long-context fusion, or benchmark design, the appendix details on prompt adapters, dataset screening, and exploratory claims are also worth reading.

recommendation.zh: 这不是预训练论文，但它把“顺序扰动”从评测噪声变成了可测失效模式；做多模态 pretrain 的人至少该看方法和主表，别再默认 shuffle 无害。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it turns order sensitivity from vague eval noise into a measurable failure mode; if you train MLLMs, read the method and main table before assuming shuffling is harmless.

paper.title: Evaluating Japanese Dialect Robustness Across Speech and Text-based Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Dialogue systems based on large language models (LLMs) have advanced significantly in recent years. However, dialectal variation remains a major challenge, particularly for systems that process spoken input. LLM-based speech language models (SLMs), which integrate LLMs with speech processing components, show promise for spoken language tasks, yet their ability to comprehend dialects has not been sufficiently studied. Moreover, it remains unclear how the dialectal understanding of the base LLM af

summary.core_problem: 针对文本LLM与语音LLM（SLM）的方言鲁棒性缺乏系统公平评估、且SLM鲁棒性与底层文本LLM的关联不明确的问题。
summary.importance: 实证分析类贡献，提出了跨文本/语音LLM的方言鲁棒性公平度量方法，明确了日语方言语境下SLM鲁棒性与底层文本LLM鲁棒性的正相关关系。
summary.technical_approach: 定义鲁棒性为「方言输入性能/标准输入性能」的比值以消除任务难度干扰；分别测试纯文本LLM、接入语音编码器的SLM在日语标准语/方言输入下的性能，对比方言数据训练、语音编码器微调两种策略的效果。
summary.experiments: 未明确披露模型参数量与训练数据规模；以日语方言为测试集，基线为未做方言适配的文本LLM与SLM；验证了SLM鲁棒性与文本LLM正相关，方言数据训练、语音编码器微调均提升SLM鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the lack of systematic, fair evaluation of dialect robustness for text LLMs and Speech LLMs (SLMs), and the unclear correlation between SLM robustness and that of their underlying text LLMs.
summary_en.importance: Empirical analysis contribution; proposes a fair cross-modal dialect robustness metric, and verifies the positive correlation between SLM and text LLM robustness in the Japanese dialect scenario.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines robustness as the ratio of performance on dialect inputs to standard inputs to eliminate task difficulty bias; evaluates text-only LLMs and SLMs (pre-trained speech encoder + LLM) on Japanese standard/dialect inputs, and ablates two improvement strategies: dialect data training and speech encoder fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Model parameters and training data size are not explicitly disclosed; uses Japanese dialect as the test case, with baselines being non-dialect-adapted text LLMs and SLMs; verifies the positive robustness correlation and the effectiveness of the two adaptation strategies.

recommendation.zh: 仅针对日语方言的实证，结论普适性弱，若做多语种语音LLM适配可快速扫过实验部分即可。
recommendation.en: Japanese dialect-only empirical study with weak generalizability; skim the experiment section only if working on multilingual Speech LLM adaptation.

paper.title: LaViSA: A Language and Vision Structural Ambiguity Benchmark
paper.abstract: Structural ambiguity arises when a single sentence admits multiple valid interpretations due to its syntactic structure, posing a fundamental challenge for language understanding. Visual scenes serve as useful cues for resolving such ambiguity, and Vision and Language Models (VLMs) need to be capable of deriving possible semantic interpretations from visual scenes. We introduce Language and Vision Structural Ambiguity (LaViSA), a benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of VLMs to resolve stru

summary.core_problem: 评测 VLM 是否能借助图像消解句法结构歧义，而不是只做表层图文匹配。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测贡献。结构歧义是语言理解里的老问题，但在 VLM 里常被更粗粒度的 caption/QA 指标掩盖。把“同一句话对应多种合法语义解析”显式做成图文基准，有助于检查模型到底有没有把视觉证据接到语言组合结构上。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LaViSA 基准，包含歧义句、对应的去歧义句，以及与不同解释对应的图像，覆盖七类结构歧义。作者用该基准系统评测多种闭源和开源 VLM，比较参数规模与推理能力差异，观察模型在视觉辅助下选择正确语义解释的能力边界。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整数据规模与具体模型清单，但说明覆盖多类 VLM、不同参数规模和是否具备 reasoning 能力的模型。结论是：近期 VLM 能在一定程度上利用视觉线索做消歧，但在更细粒度、结构性更强的歧义类型上仍明显不足，说明当前多模态对齐并未稳定学到组合式语义解析。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自奈良先端科学技术大学院大学、RIKEN Guardian Robot Project 和大阪大学。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether VLMs can use visual evidence to resolve syntactic structural ambiguity, rather than relying on shallow image-text matching.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. Structural ambiguity is a classic language understanding problem, but standard VLM benchmarks often hide it behind coarse captioning or QA metrics. Turning it into an explicit vision-language benchmark probes whether models actually connect visual grounding to compositional linguistic structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces LaViSA, a benchmark with ambiguous sentences, their disambiguated counterparts, and images corresponding to different valid interpretations, spanning seven ambiguity categories. It then evaluates a range of proprietary and open-source VLMs across scales and reasoning profiles to measure visual disambiguation ability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full dataset size or a complete model list, but it states that the evaluation covers diverse VLMs with varying parameter scales and reasoning capabilities. The main finding is that recent VLMs can leverage visual scenes to some extent, yet still struggle on finer-grained and structurally demanding ambiguity cases, suggesting current multimodal alignment does not robustly capture compositional semantic parsing.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from NAIST, RIKEN Guardian Robot Project, and The University of Osaka.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练的人可以把它当 stress test 备查；不改方法论，但能提醒你现有 VLM 可能只是学会了图文共现，没真接上句法组合性。
recommendation.en: Useful as a stress-test reference for multimodal pretraining: it likely won’t change your recipe, but it is a clean reminder that many VLMs may still ride on co-occurrence instead of grounded compositional syntax.

institutions: Nara Institute of Science and Technology

paper.title: ROSE: Benchmarking the Perception-to-Action Gap in Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected to act on visual information, yet the same scene may require different actions under different task contexts. How reliably can a model turn the same visual evidence into the action required by the current context? To answer this question, we introduce \textsc{ROSE} (\textbf{R}eference-conditioned \textbf{O}ddity and \textbf{S}ymbolic \textbf{E}xecution), a controlled benchmark that holds the visual scene fixed while varying regio

summary.core_problem: 评测多模态模型能否在视觉证据不变、任务语境变化时，把感知结果稳定地转成正确动作。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。它不再只测“看见了没有”，而是测“在不同任务约束下能不能把同一视觉输入映射成不同正确动作”，这对多模态 agent 和视觉-语言接口评估是有意义的。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ROSE 基准，通过固定场景、改变区域约束与符号输出要求，构造 coupled counting 与 coordinate-action 任务，专门测 perception-to-action gap。设计上强调控制变量：视觉场景相同，只改任务上下文，因此更容易把错误归因到动作映射而非感知失败。
summary.experiments: 在 9 个近期 MLLM 上测试，论文称从计数任务到区域条件动作任务，性能最高下降 44.5 个百分点，而人类可达 98.8%。结果说明不少模型在“看懂”与“按上下文行动”之间存在明显断层。未见与预训练配方、数据或架构的直接联动分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal models can reliably convert the same visual evidence into different correct actions when task context changes.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark. Instead of only testing perception, it isolates the perception-to-action interface under controlled context shifts, which is relevant for multimodal agents and action-grounded MLLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: ROSE fixes the visual scene while varying region constraints and symbolic output requirements, creating paired counting and coordinate-action tasks. This controlled design makes it easier to attribute failures to action mapping rather than raw perception.
summary_en.experiments: Across nine recent MLLMs, the paper reports drops of up to 44.5 percentage points from counting-oriented tasks to region-conditioned action, while humans reach 98.8%. The result suggests a substantial gap between seeing and acting, though the paper does not directly connect this to pretraining recipes or architecture choices.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的评测切口：把视觉理解和动作映射拆开测；预训练研究员只需看任务构造和误差分解，不必细读全篇。
recommendation.en: A clean benchmark slice: it separates visual understanding from action mapping; for pretraining folks, the task design and failure decomposition are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models on Fine-Grained Image Tasks: From Evaluation to Diagnosis
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal perception and reasoning capabilities. While numerous benchmarks have evaluated LVLMs from holistic or task-specific perspectives, their capabilities on fine-grained image tasks-fundamental to computer vision-remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we introduce FG-BMK, a comprehensive fine-grained evaluation benchmark containing 1.01 million questions and 0.28 million images, coveri

summary.core_problem: 现有 LVLM 评测大多关注通用问答或粗粒度能力，缺少对细粒度图像理解能力的系统诊断；这篇工作试图建立一个能区分“视觉表征不足、视觉到语义映射薄弱、还是细粒度知识缺失”的评测框架。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是 benchmark 与诊断协议。对预训练研究员的价值在于：如果你在做原生多模态预训练、视觉 tokenizer、图文对齐或 unified multimodal model，这类细粒度失败模式比通用 VQA 分数更接近真正的表征瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 FG-BMK，包含 101 万问题和 28 万图像，覆盖常见物体域到专业域。评测同时包含 dialogue-level 的细粒度语义识别，以及 feature-level 的视觉可分辨性测试；并通过 human-oriented 与 machine-oriented 两种范式，诊断失败究竟来自视觉 backbone/encoder 表征、跨模态 grounding，还是知识层面的缺口。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在一组代表性 LVLM/VLM 上做了大规模评测与诊断，但未在摘要中给出具体模型名单、参数规模、领先模型、或量化差距。已知资产规模较大，适合作为后续多模态预训练模型的分析基准，而不是方法论文去追单点提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表中包含 Serge Belongie。若正文机构信息无误，这通常意味着该工作在视觉识别与细粒度理解评测上有较强背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LVLM evaluations mostly emphasize generic QA or coarse-grained capabilities, leaving fine-grained image understanding poorly characterized. This work aims to build an evaluation framework that can disentangle failures due to weak visual representations, poor visual-semantic grounding, or missing fine-grained knowledge.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark plus diagnostic protocol. For pretraining researchers, the value is that if you work on native multimodal pretraining, visual tokenization, image-text alignment, or unified multimodal models, these fine-grained failure modes are often closer to the real representation bottlenecks than generic VQA scores.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces FG-BMK, with 1.01M questions and 0.28M images spanning common object-centric domains and specialized domains. It jointly evaluates dialogue-level fine-grained semantic recognition and feature-level visual discriminability, under both human-oriented and machine-oriented settings, to diagnose whether failures come from the visual encoder, cross-modal grounding, or knowledge limitations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the benchmark is used to evaluate a diverse set of representative LVLMs/VLMs at scale, but does not provide exact model names, parameter counts, top performers, or quantitative gaps. The asset is large enough to matter as an analysis benchmark rather than a method paper chasing a narrow gain.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Serge Belongie. If the affiliation details in the paper confirm it, that usually signals strong background in visual recognition and fine-grained evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做多模态预训练，只看 benchmark 设计和 failure taxonomy 就够了；正文大概率偏评测堆表，不必逐项细读。
recommendation.en: If you work on multimodal pretraining, read the benchmark design and failure taxonomy only; the rest is likely mostly leaderboard-style evaluation.

paper.title: Beyond the Current Observation: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Controllable Non-Markov Games
paper.abstract: Deploying multimodal foundation models as closed-loop policies increasingly requires conditioning actions on observations that are no longer visible. However, existing benchmarks either expose the full state, conflate hidden-state reconstruction with other agent skills, or test recall only after an episode has ended. We introduce RNG-Bench (Reconstructive Non-Markov Games), a benchmark suite designed to isolate a base model's ability to reconstruct past observations and act on them during multi-

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态大模型在非马尔可夫交互环境中，能否记住已经消失的视觉观察，并在后续动作中正确使用这些记忆。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测基准。它把“过去观察重构”从规划、工具使用、语言推理等能力中拆出来，适合检查 VLM/MLLM 作为闭环策略时的短期视觉记忆与空间整合能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RNG-Bench，包括 Matching Pairs 和 3D Maze 两类可控游戏。前者要求模型记住短暂翻开的卡牌身份与位置，后者要求模型把第一视角观察整合成空间地图。基准使用统一交互 harness，并控制网格大小、视觉图案、观察模态三个难度轴；还引入 head-to-head duel protocol 来降低实例差异带来的噪声，并设计 Memory Gap 相关度量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体评测模型列表、参数规模、样本量或提升数字。可确认的是实验围绕两类非马尔可夫游戏展开，目标是比较多模态基础模型在不同难度、模态和隐藏状态需求下的闭环表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自复旦大学、上海创新研究院、上海人工智能实验室、浙江大学和香港中文大学。Dahua Lin、Jiaqi Wang 所在团队长期参与 OpenMMLab、多模态模型与评测体系建设；Haodong Duan 参与过多模态评测相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal large language models can reconstruct no-longer-visible observations and use that memory for actions in non-Markov interactive environments.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It isolates past-observation reconstruction from broader skills such as planning, language reasoning, and tool use, making it useful for probing visual memory and spatial integration in MLLMs used as closed-loop policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce RNG-Bench, built around two controllable games: Matching Pairs, where card identities are briefly revealed and must later be recalled by location, and 3D Maze, where egocentric observations must be integrated into a spatial map. The suite uses a unified interaction harness with three difficulty axes—grid size, visual pattern, and observation modality—and adds a head-to-head duel protocol to control instance-level variance, together with a Memory Gap-style metric.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the exact evaluated model list, model sizes, dataset size, or numerical results. The confirmed setup evaluates multimodal foundation models across two non-Markov games under controlled difficulty and modality conditions.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Fudan University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Zhejiang University, and The Chinese University of Hong Kong. Dahua Lin and Jiaqi Wang are associated with teams known for OpenMMLab and multimodal model/evaluation work; Haodong Duan has contributed to multimodal evaluation work.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM agent 记忆评测备查即可；看任务设计和 duel protocol，别把分数当预训练能力结论。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for VLM-agent memory evaluation; read the task design and duel protocol, but do not overread scores as pretraining capability evidence.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Vision-language models for chest radiography do not always need the image
paper.abstract: Medical vision-language models report strong chest radiograph accuracy, and this is increasingly read as evidence that they use the image. That inference is unsafe: a model exploiting finding-name priors scores like one that reads the scan, and no standard benchmark separates them. We introduce a causal audit that intervenes on the image, occluding the relevant region, occluding an irrelevant one, and swapping in another patient's same-label scan, and combines three behavioral metrics to test wh

summary.core_problem: 医学VLM报告高精度但无法确定是否真正使用图像信息，还是仅利用文本先验（病名频率等），现有benchmark无法区分这两种情况。
summary.importance: 方法论创新，首次提出针对VLM图像依赖性的因果审计框架，对多模态模型评估方法有启示。
summary.technical_approach: 引入因果审计：三种图像干预（遮挡相关区域、遮挡无关区域、交换其他患者同标签图像）+三个行为指标，测试正确答案是否依赖于图像。
summary.experiments: 测试9个系统：无图像访问的text-only模型与最好多模态模型差距仅5.7精度点；119B多模态模型与7B text-only基线在统计上无法区分。识别出3个完全忽略图像的模型、1个不稳定模型、5个选择性使用图像的模型。

summary_en.core_problem: Medical VLMs report high accuracy but it is unclear whether they truly use image information or merely exploit text priors (finding-name frequencies); no standard benchmark separates them.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; first causal audit framework for testing image dependency in VLMs, with implications for multimodal model evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces causal audit with three image interventions (occlude relevant region, occlude irrelevant region, swap in another patient's same-label scan) + three behavioral metrics to test whether correct answers depend on the image.
summary_en.experiments: Across 9 systems: text-only model with no image access reaches within 5.7 accuracy points of the best multimodal model; a 119B multimodal model is statistically indistinguishable from a 7B text-only baseline. Identifies 3 image-ignoring models, 1 unstable model, 5 selectively image-using models.

recommendation.zh: 因果审计方法对验证VLM是否真正使用图像有启示，但属于医学影像特定领域，仅作方法论参考。
recommendation.en: Causal audit approach is instructive for verifying whether VLMs actually use images, but it is medical imaging domain-specific; methodological reference only.

paper.title: Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in learning generalist robot policies from large-scale multimodal data. However, most existing VLA systems are trained and evaluated primarily with English instructions, leaving their ability to understand and execute instructions in other languages largely unexplored. While the underlying large language models often possess multilingual capabilities, it remains unclear whether these multilingual capabilities transfe

summary.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action 模型多数用英语指令训练和评估，尚不清楚底层 LLM 的多语言能力是否能迁移到机器人动作策略中。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLA 多语言能力的系统评估。它指出 native multimodal / action 训练可能损伤或遮蔽 LLM backbone 原有的跨语言能力；对多模态统一预训练有旁证价值，但机器人任务本身离文本基座训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 将现有 VLA benchmark 的英语指令翻译成多语言版本，并在仿真任务中评估多个代表性 VLA 模型。核心是 controlled instruction translation + cross-language performance comparison，用来测量英语训练模型在非英语指令下的执行退化。
summary.experiments: 摘要称覆盖多个代表性 VLA 模型和一系列仿真任务，发现主要用英语训练的模型存在显著 multilingual gap：即便底层 LLM 具备多语言能力，VLA 训练后也不能可靠迁移到非英语指令执行。具体模型列表、语言覆盖和退化幅度需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beijing Jiaotong University。

summary_en.core_problem: Most Vision-Language-Action models are trained and evaluated with English instructions, and it is unclear whether the multilingual ability of the underlying LLM transfers to robotic action policies.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systematic evaluation of multilingual VLA behavior. It suggests that native multimodal and action training can damage or obscure the cross-lingual abilities of the LLM backbone. This is relevant as indirect evidence for multimodal pretraining, though the robotics setting is not central to text foundation-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper extends existing VLA benchmarks by translating English instructions into multiple languages, then evaluates representative VLA models in simulation. The core setup is controlled instruction translation plus cross-language performance comparison to measure degradation under non-English instructions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluation across several representative VLA models and simulation tasks. Models trained mainly on English show a substantial multilingual gap: multilingual capability in the LLM backbone does not reliably transfer to non-English instruction execution after VLA training. Exact model names, language coverage, and degradation numbers require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Beijing Jiaotong University.

recommendation.zh: 知道这个 failure mode 即可；若做多模态预训练，只需看语言退化表，不必深读机器人细节。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a failure mode; for multimodal pretraining, read the language-degradation table and skip most robotics details.

paper.title: Reasoning for Mobile User Experience with Multimodal LLMs: Task, Benchmark, and Approach
paper.abstract: User experience (UX) centered on usability, perceived consistency, and functional clarity is fundamental to real-world user interfaces (UI). The application of   multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in the field of user interfaces is evolving rapidly, such as visual element grounding, graphical user interface (GUI)   agents, and design-to-code generation. However, research efforts on evaluating UX based on UI screenshots are still immature. To address this, we propose UXBench,   a novel mult

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态大模型是否能仅基于移动端 UI 截图推理用户体验问题，包括布局关系、视觉层级和内容一致性。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 Benchmark。UXBench 把 UI/UX 诊断从元素定位、GUI 操作扩展到更细粒度的体验推理，对 VLM 和 GUI agent 的评测覆盖有一定补充，但离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 2,000 条 VQA 样本，覆盖 8 类基于真实移动端截图的 UX 推理任务。任务要求模型识别可用性、视觉一致性、功能清晰度等问题，而不是只做 OCR 或控件定位。
summary.experiments: 评测主流多模态大模型，结论是现有 MLLM 在 UI-based reasoning 上仍有明显限制。摘要未给出完整模型列表、标注流程、人工一致性或各任务细分分数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal LLMs can reason about mobile UI user-experience issues from screenshots, including layout relations, visual hierarchy, and content consistency.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark. UXBench extends UI evaluation beyond grounding and GUI control toward UX diagnosis, which is useful for VLM and GUI-agent evaluation but only weakly connected to foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It builds 2,000 VQA samples across 8 task types from real mobile UI screenshots. The tasks require models to diagnose usability, visual consistency, and functional clarity rather than merely perform OCR or element localization.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate mainstream MLLMs and report that current models remain limited in UI-based reasoning. The abstract does not provide the full model list, annotation protocol, inter-annotator agreement, or detailed per-task scores.

recommendation.zh: 作为 GUI/VLM 评测资产知道即可；若做 native multimodal pretrain，只看任务 taxonomy 和错误类型。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a GUI/VLM evaluation asset; for native multimodal pretraining, only inspect the task taxonomy and failure modes.

paper.title: RAIL: Rethinking Auditory Intelligence in Large Audio-Language Models with a CHC-Grounded Benchmark
paper.abstract: Humans process rich auditory environments through tightly integrated cognitive capabilities such as audio perception, audio reasoning, and memory. Despite recent progress in large audio-language models (LALMs) across speech understanding and multimodal audio reasoning, current evaluation paradigms remain largely task- or modality-centric, focusing on end performance while overlooking underlying auditory cognitive behaviours. This reveals a fundamental gap between how auditory cognition is unders

summary.core_problem: 现有 large audio-language model 评测多按任务或模态给分，难以刻画模型是否具备类似人类的听觉感知、推理和记忆能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 与 evaluation protocol。RAIL 用 CHC 认知框架重构音频语言模型评测，把听觉智能拆成多个认知能力维度，这对音频 LM 和统一多模态预训练的能力诊断有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RAIL 评测范式，基于 Cattell-Horn-Carroll 认知理论，将 auditory cognition 形式化为五类核心能力，并设计结构化任务来测试模型如何处理、保持和整合声音信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出被评测模型、样本规模和具体排名；可以确认的是它面向 LALMs，覆盖 speech understanding 与 multimodal audio reasoning 之外的认知行为评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Current large audio-language model evaluations are mostly task- or modality-centric and do not directly measure auditory perception, reasoning, and memory as cognitive behaviors.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. RAIL grounds audio-language evaluation in the CHC cognitive framework, which is useful for diagnosing audio LMs and unified multimodal pretraining systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: RAIL formalizes auditory cognition into five core capabilities using the Cattell-Horn-Carroll theory and turns them into structured tasks that probe how models process, retain, and integrate auditory information.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the evaluated model list, dataset size, or numerical results. It states that the benchmark targets LALMs and goes beyond speech understanding and task-level multimodal audio reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 适合看任务分解表，不必迷信总分；音频 LM 预训练更需要这种能力轴而非 ASR 式指标。
recommendation.en: Read the capability taxonomy rather than the aggregate score; audio LM pretraining needs these axes more than ASR-style metrics.

paper.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
paper.abstract: We introduce WorldOlympiad, a benchmark for diagnosing video-based world models across physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity. While existing benchmarks often focus on visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal coherence, they provide limited insight into whether generated videos obey physical rules, preserve coherent 3D structure, and sustain controllable interactions over long horizons. To address this gap, WorldOlympiad decomposes world-model ev

summary.core_problem: WorldOlympiad 解决的是视频世界模型评测过于偏向画质、语义对齐和短期平滑性的问题。它把评测目标转向三个更接近“世界模型”要求的维度：物理规律是否可信，三维几何是否稳定，长程交互是否能按控制信号持续演化。
summary.importance: 这篇更适合作为评测资产泛读。对 LLM 预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在多模态世界模型的能力拆解方式。它提醒一个关键点：视频生成模型如果要承担世界模型角色，常规视觉质量指标不足以反映建模质量。对做原生多模态预训练、视频 token 建模、AR+diffusion 联合建模的人，WorldOlympiad 提供了一组可操作的诊断维度，尤其是把物理、几何和交互控制分开评估，而不是用单一视频质量分数覆盖所有失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: WorldOlympiad 构建了 1,000 条高质量长视频，覆盖 robotics、gaming、real-world 三类场景。其中 robotics 来自 RoboCOIN，筛选 400 条双臂机器人操作视频，主要考察接触、抓取、状态变化和动作一致性；gaming 来自 GameGen-X，采样并切分为最长约 60 秒的视频片段，覆盖玩家导航、视角移动、战斗、技能释放和游戏状态变化；real-world 来自 LVD-2M，包含更开放的运动和相机动态。评测设计分为三条 track。physical track 使用物体分割和 MLLM-as-judge，检查力学、热现象、材料属性等可解释规则是否被遵守。geometry track 对生成视频做 3D 重建，文中提到使用 Gaussian splatting 来诊断跨帧几何一致性。interaction track 关注长程 chunk-by-chunk 生成中，模型是否能跟随控制信号，并保持状态连续。和 VBench、VBench++ 这类偏感知质量与时序平滑性的评测相比，它的差异在于评估对象不是“视频好不好看”，而是“生成过程是否能支撑可控、可持续的世界状态演化”。
summary.experiments: 实验部分 benchmark 了 8 个代表性长视频生成 pipeline，并在三类场景、三条能力轴上分析失效模式。给出的主要发现是：现有长视频模型在长上下文一致性、物理规则遵守、三维结构稳定性和交互控制上都有系统性短板。数据规模是 1,000 条长视频，组成是 400 条机器人视频、400 条游戏视频、200 条真实世界视频。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整结果表，具体模型名称、逐项分数和统计显著性无法确认；可确认的是评测协议强调长程生成和交互式 chunk 生成，而不是短视频单次生成。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看数据构成和三条 track 的 metric 设计：physical track 如何把分割结果和 MLLM judge 结合，geometry track 如何用 3D 重建暴露跨帧结构漂移，interaction track 如何定义 chunk 间控制一致性。若关注视频世界模型预训练，可以重点看失败案例和指标定义，而不是只看 leaderboard 分数。最值得带走的是能力拆分方式：物理、几何、交互三类错误通常不会被 FVD、CLIP score 或普通视频质量指标稳定捕捉。

summary_en.core_problem: WorldOlympiad targets a gap in video world-model evaluation: most existing benchmarks measure visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal smoothness, but do not directly test physical plausibility, 3D consistency, and controllable long-horizon interaction.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation resource rather than a pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from how it decomposes video world-model capability. For native multimodal pretraining, video-token modeling, and AR-diffusion hybrid systems, the benchmark makes a useful distinction between perceptual video quality and model reliability as a simulator. A model can produce visually plausible clips while still violating object permanence, geometry, physical dynamics, or user control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 1,000 curated long videos across three domains: 400 robotics videos from RoboCOIN, 400 gaming videos from GameGen-X, and 200 real-world videos from LVD-2M. The robotics subset emphasizes contact, manipulation, gripper motion, and action-consistent state changes. The gaming subset covers navigation, camera control, combat events, skills, and evolving game states, with long videos split into shorter chunks of up to about 60 seconds. The real-world subset adds open-domain motion and camera dynamics. The evaluation is organized into three tracks. The physical track uses object segmentation and MLLM-as-judge to check interpretable rules in mechanics, thermal behavior, and material properties. The geometry track reconstructs generated videos, including with Gaussian splatting, to probe 3D consistency. The interaction track evaluates whether chunk-by-chunk generation follows control signals while preserving state continuity. Compared with VBench-style evaluation, the key difference is that the unit of evaluation is world-model behavior, not only video appearance.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates 8 representative long-video generation pipelines on the benchmark. The reported diagnostic finding is that current systems show systematic weaknesses in long-context consistency, physical reasoning, geometric stability, and interaction control. The confirmed dataset scale is 1,000 videos: 400 robotics, 400 gaming, and 200 real-world. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact per-model scores and ablation numbers cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction and the metric definitions for the three tracks. The most useful parts are the design choices behind physical-rule judging, 3D reconstruction-based geometry evaluation, and chunk-level interaction fidelity. For researchers working on video world models, the failure taxonomy is likely more informative than the aggregate ranking.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态世界模型预训练的研究员可重点看§3的评测维度设计，其余实验结果部分快速浏览即可。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on multimodal world model pretraining can focus on evaluation dimension design in §3, skim the rest of the experiment results.

paper.title: IMUG-Bench: Benchmarking Unified Multimodal Models on Interleaved Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: In recent years, unified multimodal models (UMMs) have emerged to support both understanding and generation within a single framework. Mastering dynamic, multi-turn interleaved image-text dialogues is a crucial task for UMMs in real-world applications. However, existing benchmarks fail to evaluate this important task, as they are often limited to single-turn or static settings, and typically overlook exposure bias in multi-turn interactions. To bridge this gap, we propose IMUG-Bench, a comprehen

summary.core_problem: 解决统一多模态模型在多轮、图文交错、同时包含理解与生成的交互场景中缺少合适评测基准的问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产工作。对做统一多模态预训练的人有实际价值，因为现有 benchmark 多是单轮或静态设置，容易高估模型在真实交互中的能力，尤其忽略 exposure bias 在多轮生成中的累积效应。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IMUG-Bench，面向 interleaved image-text dialogue，联合评估 understanding 和 generation。数据分为 Static Spatial、Temporal Causal、Hybrid 三类，共 3,113 个样本、12,034 个交互轮次，并加入动态理解问题，以更接近真实多轮交互。
summary.experiments: 作者在 IMUG-Bench 上系统评测主流统一多模态模型。摘要没有列出具体参评模型、评分协议、judge 设计和领先者差距，但明确指出 benchmark 的核心是暴露多轮交互中的能力退化与 exposure bias，而不是单轮静态任务表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of proper evaluation for unified multimodal models in multi-turn, interleaved image-text interactions that require both understanding and generation.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation asset with practical value for researchers working on unified multimodal pretraining. Existing benchmarks are often single-turn or static, which can overestimate real interactive capability and miss exposure-bias accumulation in multi-turn generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces IMUG-Bench for interleaved image-text dialogue, jointly evaluating understanding and generation. The benchmark contains three categories—Static Spatial, Temporal Causal, and Hybrid—with 3,113 samples and 12,034 interaction turns, plus dynamic understanding questions to better reflect real multi-turn interaction.
summary_en.experiments: The authors systematically evaluate mainstream unified multimodal models on IMUG-Bench. The abstract does not specify the exact model roster, scoring protocol, judge design, or performance gaps, but makes clear that the benchmark is intended to reveal degradation and exposure bias in multi-turn interactive settings rather than static single-turn competence.

recommendation.zh: 做 unified multimodal pretrain 的可以收下，但别通读；先看任务定义、评分协议和多轮退化案例，若 benchmark 设计不干净就只当负面 checklist。
recommendation.en: Useful if you work on unified multimodal pretraining, but don’t read it end-to-end; inspect the task design, scoring protocol, and failure cases for multi-turn degradation, then decide whether it’s a real benchmark or just a checklist.

paper.title: Evaluating Stochastic Collapse and Implicit Bias in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Current evaluations for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) overwhelmingly focus on utility-driven objectives, leaving model behavior under logic-neutral scenarios largely underexplored. Stochasticity is essential in scenarios where multiple actions are equally valid, such as recommending travel itineraries or daily schedules where multiple options have similar utility. In such settings, deterministic policies may lead to repetitive behaviors and reduced coverage of valid alternatives. To b

summary.core_problem: 现有 MLLM 评测大多围绕“有正确答案/有更高效用”的任务，忽略了在“逻辑中性”(所有选项等价)场景下模型是否能维持近似均匀的随机选择分布。论文要回答的是：当明确要求随机选择时，MLLM 是否会出现概率质量坍缩到少数选项的现象，以及这种偏好是否稳定、可量化、是否受视觉显著性等因素劫持。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产型工作（eval），对预训练研究的价值在于提供一个“分布行为诊断”视角：1）把模型当作随机策略时，指令对齐与 RLHF 可能强化确定性与偏置（文中声称强模型/更对齐模型反而更坍缩），这会反向影响 agent 场景的覆盖率与探索；2）暴露“内生先验”(位置偏好、数字偏好、视觉显著性偏好)可能来自预训练数据与解码习惯的耦合，而不是表面 prompt 伪影；3）对训练侧的启发是：如果需要真正的随机策略，可能要在目标函数里显式约束熵/校准，或在数据与对齐阶段引入“逻辑中性随机性”训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RandomBench：200 个实例，分 RB-Text 与 RB-Vision，两种模态都构造“绝对等价”的候选项集合，要求模型随机选一个。评测协议强调重复采样：每个实例重复评测 50 次，用经验分布来估计随机性与偏置。指标方面给出三类熵/偏置度量：Randomness Index (RI) 用于衡量接近均匀分布的程度；Bias Intensity Index (BII) 衡量偏置强度/集中度；Bias Consistency Index (BCI) 衡量跨重复采样或条件变化时偏好是否一致稳定。分析上提出两种现象：stochastic collapse（分布坍缩）与 visual hijacking（视觉线索如显著性、空间位置、几何复杂度压过“随机选择”指令）。另外做了若干控制：选项标签替换、跨语言提示等，用来论证偏置不是纯词面格式导致，而更像参数内生的行为先验；并观察到模型会为无逻辑依据的选择生成流畅的事后理由。
summary.experiments: 基准规模与协议：200 实例、每例 50 次采样。结果层面，论文报告多种 MLLM 在 text-only 与 vision-language 两种设置下都出现 stochastic collapse；vision 侧更明显地出现 visual hijacking；并且更强/更对齐的模型可能表现出更强的坍缩与更稳定的偏好（伴随更强的“合理化”文本）。当前提供的全文片段未包含具体被测模型列表、各指标的数值区间、以及不同温度/解码策略的敏感性曲线，因此无法在此给出可核验的具体分数对比。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：1）先看 RandomBench 的任务构造与“绝对等价”如何保证，尤其是 RB-Vision 如何控制视觉线索；2）把三项指标的数学定义看清楚，确认它们分别对应“熵不足”“偏置集中”“偏置稳定”；3）重点看控制实验（标签置换、跨语言、格式变化）与解码设置（温度、top-p）是否固定，因为这直接决定结论是否可归因到模型而非采样器；4）如果做训练侧改进，优先关注作者对“强模型更坍缩”的证据链。预计 30-45 分钟可读完方法与主要图表。

summary_en.core_problem: Most MLLM evaluations are utility-driven (there is a correct answer or a better option), leaving logic-neutral situations under-tested. This paper asks whether MLLMs can follow an instruction to “choose randomly” when all options are semantically equivalent, or whether their output distribution collapses onto a few options in a stable, biased way—especially under multimodal (vision) cues.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution. For pretraining/alignment researchers, it provides a distributional-behavior diagnostic: (1) instruction tuning/RLHF may implicitly push models toward deterministic, overconfident policies, which hurts coverage and exploration in agent-like settings; the paper claims stronger/more aligned models can show more severe collapse. (2) It surfaces endogenous priors (position/number/visual-saliency biases) that likely arise from pretraining data and decoding conventions rather than prompt artifacts. (3) It suggests that if true stochastic policies are desired, training objectives may need explicit entropy/calibration constraints or logic-neutral randomness supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: RandomBench contains 200 logic-neutral instances split into RB-Text and RB-Vision. Each instance presents K equivalent options and explicitly asks the model to pick randomly. The protocol uses exhaustive repeated sampling: 50 runs per instance to estimate the empirical choice distribution. Three entropy/bias metrics are introduced: Randomness Index (RI) for closeness to uniformity, Bias Intensity Index (BII) for concentration/strength of preference, and Bias Consistency Index (BCI) for stability of the preference across repeats/conditions. The analysis names two failure modes: stochastic collapse (non-uniform, concentrated choice distributions) and visual hijacking (visual saliency/position/geometry overriding the randomness instruction). Control tests such as option-label substitution and cross-lingual prompting are used to argue the bias is endogenous rather than a superficial lexical formatting effect; models also generate fluent post-hoc rationalizations for arbitrary choices.
summary_en.experiments: Setup: 200 instances with 50 repeated samples each. Reported findings: stochastic collapse appears across multiple MLLMs in both text-only and vision-language settings; vision inputs exacerbate the issue via visual hijacking; stronger/more instruction-aligned models can exhibit more pronounced and consistent collapse, often with stronger rationalizations. The provided excerpt does not include the full model roster, numeric metric values, or sensitivity to decoding parameters (temperature/top-p), so exact quantitative comparisons cannot be stated here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan: (1) Verify how “absolute equivalence” is enforced, especially for RB-Vision where visual cues can leak preference signals. (2) Read the formal definitions of RI/BII/BCI to understand what each captures (entropy deficit vs concentration vs stability). (3) Focus on control experiments (label swaps, cross-lingual prompts, formatting changes) and decoding settings, since attribution hinges on these. (4) If you care about training implications, scrutinize the evidence behind “stronger models collapse more.” 30–45 minutes should cover the benchmark design and main plots.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是在做更强模型，而是在提醒你对齐后模型可能连“均匀随机”都学不会；读指标定义和主结果表就够，适合拿来补 internal eval。
recommendation.en: This paper is not about making models stronger; it shows that aligned models may fail even at 'uniform randomness.' Read the metric definitions and main results table, then consider adding this to your internal eval stack.

paper.title: Almieyar-Oryx-BloomBench: A Bilingual Multimodal Benchmark for Cognitively Informed Evaluation of Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite the rapid progress of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the field lacks benchmarks that rigorously diagnose their true reasoning abilities and chart meaningful progress toward human-like multimodal intelligence. Most existing evaluations focus on piecemeal or disconnected tasks, obscuring critical cognitive weaknesses and providing little insight for targeted improvement. To address this gap, we introduce BloomBench, part of the Almieyar benchmarking series, the first cognitively human-grou

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM评测多为零散任务，无法系统性诊断模型认知层次的推理能力缺陷
summary.importance: 多模态评测基准贡献，首次基于布鲁姆认知分类法构建英阿双语VLM评测基准
summary.technical_approach: 基于布鲁姆认知分类的6个层次（记忆、理解、应用、分析、评价、创造）设计图文问答任务，采用半自动化构建流程和分层混合质量验证协议保证可扩展性、文化包容性和语言保真度
summary.experiments: 基于该基准对主流VLM进行了系统性评测，完成了基准的质量验证
summary.authors_note: 英属哥伦比亚大学、卡塔尔计算研究所等机构团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM evaluations are mostly fragmented tasks that cannot systematically diagnose flaws in reasoning abilities at different cognitive levels
summary_en.importance: Multimodal evaluation benchmark contribution, the first bilingual (English-Arabic) VLM benchmark grounded in Bloom's Taxonomy
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs image-question-answer tasks aligned with 6 levels of Bloom's Taxonomy (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, Create); uses semi-automated construction pipeline and stratified hybrid quality assurance to ensure scalability, cultural inclusivity, and linguistic fidelity
summary_en.experiments: Conducted systematic evaluation of mainstream VLMs using the benchmark, completed quality validation of the benchmark assets
summary_en.authors_note: Teams from University of British Columbia, Qatar Computing Research Institute, etc.

recommendation.zh: 认知维度的多模态评测设计思路有参考，看评测分层设计部分即可，无需复现
recommendation.en: The cognitive-dimension multimodal evaluation design is referential; only read the evaluation stratification section, no need for reproduction

institutions: Qatar Computing Research Institute (QCRI), Hamad Bin Khalifa University

paper.title: SagaQA: A Multi-hop Reasoning Benchmark for Long-form Narrative Understanding in TV Series
paper.abstract: We introduce SagaQA, a long-form video benchmark for multi-hop reasoning over full-length TV series. Existing video reasoning benchmarks often emphasize local understanding of adjacent frames or clips. SagaQA addresses this gap by requiring high-level comprehension of extended multimodal narratives in entire TV shows. A distinguishing feature of SagaQA is the granularity of its reasoning steps. Our dataset necessitates long-range reasoning hops to connect information across completely different

summary.core_problem: 构建并评估一个面向完整电视剧叙事理解的长视频多跳推理基准，检验模型能否跨集数、跨事件连接信息。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 贡献。它把视频理解评测从短片段局部感知推进到长程叙事、多模态记忆和跨 episode 推理，对长上下文 VLM 与 agentic planner 的评估有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SagaQA，问题需要模型在完整 TV series 范围内进行多跳推理，而不是只依赖相邻帧或短 clip。论文还把 agentic planning 策略分为 Parallel、Sequential、Hybrid 三类，比较不同规划方式生成推理计划的完整性和一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验评估了不同规划策略在 SagaQA 上的表现，重点观察它们处理复杂叙事推理链的能力；未给出具体模型列表、样本规模、提升幅度或完整数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 IRIT / University of Toulouse 与 A*STAR；Nancy F. Chen 长期从事语音、语言与多模态交互研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a long-form video QA benchmark for multi-hop reasoning over full TV series, where models must connect events across episodes.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation asset. It shifts video reasoning evaluation from local clip understanding toward long-range narrative memory, multimodal event tracking, and cross-episode reasoning, which is relevant for long-context VLMs and agentic planners.
summary_en.technical_approach: SagaQA is designed so that questions require reasoning over complete shows rather than adjacent frames or short clips. The paper also studies agentic planning strategies, grouped into Parallel, Sequential, and Hybrid planners, and compares their ability to produce coherent and complete reasoning plans.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations of different planning strategies on SagaQA, focusing on their ability to handle complex narrative reasoning chains. It does not provide full model lists, dataset size, or quantitative gains in the provided excerpt.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with IRIT / University of Toulouse and A*STAR; Nancy F. Chen is known for work in speech, language, and multimodal interaction.

recommendation.zh: 长视频叙事 eval 可作为 long-context VLM 失败模式备查；不必细读，先看数据构造和 planner 对比。
recommendation.en: Useful as a failure-mode reference for long-context VLMs; skim the dataset construction and planner comparison, not the whole paper.

institutions: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)

paper.title: SynCred-Bench: Benchmarking Synthetic Credibility in AI-Generated Visual Misinformation
paper.abstract: Recent generative models can now produce visual artifacts with realistic embedded text and layouts, creating a new misinformation threat: synthetic credibility. We introduce SYNCRED-Bench, a benchmark of 600 AI-generated misinformation images balanced across six credible-form categories and seven fine-grained circulation styles, together with FP450, a real-image negative set for measuring false positives. Extensive evaluation shows that existing systems remain unreliable: under a 5% false-positi

summary.core_problem: 评测现有模型是否能识别带有逼真文本、版式和可信外观的 AI 生成视觉虚假信息，即“synthetic credibility”问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测资产与问题定义：提出一个更贴近现实攻击面的视觉 misinformation benchmark，检验 MLLM、AIGC detector 和商业 API 在低误报约束下的真实检测能力。对做多模态安全、评测协议和模型鲁棒性的研究员有参考价值，但对 LLM 预训练本身是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 SynCred-Bench：600 张 AI 生成误导图像，覆盖 6 类可信形式与 7 类传播风格；再加入 FP450 真实图像负样本集，用于在固定 5% FPR 约束下测量 TPR。评测对象包括 15 个 MLLM、开源 AIGC 检测器和商业 API，并与人类标注者比较。
summary.experiments: 关键结果是：在 5% false-positive-rate 约束下，15 个 MLLM 的 TPR 仅 10.5%，开源 AIGC detector 低于 5%，商业 API 达到 57.6%，人类标注者也只有 63% TPR。摘要没有给出训练规模，因为核心是 benchmark 而非方法训练。
summary.authors_note: 来自清华大学 CoAI / Minlie Huang 团队，长期做对话系统、LLM 与评测相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether current systems can detect AI-generated visual misinformation that looks credible through realistic text, layout, and presentation—what the paper calls synthetic credibility.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and problem framing: a benchmark targeting a realistic attack surface in visual misinformation, measuring actual detection ability of MLLMs, AIGC detectors, and commercial APIs under low false-positive constraints. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but useful for multimodal safety and evaluation researchers.
summary_en.technical_approach: SynCred-Bench contains 600 AI-generated misinformation images spanning six credibility-form categories and seven circulation styles, plus FP450 as a real-image negative set. The protocol reports TPR under a fixed 5% FPR constraint. The benchmark evaluates 15 MLLMs, open-source AIGC detectors, commercial APIs, and human annotators.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is that under a 5% false-positive-rate constraint, 15 MLLMs achieve only 10.5% TPR, open-source AIGC detectors stay below 5%, commercial APIs reach 57.6%, and humans achieve 63% TPR. No training-scale details are central because this is a benchmark paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from Tsinghua University's CoAI / Minlie Huang group, known for dialogue systems, LLMs, and evaluation-related research.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但评测协议是干净的：固定 FPR 看 TPR，比泛泛 accuracy 更像真实部署；读结果表即可，不必深挖方法。
recommendation.en: Not directly about pretraining, but the evaluation protocol is cleaner than generic accuracy—TPR at fixed FPR is deployment-relevant; read the main result table and move on.

institutions: The Conversational AI (CoAI) group, DCST, Tsinghua University

paper.title: OVO-S-Bench: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Streaming Spatial Intelligence in Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal agents in robotics, AR, and autonomous driving must reason about places and layouts from continuous egocentric streams, often using evidence outside the current view. Existing benchmarks either evaluate offline over full videos or target events rather than spatial structure. We introduce OVO-S-Bench, a fully human-annotated benchmark for streaming spatial intelligence, comprising 1,680 questions over 348 source videos. Annotation involves 12 trained annotators, each also serving as a

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态评测难以衡量流式场景下空间智能的问题，尤其是模型是否能仅基于视频前缀追踪布局、跨时刻整合证据并进行空间推理。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测资产工作，贡献在于把 streaming spatial intelligence 从离线视频理解中单独剥离出来，并用层级任务设计区分感知、跟踪、模拟和地图构建。对做原生多模态预训练和视频流建模的人有一定参考，但更偏 benchmark。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 OVO-S-Bench，包含 348 个源视频、1680 个问题。每个问题带 query timestamp 和 evidence interval，评测时模型只能看到 query 之前的视频前缀。任务按四层组织：瞬时第一视角感知、时空上下文跟踪、空间模拟与推理、allocentric mapping。作者在 38 个开源和闭源 MLLM 上做系统评测，并与人类专家比较。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的关键结果是：Gemini-3.1-Pro 仍落后人类专家 27 个百分点，说明当前 MLLM 在流式空间智能上存在明显缺口。数据集规模中等，人工标注和质检投入较高。由于核心贡献是 benchmark，研究员更应关注任务协议是否避免信息泄漏、前缀约束是否严格、以及四层任务是否真能分离能力。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of benchmarks for streaming spatial intelligence in multimodal models, especially whether a model can track layouts, integrate evidence across time, and reason spatially using only the video prefix available at query time.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation asset. Its contribution is to isolate streaming spatial intelligence from generic offline video understanding, with a hierarchical task design spanning perception, tracking, simulation, and mapping. It is somewhat relevant to native multimodal pretraining and video-stream modeling, but it is primarily a benchmark paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces OVO-S-Bench with 348 source videos and 1,680 questions. Each question includes a query timestamp and an evidence interval, and the model only sees the prefix before the query during evaluation. Tasks are organized into four levels: instantaneous egocentric perception, spatiotemporal context tracking, spatial simulation and reasoning, and allocentric mapping. The benchmark is evaluated on 38 open and proprietary MLLMs and compared against human experts.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result in the abstract is that Gemini-3.1-Pro trails human experts by 27 points, indicating a substantial gap in streaming spatial intelligence. The dataset is moderate in size but heavily human-annotated. Since this is a benchmark paper, the main thing to inspect is whether the protocol truly prevents leakage, whether the prefix-only constraint is strict, and whether the four levels cleanly separate capabilities.

recommendation.zh: 偏视频-VLM 评测，不是基座方法论文；知道有这个坑位即可，若做流式多模态只看任务协议和人机差距那张主表。
recommendation.en: This is a video-VLM benchmark rather than a foundation-method paper; know it exists, and if you work on streaming multimodality, just inspect the protocol and the human-vs-model gap table.

paper.title: Do Audio LLMs Listen or Read? Analyzing and Mitigating Paralinguistic Failures with VoxParadox
paper.abstract: Audio large language models (Audio LLMs) demonstrate strong performance on speech understanding tasks, yet their ability to understand paralinguistic information remains limited. To systematically quantify this issue, we introduce VoxParadox, an adversarial benchmark with 2,000 verified examples, spanning 10 paralinguistic tasks, created with controlled speech synthesis to intentionally mismatch transcript claims and speaking style, enabling direct measurement of speech paralinguistic understand

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 Audio LLM 在语音副语言信息上的失效：当转写文本和声音表达相互矛盾时，模型到底是在听声音，还是在跟随文本语义。副语言信息包括情绪、年龄、性别、音高、音量、语速、语调和说话人身份等。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于揭示语音-语言统一建模中的模态失衡。很多 Audio LLM 通过音频编码器接 LLM，训练信号常偏向 ASR 或文本语义，导致声学表示即使存在，也可能在投影到 LLM 或生成答案时被弱化。这个问题直接影响语音 LM、native audio multimodal pretraining 和音频 tokenizer/encoder 设计：如果训练目标主要奖励转写内容，模型会学到“读文本”的捷径，而不是稳定使用声学证据。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造 VoxParadox，一个带有语言-声学冲突的对抗式语音问答 benchmark。每个样本有两个标签：声音真实表达的 paralinguistic ground truth，以及转写文本中显式声称的错误标签。转写由 GPT-4o 生成，用来明确诱导错误答案；音频由可控 TTS 合成，使声音属性对应真实标签。数据覆盖 10 类副语言任务，每类 200 条，总计 2,000 条已验证多选题。分析部分使用 layer-wise probing 检查副语言信息在音频编码器、encoder-LLM projection 和 LLM hidden states 中的保留情况。方法部分提出 Prompt-Conditioned Layer Mixer，把音频编码器多个层的表示按用户 prompt 自适应混合，再送入 LLM；同时使用 DPO，让模型更偏好基于声学证据的答案，而不是文本暗示的错误答案。
summary.experiments: 作者评估了多种现代 Audio LLM，结果显示一个一致模式：模型在声学真实标签上的准确率偏低，却高度同意转写文本暗示的错误选项。层级 probing 给出两个原因。第一，副语言线索可能在音频编码器深层或 encoder-LLM 投影边界被削弱，这与 ASR 中心的预训练目标相符。第二，即使内部表示中仍能线性或探针式取出副语言信息，LLM 也经常不使用这些信息，形成 utilization gap。PCLM 改善送入 LLM 的音频表示，DPO 进一步提高在语言-声学冲突场景下选择声学真实答案的倾向，也改善一般副语言理解表现。具体准确率数字在给定内容中未显示。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25 到 40 分钟。先看 VoxParadox 的数据构造，重点确认 transcript claim 和 acoustic ground truth 如何被严格解耦；再看各 Audio LLM 在真实声学标签与文本暗示标签上的对照结果，这是判断模态捷径的关键；随后看 layer-wise probing，区分“表示丢失”和“表示存在但未被使用”两类问题；最后看 PCLM 和 DPO 的实验，判断改进来自更好的音频层选择，还是来自偏好训练改变了决策边界。对做语音 LM 预训练的人，最有用的是它把副语言失败拆成 encoder 表示、投影接口、LLM 使用三段，而不是只报告最终问答准确率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether Audio LLMs actually use acoustic paralinguistic evidence when it conflicts with the transcript. The target signals are attributes such as emotion, age, gender, pitch, volume, speaking rate, prosody, and speaker identity.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is modality imbalance in speech-language models. Many Audio LLMs connect an audio encoder to a text LLM and are trained with objectives that strongly reward lexical or ASR-like content. This can create a shortcut: the model follows what the transcript says even when the acoustic signal carries the correct answer. For audio LM and native speech multimodal pretraining, the paper points to a concrete failure mode in the interface between acoustic representation learning and language-model reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce VoxParadox, an adversarial speech QA benchmark built around controlled linguistic-acoustic contradiction. Each example has a true label conveyed by the speech signal and an adversarial label explicitly asserted in the transcript. GPT-4o is used to generate misleading transcripts that claim the wrong paralinguistic attribute, while controlled TTS synthesis produces audio matching the true attribute. The dataset contains 2,000 verified multiple-choice examples across 10 paralinguistic tasks, with 200 examples per task. The analysis uses layer-wise probing to locate where paralinguistic information is lost or retained across the audio encoder, the encoder-to-LLM projection, and the LLM hidden states. The proposed mitigation is Prompt-Conditioned Layer Mixer, which adaptively mixes representations from multiple audio encoder layers based on the user prompt. The model is further trained with DPO to prefer acoustically grounded answers over transcript-implied incorrect answers.
summary_en.experiments: Across a diverse set of Audio LLMs, the reported pattern is consistent: accuracy with respect to acoustic ground truth is low, while agreement with the transcript-implied wrong label is high. The probing analysis suggests two bottlenecks. First, paralinguistic information can degrade in deeper audio encoder layers or at the projection boundary into the LLM, consistent with ASR-centric training. Second, even when paralinguistic cues remain recoverable from internal representations, the LLM often fails to use them, leaving a utilization gap. PCLM improves the audio representation passed to the LLM, and DPO further improves robustness under linguistic-acoustic contradiction as well as general paralinguistic understanding. Exact accuracy numbers are not available in the provided content.
summary_en.reading_guide: A targeted skim should take about 25 to 40 minutes. Start with the VoxParadox construction and verification protocol, because the key is the explicit separation between transcript claims and acoustic ground truth. Then inspect the evaluation tables contrasting acoustic-ground-truth accuracy with transcript-implied agreement. The layer-wise probing section is the most useful diagnostic part, since it separates representation loss from failure to use available representations. Finally, read the PCLM and DPO ablations to see whether gains come from better audio-layer selection or from preference training. The useful takeaway for audio pretraining is the three-part decomposition of the failure: encoder representation, projection interface, and LLM utilization.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 构造和 probing 图；这类冲突样本比普通语音理解榜单更能暴露 audio-token 接口问题。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and probing figures; the conflict setup exposes audio-token interface failures better than ordinary speech-understanding leaderboards.

paper.title: Agentic Active Omni-Modal Perception for Multi-Hop Audio-Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multi-hop audio-visual reasoning remains challenging for Omni-LLMs, as relevant evidence is often sparse, temporally dispersed, and distributed across both audio and visual streams. Existing benchmarks provide limited investigation of this setting, typically involving only a limited number of modalities, relevant temporal segments, or reasoning steps. In this work, we introduce MOV-Bench, a benchmark containing 519 carefully curated questions that require multi-hop reasoning over temporally disp

summary.core_problem: 现有全模态大模型缺乏针对跨模态、跨时间片段多跳推理能力的专用评测基准，且开源全模态大模型无法低成本实现主动感知以定位稀疏分散的多模态证据。
summary.importance: 为多模态大模型的跨模态多跳推理能力评测提供了标准化基准，验证了无需额外训练即可通过Agent架构弥补基座感知能力短板的可行性，为多模态基座预训练的感知-推理协同能力设计提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 首先构建MOV-Bench多跳音视频推理基准，包含519道筛选后的选择题，要求推理必须结合多时间片段证据、跨模态融合，覆盖因果、指代、关系、假设、意图五类推理主题；随后提出AOP-Agent低资源主动感知框架，通过层级化全模态记忆组织视频内容，将复杂推理拆解为观察-反思-重规划的协作交互流程，无需额外训练或闭源模型即可支持开源全模态大模型逐步定位整合稀疏音视频证据。
summary.experiments: 在MOV-Bench和OmniVideoBench两个基准上测试，AOP-Agent在多跳音视频推理任务上带来稳定提升，尤其在长视频和高推理复杂度问题上提升更显著；对比现有代表性Agent视频推理框架，AOP-Agent为开源全模态大模型实现了更高效率的主动感知。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注MOV-Bench的设计原则与构建流程、AOP-Agent的核心架构设计，以及两个基准上的核心对比结果，预计阅读时间约20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Omni-LLMs lack dedicated evaluation benchmarks for cross-modal, cross-temporal-segment multi-hop reasoning capability, and open-source Omni-LLMs cannot implement active perception at low cost to locate sparse, dispersed multi-modal evidence.
summary_en.importance: It provides a standardized benchmark for evaluating the cross-modal multi-hop reasoning capability of multimodal large models, verifies the feasibility of compensating for the perception shortcomings of foundation models through agent architecture without additional training, and provides reference for the design of perception-reasoning collaboration capability in multimodal foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, MOV-Bench, a multi-hop audio-visual reasoning benchmark, is constructed, containing 519 curated multiple-choice questions that require evidence from multiple temporal segments and cross-modal fusion, covering five reasoning themes. Then AOP-Agent, a low-resource active perception framework, is proposed: it organizes video content through hierarchical omni-modal memory, and decomposes complex reasoning into a collaborative observe-reflect-replan interaction process, enabling open-source Omni-LLMs to gradually locate and integrate sparse audio-visual evidence without additional training or closed-source models.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on MOV-Bench and OmniVideoBench, AOP-Agent brings consistent improvements on multi-hop audio-visual reasoning tasks, especially on long videos and questions with high reasoning complexity. Compared with existing representative agent video reasoning frameworks, AOP-Agent achieves more efficient active perception for open-source Omni-LLMs.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the design principles and construction pipeline of MOV-Bench, the core architecture design of AOP-Agent, and the core comparison results on the two benchmarks. Estimated reading time is about 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 任务定义和错误类型即可；519 题规模不大，但能暴露 native multimodal 预训练未覆盖的时间证据组合缺口。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and error taxonomy; 519 questions is small, but it exposes temporal evidence-composition gaps not solved by current native multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: Which Way Did It Move? Diagnosing and Overcoming Directional Motion Blindness in Video-LLMs
paper.abstract: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have made rapid progress on temporal video understanding, yet many fail at a basic perceptual primitive: signed image-plane motion direction. On simple videos of a single object moving left, right, up, or down, most Video-LLMs perform near chance, with above-chance cases largely attributable to prediction biases rather than genuine direction understanding. We call this failure directional motion blindness. We localize the failure by tracing motion directi

summary.core_problem: 诊断 Video-LLM 是否真正理解单物体在图像平面中的有符号运动方向，例如向左、向右、向上、向下。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 感知能力诊断，而不是新的预训练方法。它指出一些 Video-LLM 在看似简单的低层视觉运动判断上接近随机，提示视频-语言对齐中仍存在从视觉信号到语言答案的绑定缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造简单运动视频任务，并沿 Video-LLM pipeline 追踪方向信息：检查视觉编码器、projector 和 LLM hidden states 中方向信号是否线性可读。核心发现是方向信息并未完全丢失，而是在最终 verbal answer option 的 readout/binding 阶段失效。作者还用合成运动方向指令微调尝试缩小缺口，并用 direction concept vector 分析复杂视觉场景下信号衰减。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型列表、参数规模和完整数值。主要实验包括单物体方向判断、prediction bias 分析、各层线性探针、合成方向指令微调，以及跨域视觉复杂度下的概念向量信号强度分析。结论是多数 Video-LLM 接近 chance，合成调优能改善源域但泛化受限。
summary.authors_note: Kyung Hee University 与 Princeton University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether Video-LLMs can reliably identify signed image-plane motion direction, such as left, right, up, or down, in simple videos.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a diagnostic study for multimodal models rather than a pretraining method. Its value is in showing that high-level video-language performance can coexist with failure on a basic perceptual primitive, which points to a binding issue between visual motion evidence and verbal answer choices.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build simple motion-direction probes and trace the direction signal through the Video-LLM stack. They test whether motion direction is linearly recoverable from the vision encoder, projector, and LLM hidden states, then analyze why the final answer readout fails. They also apply synthetic motion-direction instruction tuning and use direction concept vectors to study how visual complexity weakens the signal.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the exact model list, parameter sizes, or full numerical tables. The experiments cover simple single-object motion tasks, prediction-bias checks, linear probing across the pipeline, synthetic instruction tuning, and out-of-domain tests under more complex visual scenes. Most Video-LLMs are reported to be near chance, while source-domain tuning helps but generalizes poorly.
summary_en.authors_note: Kyung Hee University and Princeton University.

recommendation.zh: 只看诊断结论和线性探针部分即可；它提醒 VLM 预训练别把 temporal benchmark 分数误读成基础运动绑定能力。
recommendation.en: Skim the diagnostic and probing results; it is a useful warning that video benchmark scores do not imply clean motion-to-language binding.

paper.title: Robust Checkpoint Selection for Multimodal LLMs via Agentic Evaluation and Stability-Aware Ranking
paper.abstract: Checkpoint selection for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) presents significant challenges when performance differentials are marginal and evaluation signals are prone to noise. Existing methodologies rely heavily on static benchmarks or pointwise scoring, which frequently misalign with in-the-wild usage and lack robust uncertainty estimation, particularly in OCR-heavy scenarios. In this work, we formulate checkpoint selection as a robust decision problem under evaluation uncertainty. We

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态LLM训练过程中checkpoint分数差距很小、评测噪声大、OCR场景尾部失败难以被静态benchmark发现的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态评测与模型选择流程。它偏工程决策，不是新的VLM预训练方法，但对大规模训练中的checkpoint selection和eval reliability有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把checkpoint选择形式化为评测不确定性下的稳健决策问题。系统结合真实数据、结构化LLM-as-judge、多阶段排序协议，先pointwise过滤，再listwise排序，最后pairwise比较；同时用subsampling估计置信度，并用percentile-based score惩罚尾部失败。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据量和具体提升数字。实验重点似乎是OCR-heavy多模态场景下的checkpoint选择稳定性，以及证明数据选择和稳定性排序能比静态benchmark或单点评分更可靠。
summary.authors_note: 作者信息标注为Independent Researcher，previously Meta AI。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses noisy checkpoint selection for multimodal LLMs, especially when score gaps are small and OCR-heavy failure modes are missed by static benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and model-selection workflow contribution for MLLMs. It is more of an engineering decision system than a new multimodal pretraining method, but it is relevant to training-time checkpoint governance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate checkpoint selection as robust decision-making under evaluation uncertainty. The pipeline combines curated real-world data, structured LLM judging, and staged ranking: pointwise filtering, listwise ranking, and pairwise comparison. It also uses subsampling-based confidence estimation and percentile-based scoring to penalize tail failures.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset sizes, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears to focus on checkpoint-selection stability in OCR-heavy MLLM scenarios and on showing that stability-aware ranking is more reliable than static benchmarks or pointwise scoring.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliation is listed as Independent Researcher, previously Meta AI.

recommendation.zh: 这是训练运营里的eval hygiene，不是VLM建模创新；若你负责checkpoint选择，看percentile打分即可。
recommendation.en: This is eval hygiene for training operations, not VLM modeling; if you own checkpoint selection, read the percentile scoring part.

paper.title: FAGER: Factually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement of Text-to-Image Models
paper.abstract: Existing text-to-image (T2I) evaluation metrics mainly assess whether generated images align with information explicitly stated in the prompt, but often fail to capture factual requirements that are implicit, externally grounded, or identity-defining. As a result, they are not well suited for evaluating factual correctness in prompts involving scientific knowledge, historical facts, products, or culture-specific concepts. We propose FActually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement (FAGER), an agenti

summary.core_problem: 现有文生图评测更偏“字面 prompt 对齐”，难以衡量隐含/外部知识支撑的“事实正确性”，也缺少可操作的改进反馈。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏评测与诊断：把“可视觉验证的事实”显式结构化成 rubric，并给出可用于模型改进的反馈链路；对多模态对齐/事实性评测有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FAGER：先用 LLM 提议事实点，再结合参考引导的视觉事实抽取与核验，构建结构化 factual rubric；再把 rubric 转成 QA 对，用 VLM 做问答式评估，从而得到事实性分数与可执行的修正建议；并引入 Factual A/B test 作为验证该指标有效性的评测协议。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模与量化结果细节；主要实验应围绕：与既有 T2I 指标/评测协议对比、在“科学/历史/产品/文化概念”等事实依赖 prompt 上的区分度，以及 A/B test 下与人类偏好/事实判断的一致性。
summary.authors_note: Boston University；IBM Research。

summary_en.core_problem: Most T2I metrics focus on explicit prompt alignment and miss factually grounded requirements (implicit or external-knowledge-dependent), and they rarely provide actionable refinement feedback.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation/diagnostics contribution: it operationalizes “visually verifiable facts” into a structured rubric and closes the loop with actionable feedback, useful for multimodal factuality assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: FAGER builds a structured factual rubric via LLM-based fact proposal plus reference-guided visual fact extraction/verification, converts the rubric into QA pairs, and uses a VLM for QA-style evaluation to score factuality and generate improvement feedback; introduces a Factual A/B test protocol to validate the metric.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model/data scales or exact numbers; experiments likely compare against prior T2I metrics and evaluate agreement with human factual judgments on fact-heavy prompts (science/history/products/culture), using the proposed A/B test.
summary_en.authors_note: Boston University; IBM Research.

recommendation.zh: 偏评测工程：把“事实”拆成可问答的 rubric 这点可借鉴，但强依赖参考与 VLM 判题，结论当弱信号看即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly evaluation engineering: the rubric-to-QA decomposition is reusable, but heavy reliance on references and VLM judging makes the claims a weak signal.

paper.title: Eyes on VLM: Benchmarking Gaze Following and Social Gaze Prediction in Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have rapidly evolved into general-purpose multimodal reasoners with strong zero-shot generalization. In this context, VLMs could greatly benefit the analysis of human gaze and attention, a central task in human behavior understanding that requires reasoning about the physical scene as well as the activity, interactions, and social context. However, the extent to which VLMs can reliably understand human gaze and related attentional behaviors remains largely unexplore

summary.core_problem: 系统评估 VLM 是否能理解人的注视方向、注视目标和社会性 gaze 行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM benchmark。它把 gaze following 和 social gaze prediction 这类需要人脸、视线方向、3D 场景结构、空间 grounding 和社交上下文的能力纳入评测。对预训练研究员的价值在于暴露 VLM 在细粒度空间和社会注意力理解上的缺口，但任务域较窄。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EyeVLM 评测框架，从任务和模型两个维度评估 gaze understanding。核心任务包括 gaze following，即预测人正在看的 2D 位置；以及 social gaze prediction，即基于场景、活动和交互关系推断注意力行为。方法重点是 benchmark 设计和模型评测，而非新的 VLM 架构或训练目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明会在多个 VLM 上评测 gaze following 和 social gaze prediction；但给定摘要未列出具体模型、数据集、样本规模、指标数值或主结论。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Idiap Research Institute。Jean-Marc Odobez 长期从事人类行为理解、社交信号处理和视觉感知研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematically evaluates whether VLMs can understand human gaze direction, attended targets, and social gaze behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM benchmark contribution. It evaluates gaze following and social gaze prediction, which require face understanding, gaze direction, 3D scene structure, spatial grounding, activity context, and social interaction reasoning. For pretraining researchers, it is useful as a probe of fine-grained spatial and social attention understanding, though the task scope is narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces EyeVLM, an evaluation framework organized along tasks and models. The core tasks include gaze following, where the model predicts the 2D location a person is looking at, and social gaze prediction, where the model infers attentional behavior from scene, activity, and interaction context. The contribution is benchmark design and evaluation rather than a new VLM architecture or training objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that multiple VLMs are evaluated on gaze following and social gaze prediction. The provided text does not list the exact models, datasets, sample sizes, metrics, or main quantitative findings.
summary_en.authors_note: The institution is Idiap Research Institute. Jean-Marc Odobez has a long research record in human behavior understanding, social signal processing, and visual perception.

recommendation.zh: 任务偏窄，但可用来检查 VLM 是否真的学到空间 grounding；看 benchmark 定义和失败案例即可。
recommendation.en: The task is narrow, but it is a useful probe for VLM spatial grounding; read the benchmark setup and failure cases only.

paper.title: When Vision Speaks for Sound
paper.abstract: Despite rapid progress in video-capable MLLMs, we find that their apparent audio understanding in videos is often vision-driven: models rely on visual cues to infer or hallucinate acoustic information, rather than verifying the audio stream. This issue appears across both state-of-the-art open-source omni models and leading closed-source models from providers such as Google and OpenAI. We characterize this failure mode as an audio-visual Clever Hans effect, in which models appear (falsely) audio

summary.core_problem: 诊断 video-capable MLLM 的音频理解是否真实依赖音频流，还是主要根据视觉线索推断甚至幻觉声音信息。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态评测与对齐分析。论文提出 audio-visual Clever Hans effect：模型看似理解视频声音，实际可能只利用视觉-声音相关性。这对 native multimodal 预训练很关键，因为它揭示了多模态 benchmark 中的伪 grounding 问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Thud，一个干预式 probing 框架，使用三类反事实音频编辑：Shift 测时间同步，Mute 测声音是否存在，Swap 测音画一致性。论文还研究两阶段 alignment recipe，利用干预产生的 preference 数据和后续对齐训练，尝试让模型更依赖真实音频证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该现象出现在多个开源 omni 模型以及 Google、OpenAI 等闭源前沿模型中。具体模型列表、任务规模、准确率下降幅度和两阶段对齐收益未在摘要中完整给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether video-capable multimodal LLMs actually ground answers in the audio stream, or merely infer and hallucinate sound from visual cues.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal evaluation and alignment analysis. It names the failure mode as an audio-visual Clever Hans effect: models appear audio-grounded while exploiting visual-acoustic correlations. This matters for native multimodal pretraining because it exposes false grounding in common video-audio evaluation setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Thud, an intervention-driven probing framework with three counterfactual audio edits: Shift for temporal synchronization, Mute for sound existence, and Swap for audio-visual consistency. It also studies a two-stage alignment recipe based on intervention-derived preference data to make models rely more on acoustic evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that the failure appears across state-of-the-art open-source omni models and leading closed-source models from providers including Google and OpenAI. The exact model list, dataset size, degradation numbers, and alignment gains are not fully specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 读 Thud 的反事实构造即可；它提醒多模态预训练别把音频能力误判成视觉先验。
recommendation.en: Read the Thud counterfactual design; it is a useful warning against mistaking visual priors for learned audio grounding.

paper.title: VCG-Bench: Towards A Unified Visual-Centric Benchmark for Structured Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Despite the rapid advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), a critical gap remains in their ability to handle structured, controllable diagrammatic tasks essential for professional workflows. Existing methods predominantly rely on pixel-based synthesis, which operates in probabilistic pixel spaces and is inherently limited in editability and fidelity. Instead, we propose a new Diagram-as-Code paradigm with symbolic logic that leverages mxGraph Extensible Markup Language (XML) for precise di

summary.core_problem: 评估 VLM 在结构化、可控、可编辑的图表生成与编辑任务上的能力，而不是只看像素级视觉生成。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM benchmark 和任务范式定义。它把图表视为 mxGraph XML 代码，强调专业工作流里的结构保真、可执行性和可编辑性，对多模态模型的结构化输出训练有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Diagram-as-Code 范式，用 mxGraph XML 表示图表的符号结构。VCG-Bench 同时覆盖 Generation，即 Vision-to-Code，以及 Editability，即 Code-to-Code。评测协议包含 mxGraph Execution Success Rate、Style Consistency Score 等多维指标，而不是只用像素相似度。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 1,449 个图表，覆盖 6 个领域和 15 个子领域。摘要未给出具体评测模型列表、参数规模和数值结果，只说明进行了实验评估。需要看正文确认任务是否主要测 VLM 结构解析，还是更接近图表工程应用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates VLMs on structured, controllable, and editable diagram generation and editing, rather than pixel-level visual synthesis alone.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM benchmark and task formulation. By representing diagrams as mxGraph XML, it emphasizes structural fidelity, executability, and editability in professional workflows, which can inform structured-output training for multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a Diagram-as-Code paradigm using mxGraph XML as the symbolic representation. VCG-Bench covers both Generation, framed as Vision-to-Code, and Editability, framed as Code-to-Code. The evaluation protocol includes mxGraph Execution Success Rate, Style Consistency Score, and other multidimensional metrics instead of relying only on pixel similarity.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 1,449 diagrams across 6 domains and 15 subdomains. The abstract does not provide the evaluated model list, model scales, or numerical results. The key thing to verify in the full paper is whether the benchmark probes general VLM structured reasoning or mostly diagram-tool engineering.

recommendation.zh: 知道这个 benchmark 就够；若做 native multimodal 或结构化输出训练，重点看指标设计而非榜单。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a benchmark; for native multimodal or structured-output training, read the metric design rather than the leaderboard.

paper.title: CurveBench: A Benchmark for Exact Topological Reasoning over Nested Jordan Curves
paper.abstract: We introduce CurveBench, a benchmark for hierarchical topological reasoning from visual input. CurveBench consists of \textbf{756 images} of pairwise non-intersecting Jordan curves across easy, polygonal, topographic-inspired, maze-like, and dense counting configurations. Each image is annotated with a rooted tree encoding the containment relations between planar regions. We formulate the task as structured prediction: given an image, a model must recover the full rooted containment tree induced

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态模型的拓扑推理能力缺乏专门的细粒度评测基准，无法准确衡量嵌套曲线的层次包含关系理解能力
summary.importance: 评测基准贡献，首次提出针对视觉拓扑推理的结构化预测任务基准，暴露VLM的逻辑推理缺陷
summary.technical_approach: 构建CurveBench基准，包含756张不同难度的非相交Jordan曲线图像，每张标注对应区域包含关系的根树，任务为从图像恢复完整根树结构
summary.experiments: Gemini 3.1 Pro在CurveBench-Easy上仅71.1%树生成准确率，Hard子集仅19.1%；经过RLVR微调的Qwen3-VL-8B在Easy子集上从2.8%提升至33.3%
summary.authors_note: 马斯特里赫特大学、康奈尔大学、宾夕法尼亚州立大学联合团队，无公开知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multimodal models lack specialized fine-grained benchmarks for topological reasoning, failing to accurately measure the ability to understand hierarchical containment relations of nested curves
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, first proposed benchmark for visual topological reasoning structured prediction task, exposing logical reasoning defects of VLMs
summary_en.technical_approach: Build CurveBench, containing 756 non-intersecting Jordan curve images of varying difficulty, each annotated with a rooted tree encoding region containment relations; the task is to recover the full rooted tree structure from images
