summary_en.experiments: Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves only 71.1% tree generation accuracy on CurveBench-Easy and 19.1% on Hard subset; RLVR fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B improves from 2.8% to 33.3% on Easy subset
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from Maastricht University, Cornell University, Pennsylvania State University, no publicly well-known authors

recommendation.zh: 仅用于VLM拓扑推理能力评测，对LLM预训练无直接启发，可作为能力边界参考
recommendation.en: Only used for VLM topological reasoning evaluation, no direct insight for LLM pretraining, can serve as a capability boundary reference

paper.title: CiteVQA: Benchmarking Evidence Attribution for Trustworthy Document Intelligence
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced document understanding, yet current Doc-VQA evaluations score only the final answer and leave the supporting evidence unchecked. This answer-only approach masks a critical failure mode: a model can land on the correct answer while grounding it in the wrong passage -- a critical risk in high-stakes domains like law, finance, and medicine, where every conclusion must be traceable to a specific source region. To address this, we i

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是文档理解中的证据归因，而不是基座预训练方法本身。它要解决的问题是：现有 Doc-VQA 只看答案对不对，不检查答案是否真的落在正确的文档区域上，因此模型可能“答对了，但证据错了”。作者把这个问题形式化为 answer + citation 的联合评测，要求模型返回元素级 bounding-box 证据，并用严格指标同时检查答案正确性和证据忠实性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响较弱，不属于核心 pretrain 论文。但它对多模态模型训练信号设计和后训练评测有一个明确启发：只优化最终答案会掩盖 grounding failure，尤其在长文档、多页 PDF、跨语言场景下更明显。若后续有人做 native document MLLM 预训练、视觉 token 对齐、或 retrieval-grounded post-training，这个 benchmark 提供了一个更严格的监督与评测方向。它的价值主要在评测框架，而不在建模方法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 benchmark 构建与指标设计。数据侧，作者从超过 1 亿份原始 PDF 中，经分层采样先筛到约 25 万候选，再通过两阶段 MLLM 标注流程做领域和子类别识别，最终选出 711 份文档，覆盖 7 个领域、30 个子类、两种语言。问题总数 1,897，平均每份文档 40.6 页，强调长文档和真实复杂版式。

标注侧，作者设计了自动化 annotation pipeline，用文档解析模型和 MLLM 协同生成问题、答案和细粒度证据区域，目标是把人工逐页框选的成本降下来，同时保持一致性。评测侧，除了普通 answer accuracy，还提出 Traceability Metrics，其中核心是 Strict Attributed Accuracy，要求答案和证据同时正确才计分；另外用 Recall 看证据覆盖，用 Relevance 看引用区域与答案推理链是否匹配。

从方法性质看，这不是提出新的文档建模架构，也不是新的预训练目标，而是把“faithful evidence attribution”从一个模糊要求变成可量化 benchmark。
summary.experiments:
实验主要是 benchmark audit，而不是算法创新。作者评测了 20 个主流 MLLM，发现一个稳定现象：Attribution Hallucination，也就是文本答案正确，但引用的证据位置完全不对。文中给出的代表性结果是，Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 的 Strict Attributed Accuracy 最高约 76.0；领先的开源模型甚至没有超过 25.0。这个落差说明 answer-only 指标会明显高估系统可靠性。

数据统计方面，CiteVQA 包含 711 份 PDF、1,897 个问题、7 个领域、30 个子类、两种语言，平均文档长度 40.6 页。作者强调这是在文档数量、长度和领域覆盖之间做平衡，目的是更接近真实使用场景。若只看实验结论，最重要的信息不是谁排第一，而是“正确答案不等于正确归因”在当前 MLLM 中相当普遍。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读。先看引言，明确它要修正的是 Doc-VQA 的评测缺口，而不是提出新的 MLLM 训练范式。然后看 benchmark construction 和 metrics 两节，重点理解自动化标注流程、元素级 citation 定义、以及 Strict Attributed Accuracy 的计分方式。最后看主结果表，关注 answer accuracy 与 SAA 的差距有多大。

如果你的工作偏预训练，这篇不需要逐节精读。20 分钟左右看完数据构建、指标定义和主表即可。只有在你关心 document MLLM 的 grounding、长文档对齐监督、或 post-training 中的 citation learning 时，才值得进一步看附录里的数据质量控制细节。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper is not a pretraining-method paper. Its core problem is an evaluation gap in document VQA: current benchmarks score the final answer but do not verify whether the model grounded that answer in the correct document region. As a result, a model can be correct in text while citing the wrong evidence. The paper turns this into a joint answer-plus-citation task, requiring element-level bounding-box evidence and evaluating both correctness and faithfulness together.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, so this is not a core pretrain read. The useful takeaway is narrower: answer-only supervision and evaluation can hide grounding failures, especially in long, multi-page, multilingual document settings. For researchers interested in document-native MLLM pretraining, visual-text alignment, or retrieval-grounded post-training, the benchmark offers a stricter target for supervision and evaluation. The contribution is mainly in benchmark design, not in modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is a benchmark and metric suite. On the data side, the authors start from more than 100 million raw PDFs, down-select roughly 250k candidates through stratified sampling, then apply a two-stage MLLM-based annotation process for domain and subcategory classification. The final benchmark contains 711 documents spanning 7 domains, 30 subcategories, and 2 languages, with 1,897 questions and an average document length of 40.6 pages.

For annotation, they build an automated pipeline combining document parsers and MLLMs to generate questions, answers, and fine-grained evidence regions. The goal is scalability and consistency, since manual box-level annotation over long PDFs is expensive and noisy. On the evaluation side, they introduce traceability metrics. The central one is Strict Attributed Accuracy, which only gives credit when both the answer and the cited evidence are correct. Additional metrics include Recall for evidence coverage and Relevance for logical alignment between cited regions and the answer.

Methodologically, this is a benchmark paper that operationalizes faithful evidence attribution rather than proposing a new document modeling architecture or a new pretraining objective.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are primarily an audit of existing MLLMs rather than a new algorithmic result. The authors evaluate 20 mainstream models and identify a recurring failure mode they call Attribution Hallucination: the model gives the correct textual answer but points to the wrong evidence region. The headline number is that Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview reaches about 76.0 Strict Attributed Accuracy, while leading open-source models remain below 25.0. The main message is not who ranks first, but how much answer-only evaluation overestimates reliability.

Dataset statistics are also part of the empirical contribution: 711 PDFs, 1,897 questions, 7 domains, 30 subcategories, 2 languages, and an average of 40.6 pages per document. The benchmark is designed to balance document count, length, and domain diversity so that it better reflects realistic document intelligence settings.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper for a pretraining-oriented reader. Start with the introduction to understand the exact evaluation gap it addresses. Then read the benchmark construction and metric sections, focusing on the automated annotation pipeline, the definition of element-level citations, and how Strict Attributed Accuracy is computed. Finally, inspect the main result table and compare answer accuracy against SAA.

If your focus is pretraining, around 20 minutes is enough to extract the useful part. Only go deeper into the appendix if you care about document grounding, long-document alignment supervision, or citation-aware post-training for MLLMs.

recommendation.zh: 把“引用是否对”从口号变成可量化指标，适合用来检验你家 VLM 的 grounding 训练是否真有效；只看评测协议和错误类型统计就够。
recommendation.en: It turns citation fidelity into a measurable target; use it to sanity-check whether your VLM grounding training actually works—skim the eval protocol and error breakdowns.

paper.title: 20/20 Vision Language Models: A Prescription for Better VLMs through Data Curation Alone
paper.abstract: Data curation has shifted the quality-compute frontier for language-model and contrastive image-text pretraining, but its role for vision-language models (VLMs) is far less established. We ask how far data curation alone can take VLM performance, holding architecture, training recipe, and compute fixed and varying only the training data. Our pipeline, applied to the MAmmoTH-VL single-image subset, lifts performance by +11.7pp on average across 20 public VLM benchmarks (spanning grounding, VQA, O

summary.core_problem: 在 VLM 预训练里，“只改数据、不改模型/训练配方/算力”到底能把能力推到哪里、能否系统性提升而不是只在少数任务上变好。论文把数据当作一等设计变量，要求在严格 matched-compute 条件下给出可复现的增益，并回答：哪些数据处理环节（去重、过滤、配比、合成）对哪些能力轴最关键，以及这些增益是否稳健（OOD、seed、上下文长度、开放式交互）。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献是把 VLM 的“数据策展”从零散技巧拉到可度量、可组合、可对照的工程闭环：在 1B/2B/4B 三个尺度上，单靠数据就能把 cost-quality Pareto 明显外推，并在很大程度上缩小与“更大算力+重度 post-train（SFT/RL）”公开模型的差距。更关键的是它展示了数据策展不仅提升均值，还显著降低 seed 方差、改善 OOD 与开放式行为（更具体、更诚实、拒答更少），这对后续做 scaling law、数据配比、以及 pretrain↔posttrain 接口设计都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是一个端到端的数据策展流水线，核心点在“联合（joint）”与“目标分布匹配（target-distribution matching）”。
1) 联合去重：不是只做文本去重或图像去重，而是做跨模态的 joint image-and-text dedup，减少同图多文、同文多图、以及模板化网页带来的重复信号，目标是降低有效 token/样本的冗余，提高梯度多样性。
2) 联合过滤：同时对图像与文本做质量过滤，而不是只用 caption 质量或只用图像美学分数。过滤目标更偏“训练信号可学习性”：可读 OCR、描述与图像一致性、噪声/水印/拼贴、低信息量 caption 等。
3) 配比设计：用 target-distribution matching 让训练混合更贴近评测/真实使用分布（论文把能力拆成多个轴：OCR/文档、图表、数学、计数、空间/3D、品牌识别、caption、VQA、grounding、多图推理等），避免单一 web 图文对把模型推向“泛描述”而缺少结构化与符号密集能力。
4) 合成数据：同时使用 task-agnostic 与 task-specific synthetic data。前者更像“补足长尾视觉语言现象”的通用增强（例如更清晰的描述、更规范的 OCR 表达），后者更像“对齐某些能力轴的监督形状”（例如图表/数学/计数/品牌等更可控的样式）。论文的主张是：单点改进（只去重/只过滤/只合成）容易把增益局限在局部能力；把这些环节组合起来，才能在 20 个公开 benchmark 与 DatBench 的多轴评测上形成一致提升。
5) 严格对照：架构固定为 Qwen3 LM（1B/2B/4B）+ SigLIP2 视觉编码器，训练配方与算力固定；baseline 用同一来源的未策展数据（MAmmoTH-VL-12M 的 single-image 10M 子集），只替换数据版本。并对 baseline 与 curated 都做同等的多模态去污染（decontamination），避免“数据更干净所以更像测试集”的伪增益。
summary.experiments:
核心结果围绕“同算力、只改数据”的增益与稳健性：
- 20 个公开 VLM benchmark 平均提升：1B +13.0pp，2B +11.7pp，4B +14.0pp（论文强调每个尺度都 Pareto-dominant）。
- DatBench 九个能力轴平均提升：2B +11.3pp，并且随规模增大增益更明显（说明策展后的数据更能被更大模型利用，符合数据质量提升后 scaling 更顺的直觉）。
- OOD：9-eval OOD 平均在 2B 上 +7.2pp。并且出现“训练中缺失能力也提升”的现象：例如 BLINK 的 multi-image reasoning 总体 +3.09pp，其中 Visual_Correspondence +11.8pp（尽管它需要跨图对应关系）。这更像是表征与对齐质量提升带来的迁移，而不是记忆。
- 稳定性：跨 seed 的按能力统计标准差从 2.47pp 降到 0.82pp（约 67% 降幅），说明策展不仅提高均值，也减少训练不确定性/坏种子。
- 上下文长度：从 4k 到 16k 的 context sweep 下优势保持，暗示增益不是靠某个特定长度的“提示工程式”偶然。
- 开放式交互：约 1100 条开放式查询（OCR、品牌/IP 识别、场景描述、拒答校准等）上，curated 2B 更具体、更诚实，且对 benign query 拒答更少；同时回答更简洁。论文把这作为“超出 benchmark 的行为质量”证据。
- 与强参考模型对比：在最多约 150× 更少训练算力、且不做重度 post-training 的前提下，curated 模型在多项评测上逼近（或部分接近）同尺度的公开强模型（Qwen3-VL、InternVL3/3.5、Qwen3.5 等）。这里的关键点不是“超过谁”，而是把差距的主要来源之一明确指向数据，而非必须依赖 RL/SFT 才能获得的能力。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议按“可复用的方法论”来读：
- 先看 Figure 1（cost-quality Pareto）与 §4 的主结果表：确认在 1B/2B/4B 三个尺度上增益是否一致，以及哪些能力轴贡献最大。
- 重点读数据流水线的细节描述与 Appendix A 的 multimodal decontamination：这决定了结论是否可信、是否能复现到你自己的数据管线。
- 读 §5（seed 方差与 context length sweep）：这是少见的“数据策展影响训练稳定性”的证据，适合对接你自己的训练动态分析（loss spikes、坏种子、数据分布漂移）。
- 读 §6 的开放式评估设置：看它如何把“更诚实/更具体/更少拒答”操作化，哪些失败案例仍然存在。
- 如果时间有限：主文 §4-§6 + Appendix A（去污染）优先；如果要落地：把 joint 去重/过滤的判据与 target-distribution matching 的实现细节抠清楚。

summary_en.core_problem: How far can VLM capability be improved by data curation alone—while holding architecture, training recipe, and compute strictly fixed—and whether such gains are broad (many capability axes), robust (OOD, seeds, context length), and reflected in open-ended behavior rather than only benchmark cherry-picks.
summary_en.importance: It makes “data” a first-class design axis for VLM pretraining under matched-compute controls. The paper shows large, consistent Pareto shifts at 1B/2B/4B purely from curation, narrowing the gap to heavily post-trained public VLMs that used far more compute. A notable pretraining-relevant takeaway is variance reduction: curation improves mean accuracy and substantially reduces seed sensitivity, which directly connects to training dynamics and reproducibility concerns in large-scale pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
An end-to-end curation pipeline that composes multiple levers instead of isolating one:
- Joint multimodal deduplication: removes redundancy across image-text pairs (not just text-only or image-only), targeting higher effective sample diversity.
- Joint image-and-text filtering: quality filtering based on learnability and alignment (e.g., caption-image consistency, OCR readability, low-information captions, noisy/watermarked images).
- Mixture design via target-distribution matching: adjusts the training mix to better cover capability axes (OCR/docs, charts, math, counting, spatial/3D, branding, captioning, VQA, grounding, etc.), mitigating the “generic web caption” bias.
- Synthetic data: both task-agnostic and task-specific generation to fill long-tail phenomena and to shape supervision for harder axes.
- Strict controls: fixed backbone/vision encoder (Qwen3 LM + SigLIP2), fixed compute and recipe; baseline uses the same source dataset without curation. Both baseline and curated runs undergo the same multimodal decontamination to reduce test leakage confounds.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported outcomes (post-decontamination):
- Average over 20 public VLM benchmarks: +13.0pp (1B), +11.7pp (2B), +14.0pp (4B).
- DatBench (9 capability axes): +11.3pp at 2B, with gains increasing with scale.
- OOD (9-eval average): +7.2pp at 2B.
- Transfer to “absent-in-training” capability: BLINK multi-image reasoning +3.09pp overall; Visual_Correspondence +11.8pp.
- Robustness: per-capability std across seeds drops from 2.47pp to 0.82pp (~67% reduction). Advantage persists across a 4k→16k context-length sweep.
- Open-ended evaluation (~1,100 prompts): curated 2B is more specific and more honest, with fewer benign refusals and more concise answers.
- Compute positioning: curated models approach strong public references (e.g., Qwen3-VL / InternVL3/3.5 / Qwen3.5 at similar scales) despite using up to ~150× less training compute and without extensive post-training.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it like a reproducible pretraining study:
- Start with the Pareto figure and the main §4 tables to verify consistency across scales and capability axes.
- Prioritize the curation pipeline details and Appendix A (multimodal decontamination); this is where the causal claim “data alone” stands or falls.
- Study §5 for seed-variance reduction and context-length robustness—useful if you care about training stability and scaling behavior.
- Skim §6 to see how they operationalize open-ended behavior quality beyond benchmarks.
- If time-boxed: §4–§6 + Appendix A.

recommendation.zh: 必须读数据筛选和能力轴设计；若实验控制干净，它会改变小中型 VLM 预训练里 compute 与 data quality 的权重。
recommendation.en: Read the curation pipeline and capability axes; if the controls are clean, it shifts the compute-versus-data-quality prior for small and mid-sized VLM pretraining.

paper.title: Vision2Code: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Evaluating Image-to-Code Generation
paper.abstract: Image-to-code generation tests whether a vision-language model (VLM) can recover the structure of an image enough to express it as executable code. Existing benchmarks either focus on narrow visual domains, depend on paired executable reference code, or rely on generic rubrics that miss domain-specific reconstruction errors. We introduce Vision2Code, a reference-code-free benchmark and evaluation framework for multi-domain image-to-code generation. Vision2Code contains 2,169 test examples from 1

summary.core_problem: 现有图像转代码benchmark覆盖视觉域窄、依赖配对参考代码、通用评估指标遗漏域特定重构错误，无法准确评测VLM的代码生成能力
summary.importance: 基准贡献，构建了首个无参考代码的多域图像转代码评测基准，提出了与人类判断对齐度更高的评估协议
summary.technical_approach: 整合15个源数据集共2169个测试样本，覆盖图表、几何、科学图像、文档、3D场景等6大类；模型生成代码后渲染为图像，用带领域定制规则的VLM打分器评估质量，同时分离代码执行失败与重构质量的诊断指标
summary.experiments: 人工验证显示评估协议与人类判断对齐度优于现有方法，完成了多个主流SOTA VLM的图像转代码能力基准测试
summary.authors_note: 杜克大学团队，Bhuwan Dhingra为NLP与多模态领域知名研究者，长期从事语义理解相关研究

summary_en.core_problem: Existing image-to-code benchmarks have narrow visual domain coverage, rely on paired reference code, and generic metrics miss domain-specific reconstruction errors, failing to accurately evaluate VLM code generation capability
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, builds the first reference-free multi-domain image-to-code evaluation benchmark, proposes an evaluation protocol with higher alignment with human judgment
summary_en.technical_approach: Integrates 15 source datasets with 2169 test samples covering 6 categories including charts, geometry, scientific imagery, documents, 3D scenes; renders generated code to images, evaluates quality with VLM rater with domain-specific rubrics, and separates diagnostic metrics for code execution failures and reconstruction quality
summary_en.experiments: Human validation shows the evaluation protocol aligns better with human judgment than existing methods, completes benchmark testing of image-to-code capability for multiple mainstream SOTA VLMs
summary_en.authors_note: Duke University team, Bhuwan Dhingra is a well-known researcher in NLP and multimodal fields, focusing on semantic understanding research

recommendation.zh: 作为图像转代码方向的基准资源，仅做评测参考备查，无需精读正文
recommendation.en: Serves as a benchmark reference for image-to-code tasks, only for evaluation reference, no need for in-depth reading

paper.title: Do Joint Audio-Video Generation Models Understand Physics?
paper.abstract: Joint audio-video generation models are rapidly approaching professional production quality, raising a central question: do they understand audio-visual physics, or merely generate plausible sounds and frames that violate real-world consistency? We introduce AV-Phys Bench, a benchmark for evaluating physical commonsense in joint audio-video generation. AV-Phys Bench tests models across three scene categories: Steady State, Event Transition, and Environment Transition. It covers physics-grounded

summary.core_problem: 评估联合音视频生成模型是否真正满足物理一致性，而不只是生成语义上 plausible 的画面和声音。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 Benchmark。AV-Phys Bench 把音视频生成从单模态质量、语义对齐，推进到跨模态物理常识评估，尤其加入了刻意违反物理规律的 Anti-AV-Physics prompts，用来测试模型是否会盲从提示。
summary.technical_approach: 构建三类场景：Steady State、Event Transition、Environment Transition，并细分为现实场景中的物理子类。每个生成结果从五个维度打分：视觉语义遵循、音频语义遵循、视觉物理常识、音频物理常识、跨模态物理常识。
summary.experiments: 评测了 3 个闭源模型和 4 个开源模型。摘要报告 Seedance 2.0 综合表现最好，但所有模型距离稳定的物理理解仍有明显差距，尤其在跨模态物理一致性和反物理提示抵抗上不稳。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Texas at Dallas、University of Washington、University of California。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether joint audio-video generation models obey physical consistency, rather than merely producing plausible-looking videos and sounds.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a benchmark. AV-Phys Bench shifts evaluation from perceptual quality and semantic alignment toward audio-visual physical commonsense, including Anti-AV-Physics prompts that deliberately request impossible cross-modal behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark covers three scene types: Steady State, Event Transition, and Environment Transition. Generations are scored along five axes: visual semantic adherence, audio semantic adherence, visual physical commonsense, audio physical commonsense, and cross-modal physical commonsense.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate three proprietary and four open-source joint audio-video generation models. Seedance 2.0 performs best overall in the reported results, but all models remain far from robust physical understanding, especially under cross-modal and anti-physics conditions.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Texas at Dallas, University of Washington, and University of California.

recommendation.zh: 作为音视频生成评测可备查；对 pretrain 的价值主要在反物理 prompt 设计，不必读完整方法。
recommendation.en: Useful as an audio-video generation benchmark reference; for pretraining work, the main signal is the anti-physics prompt design, not the full paper.

paper.title: ICU-Bench:Benchmarking Continual Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across many domains, their training on large-scale multimodal datasets raises serious privacy concerns, making effective machine unlearning increasingly necessary. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on static or short-sequence settings, offering limited support for evaluating continual privacy deletion requests in realistic deployments. To bridge this gap, we introduce ICU-Bench, a continual multimodal unl

summary.core_problem: 为多模态大模型的连续隐私删除请求建立 benchmark，评估模型在多轮 unlearning 后的遗忘、保留和稳定性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MLLM unlearning benchmark。它把评测从静态一次性遗忘扩展到 continual unlearning，更接近部署中的反复删除请求；但数据规模较小且集中在隐私文档场景，对基座训练启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: ICU-Bench 基于 privacy-critical document data 构造，包含医疗报告和劳动合同两个文档域。它设计 100 个 forget tasks，并引入连续遗忘指标，覆盖遗忘效果、历史遗忘保持、保留效用和跨轮稳定性。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 1,000 个隐私敏感 profile、9,500 张图像、16,000 个问答对和 100 个遗忘任务。摘要提到进行了系统实验，但未给出被测 MLLM 名称、baseline、模型规模或具体数值结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自西安电子科技大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for continual privacy deletion requests in MLLMs, evaluating forgetting, retention, and stability over multiple unlearning rounds.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution for MLLM unlearning. It extends evaluation from static one-shot forgetting to continual unlearning, which is closer to deployed deletion requests, though the dataset is small and document-domain-specific.
summary_en.technical_approach: ICU-Bench is built from privacy-critical document data across medical reports and labor contracts. It defines 100 forget tasks and introduces metrics for forgetting effectiveness, preservation of historical forgetting, retained utility, and stability across continual unlearning.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,000 privacy-sensitive profiles, 9,500 images, 16,000 QA pairs, and 100 forget tasks. The abstract mentions extensive experiments but does not provide evaluated MLLM names, baselines, model sizes, or numerical outcomes.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Xidian University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 MLLM unlearning 评测备查即可；连续删除设定有用，但数据域窄，别把结论外推到通用能力。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an MLLM-unlearning evaluation reference; the continual deletion setup is useful, but the narrow document domain limits generalization.

paper.title: Towards Annotation-Free Validation of MLLMs: A Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric
paper.abstract: Dominant accuracy evaluation might reward unwarranted guessing of Large Language Models, and it might not be applicable to novel tasks for model validation without ground-truth (gt) annotation. Based on basic logic principle, we propose a novel framework to evaluate the vision-language logical consistency of MLLMs on both sufficient and necessary cause-effect relations. We define Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric (VL-LCM) on traditional MC-VQA tests, and recent NaturalBench tests withou

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型（MLLM）准确率评估依赖人工标注，易奖励模型无依据猜答案，无法适配无标注新任务的验证需求。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需标注的MLLM逻辑一致性评估框架，填补无标注场景下MLLM验证能力的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 基于因果关系的充分性、必要性逻辑原则，定义视觉语言逻辑一致性指标VL-LCM，可同时适配传统MC-VQA测试与无标注NaturalBench测试。
summary.experiments: 在MMMU、NaturalBench基准上评测4个系列共11个开源MLLM，发现现有模型准确率提升的同时逻辑一致性严重滞后，验证了VL-LCM与标注指标的高相关性。
summary.authors_note: 新加坡A*STAR信息通信研究院（I2R）团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM accuracy evaluation relies on human annotations, tends to reward unwarranted guessing, and cannot support model validation on novel tasks without ground truth.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes an annotation-free MLLM logical consistency evaluation framework, fills the gap of MLLM validation in unlabeled scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on logical principles of sufficiency and necessity in causal relations, defines Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric (VL-LCM) compatible with both traditional MC-VQA and unlabeled NaturalBench tests.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 11 open-source MLLMs from 4 families on MMMU and NaturalBench, finds logical consistency lags far behind accuracy improvement, and validates high correlation between VL-LCM and annotation-based metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Institute for Infocomm Research (I2R), A*STAR, Singapore

recommendation.zh: 多模态评估的增量方法，仅作为无标注验证场景的备选方案备查，不需要读正文。
recommendation.en: Incremental multimodal evaluation method, only for reference in annotation-free validation scenarios, no need to read full text.

institutions: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)

paper.title: How Far Are VLMs from Privacy Awareness in the Physical World? An Empirical Study
paper.abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous cognitive cores for embodied assistants, evaluating their privacy awareness in physical environments becomes critical. Unlike digital chatbots, these agents operate in intimate spaces, such as homes and hospitals, where they possess the physical agency to observe and manipulate privacy-sensitive information and artifacts. However, current benchmarks remain limited to unimodal, text-based representations that cannot capture

summary.core_problem: 评估 VLM 在真实物理环境中是否具备隐私意识，包括识别敏感物品、理解社交语境变化，以及在用户命令和隐私约束冲突时做出合适判断。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态/具身 VLM 的隐私评测框架。它不是模型预训练方法，但能暴露当前 VLM 在物理世界部署中的安全与对齐缺口，尤其是从纯文本隐私评测扩展到音视频交互场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ImmersedPrivacy，一个基于 Unity 的交互式音视频评测环境。评测分为三个递进层级：在杂乱场景中识别敏感物品，随社交上下文变化调整隐私判断，以及处理显式指令与隐含隐私约束之间的冲突。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出被测 VLM 名单、场景数量、任务样本量或具体准确率。可确认实验对象是多模态模型在模拟物理环境中的交互式隐私意识，而非静态图文问答。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Georgia Institute of Technology；从给定信息无法确认是否有大模型预训练代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether VLMs have privacy awareness in physical environments, including sensitive-object recognition, social-context adaptation, and resolving conflicts between explicit commands and inferred privacy constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a privacy benchmark for multimodal and embodied VLMs. It is not a pretraining method, but it exposes safety and alignment gaps for physical-world deployment, moving beyond text-only privacy evaluation into audiovisual interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces ImmersedPrivacy, an interactive audiovisual evaluation framework built with a Unity simulator. The benchmark has three progressive tiers: identifying sensitive items in cluttered scenes, adapting to changing social context, and handling conflicts between direct instructions and implicit privacy constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list evaluated VLMs, scene counts, task volume, or quantitative accuracy. The confirmed setup is interactive privacy evaluation in simulated physical environments rather than static image-text QA.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Georgia Institute of Technology; the provided metadata does not establish a specific foundation-model pretraining track record.

recommendation.zh: VLM 预训练研究只需扫 benchmark 设计；它测的是部署语境缺口，不太会给训练目标带来直接新信号。
recommendation.en: For VLM pretraining, skim the benchmark design only; it measures deployment-context gaps rather than giving a direct new training signal.

paper.title: Benchmarking LLMs on the Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB)
paper.abstract: The Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB) has emerged as a standard for evaluating the functional breadth of audio models. While initial baselines focused on specialized encoders, the shift toward "audio-native" Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests a new paradigm where a single multimodal backbone may replace complex, task-specific pipelines. This paper provides a rigorous empirical evaluation of leading LLMs - including members from the Gemini and GPT families - across the eight core MSEB c

summary.core_problem: 评估音频原生 LLM 与级联式音频系统在通用声音表征基准 MSEB 上的能力差距，判断统一多模态骨干是否已能替代专用音频管线。
summary.importance: 价值主要在 benchmark 和负结果：它没有证明 audio-native LLM 已经赢，也没有给出单一路线的确定答案。这对做统一多模态预训练的人有参考意义，因为它提醒大家不要把“统一 backbone”当成已成立结论。
summary.technical_approach: 在 MSEB 的八类核心能力上系统评测多种领先 LLM，包括 Gemini 和 GPT 家族，比较音频输入下的表现、鲁棒性以及与文本能力的 parity。方法上不是新模型，而是较大规模的经验性对比分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据量和详细数值，但明确指出仍存在明显 modality gap，且关于 audio-native 与 cascaded 架构谁更优，证据并不收敛；最终选择依赖延迟、成本和推理深度等约束。更像评测论文而非方法论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单包含 Cyril Allauzen、Georg Heigold、Ehsan Variani 等，属于语音/音频建模与评测方向较有代表性的研究者；摘要未明确机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether audio-native LLMs can match or replace cascaded audio systems on the Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark, and how far they are from text-level parity.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is as a benchmark with a useful negative result: it does not show that audio-native LLMs have clearly won, nor that one architecture is universally best. That matters for researchers working on unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It conducts a broad empirical evaluation of leading LLMs, including Gemini and GPT-family models, across the eight core MSEB capabilities, comparing audio performance, robustness, and audio-text parity. This is an evaluation study rather than a new modeling method.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or detailed numbers, but it clearly states that a substantial modality gap remains and that evidence for an optimal modeling approach is inconclusive. The architecture choice depends on latency, cost, and reasoning-depth constraints.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Cyril Allauzen, Georg Heigold, and Ehsan Variani, who are recognizable names in speech/audio modeling and evaluation; the abstract does not explicitly state the institution.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的价值不在结论多强，而在它没顺着行业叙事走：统一音频-文本 backbone 还没坐实，做 audio LM 的人应先看评测设定和失败面。
recommendation.en: Useful because it resists the easy 'audio-native wins' narrative; if you work on audio LMs, read the evaluation setup and failure modes, not just the headline.

paper.title: VEBench:Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Real-World Video Editing
paper.abstract: Real-world video editing demands not only expert knowledge of cinematic techniques but also multimodal reasoning to select, align, and combine footage into coherent narratives. While recent Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have shown remarkable progress in general video understanding, their abilities in multi-video reasoning and operational editing workflows remain largely unexplored. We introduce VEBENCH, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate both editing knowledge understanding

summary.core_problem: 评测大多模态模型在真实视频编辑场景中的能力缺口，尤其是多视频推理、编辑知识理解和操作级决策。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是 benchmark。它不直接提出预训练新方法，但把视频理解从单视频问答推进到更接近生产流程的编辑任务，对多模态统一建模的数据与评测设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VEBench，构建 3.9K 条高质量编辑视频和 3,080 组人工核验 QA，覆盖两类任务：编辑技术识别与编辑操作模拟。数据通过三轮 human-AI 协作标注，强调时间对齐和语义一致性。
summary.experiments: 基准包含超过 257 小时视频，评测对象应是现有 LMM/LVLM。摘要强调模型在真实编辑工作流上的不足，但未给出具体领先模型、分数区间或误差分解。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Central Florida 等机构。摘要中未能确认更强的基座模型团队背景；若确有 Cohere 参与，需以正式作者单位页为准。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper benchmarks large multimodal models on real-world video editing, focusing on gaps in multi-video reasoning, editing knowledge, and operation-level decision making.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It does not introduce a new pretraining method, but it pushes video evaluation beyond single-video QA toward workflow-like editing tasks, which is useful for multimodal data and evaluation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces VEBench, a benchmark with 3.9K edited videos and 3,080 human-verified QA pairs, covering editing-technique recognition and editing-operation simulation. The dataset is built with a three-round human-AI annotation pipeline emphasizing temporal precision and semantic consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark spans over 257 hours of video and likely evaluates current LMM/LVLM systems. The abstract highlights substantial weaknesses on realistic editing workflows, but does not provide exact model rankings, score ranges, or error breakdowns.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with institutions including the University of Central Florida. The abstract alone does not confirm a major foundation-model lab involvement; any claimed Cohere connection should be verified from the official author list.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但如果你在做 native video pretrain，只看任务定义和失败案例就够了；它提醒现有视频 token/对齐目标离真实编辑还很远。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you work on native video pretraining, read the task design and failure cases only; it exposes how far current video tokens and alignment objectives are from real editing workflows.

paper.title: Decoding Scientific Experimental Images: The SPUR Benchmark for Perception, Understanding, and Reasoning
paper.abstract: We introduce SPUR, a comprehensive benchmark for scientific experimental image perception, understanding, and reasoning, comprising 4,264 question-answering (QA) pairs derived from 1,084 expert-curated images. SPUR features three key innovations: (1) Panel-Level Fine-Grained Perception: evaluating the visual perception of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) across three dimensions (numerical, morphological, and information localization) on six fine-grained panel types; (2) Cross-Panel Relat

summary.core_problem: 构建科学实验图像问答 benchmark，评估 MLLM 是否能读懂多面板实验图、定位关键信息并进行专家级证据推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/MLLM benchmark。SPUR 的价值在于把科学实验图像拆成细粒度面板感知、跨面板关系理解和实验结论推理三个层次，比普通图文 QA 更接近科研场景中的视觉证据链。
summary.technical_approach: 数据集包含 1,084 张专家筛选的科学实验图像和 4,264 个 QA 对；设计三类评测维度：数值、形态和信息定位等 panel-level perception，平均 14.3 个面板的 cross-panel relation understanding，以及覆盖五类实验范式的定性和定量 reasoning。
summary.experiments: 评估 20 个 MLLM 和 4 种 multimodal Chain-of-Thought 方法。摘要指出现有模型与人类专家表现仍有明显差距，但未给出具体模型名单、分数表和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 项目来自北京邮电大学 BUPT-Reasoning-Lab，并提供 benchmark 页面和代码仓库。

summary_en.core_problem: SPUR evaluates whether multimodal LLMs can perceive, understand, and reason over scientific experimental images with dense multi-panel structure.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM benchmark contribution. Its useful part is the decomposition into fine-grained panel perception, cross-panel relation understanding, and evidence-based expert reasoning, which is closer to scientific visual evidence use than generic image QA.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 1,084 expert-curated images and 4,264 QA pairs. It tests numerical, morphological, and localization perception over panel types, cross-panel relations in images averaging 14.3 panels, and qualitative/quantitative reasoning across five experimental paradigms.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates 20 MLLMs and four multimodal Chain-of-Thought methods. The abstract reports a substantial gap between current models and human experts, but does not provide the detailed model list or scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from BUPT-Reasoning-Lab at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, with a project page and repository.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练只给弱信号；看任务分解和错误类型即可，别把科学图 benchmark 当通用 VLM 能力结论。
recommendation.en: Weak signal for pretraining; read the task taxonomy and error breakdown, but do not over-read a scientific-image benchmark as a general VLM capability result.

paper.title: DRAGON: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Visual Reasoning over Diagrams
paper.abstract: Diagram question answering (DQA) requires models to interpret structured visual representations such as charts, maps, infographics, circuit schematics, and scientific diagrams. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) often achieve high answer accuracy on these tasks, yet correct answers do not guarantee that models ground their reasoning in the diagram regions that support the prediction. Models may instead rely on textual correlations or dataset artifacts without identifying the visual evidence re

summary.core_problem: 评估 VLM 在图表、地图、信息图、线路图和科学图示等 diagram QA 中是否真正定位到支撑答案的视觉证据，而不只是答对问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态 benchmark。它把 diagram reasoning 的评测从 answer accuracy 推进到 evidence-grounded reasoning，要求模型输出支持答案的 bounding boxes，有助于识别 VLM 依赖文本相关性或数据集 artifact 的情况。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DRAGON benchmark。给定 diagram、问题和正确答案，模型需要预测用于证明答案的视觉区域框；证据区域可能包括答案相关组件、文本标签、图例、坐标轴、连接线等。这个设置把视觉定位和推理解释绑定起来，而不是只评估最终答案。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出数据规模、模型列表或具体分数。可以确认评测对象是近期 VLM 在 diagram QA 上的 evidence grounding 能力，指标应围绕预测框与人工证据区域的一致性展开。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Arizona State University、Adobe Research 等机构；给定信息不足以确认作者在统一多模态预训练中的代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether VLMs performing diagram QA actually localize the visual evidence that supports the answer, rather than merely producing the correct answer.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal benchmark. It moves diagram reasoning evaluation beyond answer accuracy toward evidence-grounded reasoning by requiring bounding boxes for the visual regions that justify the answer.
summary_en.technical_approach: DRAGON provides a task where, given a diagram, question, and correct answer, the model must predict bounding boxes for the supporting visual elements. These may include answer-bearing components, text labels, legends, axes, connectors, and other diagram structures. The design couples visual grounding with reasoning justification.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report dataset size, evaluated model list, or quantitative scores. The evaluation targets evidence grounding in recent VLMs for diagram QA, likely measuring agreement between predicted boxes and annotated supporting regions.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Arizona State University, Adobe Research, and collaborators; the provided metadata is insufficient to identify a major unified multimodal pretraining track record.

recommendation.zh: VLM 预训练不用细读；看任务定义和错误案例即可，它能提醒图文对齐别只盯 final answer。
recommendation.en: No need to read deeply for VLM pretraining; inspect the task definition and failure cases as a reminder that alignment should not optimize only final answers.

paper.title: DualFact+: A Multimodal Fact Verification Framework for Procedural Video Understanding
paper.abstract: We introduce DualFact, a dual-layer, multimodal factuality evaluation framework for procedural video captioning. DualFact separates factual correctness into conceptual facts, capturing abstract semantic roles (e.g., Action, Ingredient, Tool, Location), and contextual facts, capturing their grounded predicate-argument realizations in video. To support complete and role-consistent evaluation, DualFact incorporates implicit argument augmentation (VIA) and contrastive fact sets. We instantiate DualF

summary.core_problem: 评估程序性视频 caption 的事实一致性，尤其是模型是否漏掉关键动作、工具、食材、地点，以及这些角色是否和视频证据对齐。
summary.importance: 这是一个多模态事实性评测框架，贡献主要在评测粒度和诊断能力：把事实错误拆成概念层事实和上下文层事实，能比常规 caption 指标更直接暴露 VLM 在程序性视频理解中的遗漏和角色混淆。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DualFact 双层框架：概念事实捕获抽象语义角色， contextual facts 捕获视频中实际落地的谓词-论元关系；引入 implicit argument augmentation 补全隐含论元，并构造 contrastive fact sets。框架有 DualFact-T 和 DualFact-V 两种模式，分别用文本证据和视频视觉证据做验证。
summary.experiments: 在 YouCook3-Fact 和 CraftBench-Fact 上评测。摘要没有给出模型参数量或具体提升数值，但报告称 DualFact 与人工事实性判断的相关性强于标准指标，尤其是在 contextual facts 上；同时发现现有多模态语言模型生成的 caption 流畅但常有事实不完整和角色级不一致。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence, DFKI。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets factuality evaluation for procedural video captioning, focusing on whether generated captions preserve key actions, ingredients, tools, locations, and their grounded role relations.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation framework rather than a new foundation model. The useful part is the finer diagnostic split between conceptual and contextual facts, which makes omissions and role-level inconsistencies more visible than standard caption metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: DualFact separates factuality into conceptual facts over abstract semantic roles and contextual facts over grounded predicate-argument realizations. It adds implicit argument augmentation and contrastive fact sets, and instantiates two verification modes: DualFact-T against textual evidence and DualFact-V against video-grounded visual evidence.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on YouCook3-Fact and CraftBench-Fact. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact numerical gains, but states that DualFact correlates better with human factuality judgments than standard metrics, especially for contextual facts, and diagnoses fluent but incomplete captions from current multimodal language models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence, DFKI.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不直接，但做视频-文本对齐数据清洗时可借鉴事实分解；看框架定义和相关性实验即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the fact decomposition is useful for video-text data filtering; read the framework definition and correlation results only.

institutions: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)

paper.title: DO-Bench: An Attributable Benchmark for Diagnosing Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Object level hallucination remains a central reliability challenge for vision language models (VLMs), particularly in binary object existence verification. Existing benchmarks emphasize aggregate accuracy but rarely disentangle whether errors stem from perceptual limitations or from the influence of contextual textual priors, leaving underlying failure mechanisms ambiguous. We introduce DO-Bench, a controlled diagnostic benchmark that isolates these sources through structured multimodal interven

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM的物体幻觉评测基准仅输出聚合准确率，无法区分错误来源于感知能力不足还是上下文文本先验的误导，无法定位底层失效机制。
summary.importance: 提供了可归因的物体幻觉诊断工具，能够拆解幻觉的不同成因，为VLM预训练和对齐阶段的幻觉缓解方案设计提供明确的优化方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DO-Bench诊断基准，通过同一场景下的受控干预隔离两个影响维度：1）先验Override维度：固定图像输入，逐步增强上下文文本先验强度，测试模型抵抗先验误导的能力；2）感知受限维度：固定文本上下文，通过原图、簇视图、裁剪视图的层级视觉输入逐步提升目标物体的视觉显著性，测试模型的感知恢复能力。配套设计机制感知的评测指标，跟踪干预下的决策变化趋势，而非仅输出聚合正确率。
summary.experiments: 在LLaVA-v1.5-7B和InstructBLIP-7B上的预实验显示，大量漏报错误在目标视觉证据更易获取时可恢复，而大量正确的负向判断在上下文先验足够强时会被推翻。跨多个开源闭源VLM的评测显示，模型缩放可以提升强视觉证据下的感知恢复能力，但不会统一降低对上下文文本先验的敏感性，两类能力的提升轨迹存在分化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注Introduction部分的幻觉成因拆解逻辑和DO-Bench的两个干预维度设计，预计阅读时间12分钟；如果关注VLM幻觉缓解方案，可进一步阅读指标设计和模型评测结果部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing object hallucination evaluation benchmarks for vision-language models (VLMs) only output aggregate accuracy, which cannot distinguish whether errors come from insufficient perceptual ability or misleading contextual textual priors, making it impossible to locate underlying failure mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: It provides an attributable diagnostic tool for object hallucination, which can disassemble different causes of hallucination, and offers clear optimization directions for hallucination mitigation design in VLM pre-training and alignment stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes DO-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that isolates two influencing dimensions through controlled interventions on the same scene: 1) Prior-Override dimension: fix the image input, gradually increase the strength of contextual textual priors to test the model's resistance to prior misleading; 2) Perception-Limited dimension: fix the textual context, gradually improve the visual salience of the target object through hierarchical visual inputs (full scene, cluster view, crop view) to test the model's perceptual recoverability. It also designs mechanism-aware evaluation metrics that track decision change trends under interventions instead of only outputting aggregate accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: Preliminary experiments on LLaVA-v1.5-7B and InstructBLIP-7B show that a large fraction of false negative errors are recoverable when target visual evidence becomes more accessible, while a substantial portion of correct negative decisions are overturned when contextual prior strength is sufficiently high. Evaluation across multiple open-source and closed-source VLMs shows that model scaling improves perceptual recoverability under stronger visual evidence, but does not uniformly reduce sensitivity to contextual textual priors, with divergent improvement trajectories for the two capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the hallucination cause disassembly logic in the Introduction section and the design of the two intervention dimensions of DO-Bench, expected reading time 12 minutes. If you focus on VLM hallucination mitigation solutions, you can further read the metric design and model evaluation result sections.

recommendation.zh: 这个 benchmark 的价值在错误归因设计；直接看任务构造和主表，能帮判断 VLM 幻觉是语言先验还是视觉 token 不够。
recommendation.en: The value is the attribution design; read the task construction and main table to separate language-prior failures from weak visual grounding.

paper.title: Revisiting Greedy Decoding for Visual Question Answering: A Calibration Perspective
paper.abstract: Stochastic sampling strategies are widely adopted in large language models (LLMs) to balance output coherence and diversity. These heuristics are often inherited in Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) without task-specific justification. However, we contend that stochastic decoding can be suboptimal for Visual Question Answering (VQA). VQA is a closed-ended task with head-heavy answer distributions where uncertainty is usually epistemic, arising from missing or ambiguous visual evidence rather than plausibl

summary.core_problem: 重新审视 VQA 中默认沿用文本生成采样策略的做法，判断贪心解码是否在校准良好的闭集问答任务上更合适。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是解码层面的任务适配与校准分析，不是预训练方法创新。对做多模态模型评测和推理策略选择的人有参考价值，尤其是提醒不要把开放式生成的 decoding 习惯直接搬到 VQA。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从模型校准角度形式化预测准确率与解码策略的关系，给出贪心解码最优的充分条件，并在此基础上讨论多模态推理模型的 greedy decoding 变体。核心不是改模型，而是给出何时应当用 greedy 而不是 stochastic sampling 的判据。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个 VQA benchmark 上，greedy decoding 优于随机采样；同时提出面向 reasoning models 的 greedy decoding 方案，优于标准 greedy 和 stochastic sampling。摘要未给出模型规模、具体基线和提升幅度，因此更适合作为现象性结论看待。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ETH 和 MBZUAI。机构较强，但从摘要看工作重心是 VQA 推理与解码分析，而非基座预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: It revisits whether stochastic decoding, inherited from text generation, is actually appropriate for VQA, and argues that greedy decoding can be preferable under calibration assumptions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about decoding strategy and calibration analysis rather than pretraining. It is useful for multimodal evaluation and inference practice, especially as a warning against blindly reusing open-ended generation heuristics for closed-ended VQA.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes the link between calibration and predictive accuracy, derives sufficient conditions under which greedy decoding is optimal, and extends the idea to reasoning-oriented multimodal models. The main novelty is a decision criterion for decoding, not a new model.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims greedy decoding outperforms stochastic sampling across multiple VQA benchmarks, and that a reasoning-model variant beats both standard greedy and stochastic decoding. No model sizes or exact gains are given in the abstract, so treat it as a targeted empirical finding.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from ETH and MBZUAI. Strong institutions, but the paper is centered on VQA decoding and calibration rather than foundation-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这是任务解码 paper，不改 pretrain prior；若你管 VLM eval，只看理论条件和主表，别把 sampling 当默认设置。
recommendation.en: This does not move pretraining priors, but it is a useful eval paper: read the calibration condition and the main table, then stop defaulting to sampling for VQA.

paper.title: Source-Modality Monitoring in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: We define and investigate source-modality monitoring -- the ability of multimodal models to track and communicate the input source from which pieces of information originate. We consider source-modality monitoring as an instance of the more general binding problem, and evaluate the extent to which models exploit syntactic vs. semantic signals in order to bind words like image in a user-provided prompt to specific components of their input and context (i.e., actual images). Across experiments spa

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 VLM 是否能追踪信息来自哪种输入源，例如图像还是文字说明。核心问题是：当用户问“image 里有什么”或“caption 说了什么”时，模型是依赖显式模态标记完成绑定，还是依赖图像和文本内容本身的分布与语义特征。
summary.importance: 对多模态预训练的启发在于数据格式和模态标记的作用。结果显示，显式 wrapper tokens 有帮助，但模型并不只做符号绑定；当图像内容和文本内容分布差异很大时，语义和分布线索往往更强。这提示多模态模型的 source binding 不是单靠特殊 token 就能保证的能力，预训练时的模态边界、内容冲突样本、跨源检索任务和指令格式都可能影响模型对“信息来源”的监控能力。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 source-modality monitoring 形式化为一种 binding 问题：模型需要把内容绑定到 image、caption、text 等抽象角色上。评测任务采用不一致的 image-caption pair。图像和 caption 描述互相冲突，模型被要求只回答指定来源的信息。这样可以排除单纯依赖世界知识或总体模态偏好的情况。方法上还控制了输入顺序：图像在前和文本在前两种顺序都评估，并取平均。随后通过扰动模态标记来区分语法线索和语义线索的影响；再通过对 marker 表示和 content 表示施加优化变换，测试符号提示是否足以改变模型的模态归因。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Flickr30k 和 MSCOCO 构造不一致图文对。为避免 caption 与图像真实内容仍然相近，作者用 sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 计算候选 caption 与图像原始标注的相似度，并要求相似度低于 0.2。评测覆盖 11 个开源 VLM，包含有无显式图像 wrapper tokens 的不同系统。主要发现是：许多模型能完成目标模态检索；带特殊图像标记的模型整体更好；在语法标记与内容语义发生冲突时，模型通常更受分布语义线索影响，尤其是在图像和文本差异清晰的情况下。不过，显式标记仍能提高选择性，并且经过优化的表示变换可以反转模型的模态归因，说明符号线索并非无效，只是默认情况下往往弱于内容线索。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。第 2.1 节先看清楚 target-modality retrieval task，因为这个任务设计决定了结果能否解释 source binding。第 2.2 节关注数据构造、相似度阈值和输入顺序控制。结果部分建议重点看各模型的 source-modality selectivity，以及有无 wrapper tokens 的对比。扰动实验和表示变换实验值得快速阅读，它们区分了“模型真的理解标记”与“模型按内容分布猜来源”这两种机制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether vision-language models can track the source modality of information. When asked what is in the image or what the caption says, does a model bind content to the requested source using explicit modality markers, or does it rely mainly on the distributional and semantic properties of the content itself?
summary_en.importance: The main lesson for multimodal pretraining is about modality binding and input formatting. Special wrapper tokens help, but they do not fully determine source attribution. When visual and textual contents are distributionally distinct, semantic signals often dominate symbolic markers. This matters for native multimodal training: modality delimiters, source labels, conflicting multimodal examples, and retrieval-style supervision can all affect whether the model learns to monitor where information came from.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work frames source-modality monitoring as a binding problem. The model must bind content to abstract roles such as image or caption and retrieve the content associated with the queried role. The evaluation uses inconsistent image-caption pairs: the image and the caption describe mutually exclusive content, and the prompt asks for only one source. This forces source-specific retrieval rather than generic captioning or reliance on a global modality bias. The setup also evaluates both input orders, image-first and text-first, and averages over them. Additional perturbation experiments manipulate symbolic modality markers to separate syntactic cues from semantic cues. Optimized transformations applied to marker and content representations test whether symbolic cues can actively change the model’s modality attribution.
summary_en.experiments: The datasets are built from Flickr30k and MSCOCO. Captions are mismatched with images, and a sentence embedding filter using sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 requires cosine similarity below 0.2 against the image’s ground-truth captions. The evaluation covers 11 open-source VLMs, including systems with and without explicit image wrapper tokens. Many models succeed on the target-modality retrieval task. Models with explicit wrapper tokens generally show better source selectivity. When marker cues and content cues are put in tension, distributional-semantic cues tend to dominate, especially when the modalities are clearly separable. At the same time, marker cues remain useful: representation-level transformations can reverse modality attribution, showing that symbolic information is accessible but not always the strongest default signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with Section 2.1 to understand the target-modality retrieval task, since the task design is what makes the binding claim interpretable. Then read Section 2.2 for dataset construction, the 0.2 similarity filter, model coverage, and input-order control. In the results, focus on source-modality selectivity and the comparison between models with and without wrapper tokens. The perturbation and representation-transformation experiments are the most useful parts for understanding whether models follow explicit markers or infer source from content statistics.

recommendation.zh: 看任务设计和 11 个 VLM 的错误模式；对 native multimodal pretrain 的 binding loss 有参考。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and 11-model error patterns; they are relevant when thinking about binding losses for native multimodal pretraining.

summary.core_problem: 检验前沿 LLM 在城市与地点感知任务中是否真的具有文化中立性，以及默认“中性提示”是否带有隐含文化基线。
summary.importance: 这是偏机制/偏见分析工作，不直接推进预训练方法，但对数据分布、文化偏置和多模态世界知识表征有提醒价值。贡献类型主要是分析与评测设计，而不是新训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用全球均衡的街景样本，设计中性提示和不同地区文化立场提示，比较开放式描述与结构化地点判断的变化；再与区域性 human text-image benchmark 对照，分析模型默认参考系与文化提示带来的偏移。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是 frontier LLMs，摘要未给出具体模型名单与规模。主要发现包括：所谓 neutral prompt 在实践中并不真正中性；欧洲和北美提示更接近默认基线；文化提示会改变情感评价，并在部分身份上产生 ingroup preference；文化上更接近的提示可提升与区域人类描述的一致性。
summary.authors_note: 涉及清华大学、UT Austin 等机构。更接近社会技术分析与模型偏见研究，不是典型基座训练论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It tests whether frontier LLMs are culturally neutral when describing and judging cities, and whether the default 'neutral' prompt actually encodes a hidden cultural baseline.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/bias analysis paper rather than a pretraining-method paper. It is useful mainly as a reminder about data distribution, cultural priors, and multimodal world-model bias.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses a globally balanced street-view sample, compares neutral prompts against prompts invoking different regional cultural standpoints, and evaluates both open-ended descriptions and structured place judgments. It also compares outputs against regional human text-image benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions frontier LLMs but does not specify model names or scales. Main findings: the neutral condition is not neutral in practice; Europe/North America prompts stay closer to the baseline; cultural prompting shifts affective judgments and can induce ingroup preference; culturally proximate prompting can improve alignment with regional human descriptions.
summary_en.authors_note: Involves Tsinghua University and UT Austin. This is closer to socio-technical bias analysis than core foundation-model training research.

recommendation.zh: 不改方法论，但会提醒你别把“中性 prompt”当真；做多语种/多模态预训练数据配比时，这类偏置测量值得当 sanity check。
recommendation.en: It will not change your methods, but it is a useful warning not to treat 'neutral prompts' as neutral; worth keeping as a sanity check for multilingual or multimodal data-mixture work.

paper.title: UniEditBench: A Unified and Cost-Effective Benchmark for Image and Video Editing via Distilled MLLMs
paper.abstract: The evaluation of visual editing models remains fragmented across methods and modalities. Existing benchmarks are often tailored to specific paradigms, making fair cross-paradigm comparisons difficult, while video editing lacks reliable evaluation benchmarks. Furthermore, common automatic metrics often misalign with human preference, yet directly deploying large multimodal models (MLLMs) as evaluators incurs prohibitive computational and financial costs. We present UniEditBench, a unified benchm

summary.core_problem: 解决图像与视频编辑评测碎片化、跨范式不可比，以及直接用大规模 MLLM 评审成本过高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是 benchmark 与评测系统设计：把图像编辑和视频编辑放到统一协议下，并尝试用蒸馏后的轻量评审模型替代昂贵的强 MLLM judge。这对多模态评测方法有参考价值，但离 LLM 基座训练本身较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UniEditBench，构建统一任务分类体系，覆盖图像九类编辑操作和视频八类操作，并同时支持 reconstruction-based 与 instruction-driven 方法。评测侧以 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B Instruct 作为高容量教师评审器，再蒸馏出轻量 judge 以降低自动评测成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调 benchmark 覆盖计数、空间重排等组合性难任务，并比较自动评测与人类偏好的一致性，同时验证蒸馏 judge 的成本-效果折中。未见与预训练 scaling、数据配比或训练动态直接相关的实验，因此更适合作为多模态评测基础设施了解。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses fragmented evaluation for image and video editing, poor cross-paradigm comparability, and the prohibitive cost of using large MLLMs as judges.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark and evaluation framework: a unified protocol across image/video editing plus a distilled lightweight judge to replace expensive frontier MLLM evaluators. Useful for multimodal evaluation design, but not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniEditBench introduces a shared taxonomy covering nine image-editing operations and eight video-editing operations, spanning both reconstruction-based and instruction-driven settings. On the evaluation side, it distills a strong teacher judge, Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B Instruct, into a cheaper lightweight evaluator.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights coverage of compositional tasks such as counting and spatial reordering, and studies alignment between automatic metrics and human preference while validating the cost-quality tradeoff of the distilled judge. There is no direct evidence tied to pretraining scaling, data mixture, or optimization dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心多模态评测器蒸馏，只看 benchmark taxonomy 和 judge 对齐实验；对预训练本身帮助有限，不必通读。
recommendation.en: Read only the taxonomy and judge-alignment sections if you care about distilled multimodal evaluators; it is peripheral to pretraining and not worth a full read.

paper.title: Benchmarking Deflection and Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态检索增强（KB-VQA / LVLM-RAG）评测普遍只看“答对没”，忽略两类关键失败模式：在证据不足/冲突时应当“拒答/偏转（deflection）”而不是“编造（hallucination）”；同时静态基准会因模型参数记忆增强而快速“过时”，导致原本需要检索的问题被模型直接凭参数知识答出，从而无法持续衡量检索依赖与鲁棒性。本文要解决的是：如何构建一个可随模型能力演进而保持难度、并能显式区分 hallucination vs deflection 的多模态检索基准与评测协议。
summary.importance: 对预训练/基础模型研究的直接价值不在于提出新训练算法，而在于提供了一个更“机制导向”的评测框架：把“参数记忆（parametric knowledge）”与“检索证据使用（grounding under retrieval noise）”拆开测，并把失败模式细分为 hallucination/deflection，可用于诊断：模型到底是因为记住了、还是因为会用证据；以及在证据缺失/干扰时是否会产生过度自信的生成。这对数据科学与后续训练（如RAG对齐、拒答策略、校准训练）提供了更清晰的目标函数与数据构造范式。动态过滤“参数可解样本”的思路也对构建长期有效的预训练评测集有启发（类似“持续基准维护”）。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是一个“动态策展（dynamic curation）+ 四场景评测”的基准构建方法。
1) 动态过滤参数可解：从异构KB-VQA来源收集原始样本S0，每个样本x=(q,v,K,a)。用一组强开源/开放权重VLM作为gating models G={Gemma3-27B, Qwen-2.5-VL-32B, InternVL3-38B, VL-Rethinker-72B}在不提供外部知识的parametric setting下回答(q,v)。再用外部裁判E（GPT-4o + SimpleQA prompt）判定CORRECT/INCORRECT/NOT ATTEMPTED，并映射到Accuracy/Hallucination/Deflection。仅保留“所有gate都答不对”的样本进入S1，从而尽量保证问题确实需要检索证据。
2) 为每个保留样本配对gold与distractor上下文：构造K(x)^+（gold knowledge）与K(x)^-（distractors）。若源数据自带负例则复用；否则进行检索挖掘：文本侧建立Wikipedia索引WT，用EVA-CLIP做初检索、再用Contriever重排并切分成passages；图像侧建立图像索引WI，检索top-10相似但非gold的负图。
3) 质量控制：至少包含“可解性（有gold时应能解）”与“难度/干扰性（有distractor时容易诱发错误）”两类检查（全文后续应给出更细的过滤规则与阈值）。
4) 评测协议：提出四种互补场景以解耦能力来源：parametric（无检索，测记忆/先验）、oracle（给gold，测证据利用上限）、realistic（给检索到的混合上下文，测真实RAG）、adversarial（给干扰/冲突上下文，测抗噪与是否会在证据不足时deflect）。并显式统计deflection与hallucination，而非只看accuracy。
summary.experiments: 基准规模：2,775条样本，覆盖多种多模态检索设置（部分样本无图像，反映KB-VQA来源多样性）。作者对20个SOTA LVLM做系统评测，结论是：即便最强的闭源系统也“无法可靠deflect”，在不完整或干扰知识下经常hallucinate。当前给出的全文片段未包含各模型在四场景下的完整数值表、以及不同检索噪声条件下的定量差异；但从方法描述可知其指标把INCORRECT与NOT ATTEMPTED分开计量，从而能报告：在realistic/adversarial时，模型是倾向‘硬答错’还是‘拒答’。建议在全文结果表中重点核对：parametric过滤后仍残留的可解比例（过滤有效性）、oracle vs realistic的性能落差（检索链路瓶颈）、以及adversarial下hallucination率的上升幅度（鲁棒性）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30–45分钟）：
- 重点看Figure 1/2（任务定义与动态策展流水线）以及“dynamic filtering/gating models + judge映射指标”的细节：它决定了基准是否真的‘检索依赖’。
- 重点看四场景评测定义（parametric/oracle/realistic/adversarial）与指标口径（CORRECT/INCORRECT/NOT ATTEMPTED→Accuracy/Hallucination/Deflection），这是本文最可复用的机制化贡献。
- 快速扫实验主表：关注不同模型在adversarial场景的hallucination vs deflection分布，以及oracle→realistic的gap（检索噪声敏感性）。
- 若你做预训练数据/评测：深挖“如何挖distractor（EVA-CLIP+Contriever）”与质量控制阈值，思考能否迁移到纯文本RAG或长上下文证据冲突评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KB-VQA / LVLM-RAG benchmarks largely collapse evaluation into accuracy, failing to distinguish two qualitatively different failure modes under missing/contradictory evidence: (i) deflection/abstention vs (ii) hallucinated unsupported answers. They also become obsolete quickly because growing parametric knowledge allows models to answer formerly retrieval-dependent questions without retrieval. The paper targets a benchmark + protocol that stays retrieval-dependent over time and explicitly measures hallucination vs deflection under realistic and adversarial retrieval noise.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining algorithm, but it is highly relevant to foundation-model research as a diagnostic instrument: it disentangles parametric memorization from evidence-grounded retrieval behavior, and it operationalizes abstention as a first-class metric. The dynamic “filter out parametric-solvable items” recipe is a practical blueprint for maintaining long-lived benchmarks as models scale, and it provides clearer targets for subsequent training (RAG alignment, refusal policies, uncertainty calibration) and data curation aimed at reducing overconfident generations.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is a dynamic curation pipeline plus a four-scenario evaluation protocol.
1) Dynamic parametric filtering: collect heterogeneous KB-VQA samples S0 with x=(q,v,K,a). Query a set of strong open(-ish) VLMs as gating models (Gemma3-27B, Qwen-2.5-VL-32B, InternVL3-38B, VL-Rethinker-72B) in a parametric setting (q,v only, no external knowledge). Use an external judge (GPT-4o with a SimpleQA-style prompt) to label each response as CORRECT / INCORRECT / NOT ATTEMPTED, mapped to Accuracy / Hallucination / Deflection. Keep only items that all gating models fail, yielding S1 intended to be genuinely retrieval-dependent.
2) Context augmentation: for each retained item, attach gold context K(x)^+ and distractor context K(x)^-. If negatives are not provided by the source, mine them via retrieval: build a Wikipedia text index, retrieve with EVA-CLIP, segment passages, and rerank with Contriever; for visual negatives, retrieve top-10 similar non-gold images from an image index.
3) Quality control: enforce solvability with gold context and difficulty/robustness under distractors (details/thresholds appear later in the full paper).
4) Evaluation protocol: define four complementary settings—parametric, oracle (gold context), realistic (retrieved mixed context), adversarial (distracting/contradictory context)—to separate memorization, upper-bound grounding, real-world RAG robustness, and adversarial susceptibility, while explicitly tracking hallucination vs deflection rather than accuracy alone.
summary_en.experiments: Dataset size is 2,775 examples spanning diverse multimodal retrieval configurations (including some text-only cases). The authors evaluate 20 state-of-the-art LVLMs and report a consistent qualitative finding: even top proprietary models do not reliably deflect; they frequently hallucinate when evidence is incomplete or distracting. The provided excerpt does not include the full quantitative tables; when reading the full paper, the key numbers to extract are: (i) filtering effectiveness (how many items remain parametric-solvable after gating), (ii) oracle-to-realistic performance gap (retrieval/noise bottleneck), and (iii) adversarial hallucination-rate increase and whether any model meaningfully shifts mass from hallucination to deflection.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Start with Figures 1–2 to internalize the benchmark goal and the dynamic curation pipeline.
- Read the parametric filtering section carefully (gating model set, judge prompt/labels, retention rule), since it determines whether the benchmark truly measures retrieval dependence.
- Focus on the four evaluation scenarios and the metric mapping (CORRECT/INCORRECT/NOT ATTEMPTED → accuracy/hallucination/deflection).
- Then scan the main results table(s) for adversarial vs realistic behavior and oracle vs realistic gaps; those are the most actionable diagnostics for training and data work.
- If you work on data/benchmark maintenance, dig into distractor mining (EVA-CLIP + Contriever) and QC criteria to reuse the recipe elsewhere.

recommendation.zh: 把 hallucination vs deflection 拆开测并动态剔除“参数可解”样本，能直接指导你怎么维护长期有效的 RAG 评测；读协议与过滤策略就够。
recommendation.en: Separating hallucination vs deflection plus dynamically filtering “parametrically solvable” items changes how I’d maintain RAG evals over time; read the protocol and filtering method only.

paper.title: Edu-MMBias: A Three-Tier Multimodal Benchmark for Auditing Social Bias in Vision-Language Models under Educational Contexts

summary.core_problem: 如何在教育场景下系统性审计VLM的社会偏见，并区分视觉通道引入/放大的隐性偏差。
summary.importance: Benchmark/评测贡献：提出三层级（认知/情感/行为）偏见审计框架与数据生成流程，强调“视觉输入是偏见放大器”的现象，并报告反直觉模式（补偿性阶层偏好与同时存在的健康/种族刻板印象），对VLM对齐与安全评测有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: Edu-MMBias：基于社会心理学态度三成分模型构建分层评测；通过专门的生成式数据管线合成“抗污染”的学生画像（包含自我纠错机制与human-in-the-loop验证）以减少训练数据泄漏/模板污染；对SOTA VLM进行压力测试并分析视觉条件下的偏见变化。
summary.experiments: 对多种SOTA VLM进行系统审计；摘要未披露具体模型列表、样本规模、指标体系与数值结果，但强调发现多类关键偏见与视觉输入导致的放大效应。

summary_en.core_problem: How to systematically audit social bias in vision-language models within educational settings, and isolate biases introduced or amplified specifically by the visual modality.
summary_en.importance: Contributes a benchmark and auditing framework with a three-tier (cognitive/affective/behavioral) structure, highlighting that visual inputs can act as bias amplifiers and revealing non-obvious bias patterns relevant to VLM alignment and safety evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents Edu-MMBias, grounded in the social-psychology tripartite attitude model; builds an anti-contamination synthetic data pipeline for student profiles with self-correction and human-in-the-loop verification to reduce leakage/template artifacts; stress-tests VLMs and analyzes bias shifts with and without images.
summary_en.experiments: Conducts a systematic audit across multiple state-of-the-art VLMs and reports several amplified or counterintuitive biases under visual conditioning, but the abstract omits model lists, dataset size, metrics, and numeric results.

recommendation.zh: 偏安全审计向：只看“视觉输入放大偏见”的对照实验设计是否干净，以及三层级标签是否可迁移到你们的对齐评测。
recommendation.en: Safety-audit oriented: only check whether the “vision amplifies bias” controls are clean and whether the three-tier labels transfer to your alignment eval suite.
